questions.optionA: even if they are encouraged to discover their own errors and correct themselves
questions.optionB: because introducing students to abstract concepts might be a painstaking process for teachers
questions.optionC: although teachers strive to spark students' imagination and improve their problem-solving skills
questions.optionD: when they are guided to collaborate with their peers to complete classroom tasks
questions.optionE: given that self-reliance and perseverance are among the students' highly-valued assets
questions.explanation: "can be effectively promoted ----" başarının hangi koşulda/yöntemle desteklendiğini sorar; D seçeneği akran işbirliğiyle görev tamamlamayı somut bir yöntem olarak sunar.

questions.promptText: While it is unknown why some people develop misshapen cornea which leads to astigmatism, ----.
questions.turkishTranslation: Bazı insanların astigmatizmaya yol açan şekli bozuk kornea geliştirmesinin nedeni bilinmemekle birlikte, ----.
questions.optionA: corrective measures are necessary only in cases where the distortion is severe enough to impair vision
questions.optionB: light entering the eye is directed by the cornea to a single point, enabling the eye to see clearly
questions.optionC: an instrument is used to measure the cornea and calculate the shape of the required corrective lens
questions.optionD: factors such as stress, continual reading in dim lighting, or excessive close-up work may contribute
questions.optionE: the main symptom of astigmatism is blurred or distorted vision as well as a history of eye strain and double vision
questions.explanation: "While" kesin nedenin bilinmemesiyle karşıtlık kurar; D seçeneği kesin sebep olmasa da olası katkıda bulunan faktörleri sayarak bu zıtlığı tamamlar.

questions.promptText: ----, but it was after the first Industrial Revolution that the global demand for resources increased at high speed.
questions.turkishTranslation: ----, ancak kaynaklara yönelik küresel talep yüksek bir hızla artış göstermeye ilk Sanayi Devrimi'nden sonra başlamıştır.
questions.optionA: If the pace of human population growth continues at a steady rate, humankind will suffer from food shortages
questions.optionB: There is a link between a country's level of resource redistribution and the accessibility of health care
questions.optionC: Political stability and peace result in resources being shifted towards economic prosperity
questions.optionD: Since its early stages, humankind has been utilising the natural resources that the Earth provides
questions.optionE: Scientists have developed efficient mining methods for rich caches of mineral resources
questions.explanation: "but" bağlacı kaynak kullanımının insanlık tarihinin başından beri var olmasıyla, talebin asıl hızlı artışının Sanayi Devrimi'nden sonra olması arasındaki zıtlığı kurar; D ilk tarafı verir.

questions.promptText: ----; however, the Japanese began to create distinct versions of clothing during the Heian period.
questions.turkishTranslation: ----; ancak Japonlar, Heian döneminde kendilerine özgü kıyafet türleri yaratmaya başladılar.
questions.optionA: The type of fabric used in clothes signified the social rank and privilege within Japanese society
questions.optionB: Japan borrowed many Chinese customs including the wearing of robes for the wealthy, and trousers and simple tunics for the poor
questions.optionC: The Japanese were first exposed to Western dress in 1542 when British and Portuguese traders visited the nation

questions.promptText: Although the general public tends to believe natural and herbal products are always safe, ----.
questions.turkishTranslation: Genel halk, doğal ve bitkisel ürünlerin her zaman güvenli olduğuna inanma eğiliminde olsa da, ----.

questions.optionB: the efficacy and safety of these products have only recently been studied in controlled clinical trials
questions.optionC: a herbal supplement manufactured from the seeds of an African plant is thought to alleviate depression
questions.optionD: herbal alternatives are often less costly than paying out-of-pocket for non-formulary medications
questions.optionE: alternative nonmedical beliefs found in patients who believe in traditional herbal practices may actually mitigate psychological problems
questions.explanation: "Although" halkın güvenlik inancıyla, bu güvenliğin bilimsel olarak ancak yakın zamanda test edilmiş olması arasında zıtlık kurar; B bu bilimsel gerçeği sunar.

questions.promptText: ----; however, over time, they began to develop some highly sophisticated agricultural methods as they enhanced their knowledge of the lands they lived on.
questions.turkishTranslation: ----; ancak zamanla, yaşadıkları toprakları daha iyi tanımaya başladıkça oldukça gelişmiş tarım yöntemleri geliştirmeye başladılar.
questions.optionA: Once the British started to creep across Australian territory, the Aboriginals' days of hunting and gathering were an ancient memory
questions.optionB: Indigenous Australians' use of excavated watering holes to help keep animals away from crops was quite impressive
questions.optionC: Upon first arriving in Australia, early humans had no choice but to survive by hunting native species and gathering any available food
questions.optionD: Indigenous Australians' use of strategic burning and planting allowed them to cultivate a beautiful landscape
questions.optionE: Dependent upon each other for survival, Indigenous Australians had no use for full-scale conflict
questions.explanation: "however, over time" başlangıçtaki avcı-toplayıcı yaşamla, zamanla gelişen sofistike tarım yöntemleri arasında zıtlık kurar; C bu ilkel başlangıç durumunu verir.

questions.promptText: Helping parents with everyday domestic activities such as baking can be fun for the child in addition to developing fine motor skills; ----.
questions.turkishTranslation: Pişirme gibi günlük ev işlerinde ebeveynlere yardım etmek, ince motor becerilerini geliştirmenin yanı sıra çocuk için eğlenceli de olabilir; ----.
questions.optionA: for example, stirring batter provides a good workout for the hand and arm muscles, and cutting cookie dough requires hand-eye coordination
questions.optionB: as a result, encouraging gross motor skills requires a safe, open play space, peers to interact with, and some adult supervision
questions.optionC: that is, fine motor skills involve controlled movements facilitating both muscle development and maturation of the central nervous system
questions.optionD: thus, short and stubby fingers of pre-schoolers make delicate or complicated tasks more difficult
questions.optionE: conversely, fine motor development can be encouraged by activities that youngsters enjoy
questions.explanation: A seçeneği "for example" ile pastacılığın ince motor becerilerini nasıl geliştirdiğine (karıştırma, kesme) dair somut bir örnek vererek önceki genel ifadeyi somutlaştırır.

questions.promptText: Someone who is generally shy is unlikely to follow a career path in television or pursue a role that requires a lot of networking and social interaction ----.
questions.turkishTranslation: Genellikle çekingen olan biri, televizyonda bir kariyer yolu izlemesi veya çok fazla ağ kurma ve sosyal etkileşim gerektiren bir rol üstlenmesi olası değildir ----.
questions.optionA: unless they can learn to master their shyness to follow a particular passion
questions.optionB: as if shyness can affect people in different ways and in different areas of life
questions.optionC: whereas shyness can also influence the path that our lives task
questions.optionD: whether we are drawn to those things that make us feel most comfortable
questions.optionE: provided that this can be one of the biggest problems with shyness
questions.explanation: "unlikely ----" ifadesindeki olasılığa "unless" ile bir istisna eklenir: çekingenliğini yenebilen kişi için bu kural geçerli olmaz.

questions.promptText: Computer models help researchers predict the behaviour of natural phenomena and examine the effects of human interventions in natural processes; ----.
questions.turkishTranslation: Bilgisayar modelleri, araştırmacıların doğal olayların davranışını tahmin etmesine ve insan müdahalelerinin doğal süreçler üzerindeki etkilerini incelemesine yardımcı olur; ----.
questions.optionA: however, they can simulate the development of a hurricane by evaluating pressure and temperature
questions.optionB: as a result, they have become crucial tools for disciplines such as meteorology, geophysics, and oceanography
questions.optionC: nevertheless, they can provide a substantial amount of data for numerous studies in earth sciences
questions.optionD: that is, even the most sophisticated computer models contain shortcomings such as spatial resolution problems
questions.optionE: instead, the significant political role of computer models can be exemplified by the ongoing international debates over global climate change
questions.explanation: "as a result" sonuç bağlacı, bilgisayar modellerinin sağladığı faydanın (tahmin, inceleme) sonucu olarak bu modellerin ilgili bilim dallarında kritik araçlar hâline gelmesini bağlar.

questions.promptText: The advent of artificial intelligence (AI) technologies has the potential to bring about a profound transformation in the activities and operations of intelligence services ----.
questions.turkishTranslation: Yapay zeka (AI) teknolojilerinin ortaya çıkışı, istihbarat servislerinin faaliyet ve operasyonlarında köklü bir değişim yaratma potansiyeline sahiptir ----.
questions.optionA: since the use of AI introduces a complex interplay of ethical and privacy considerations
questions.optionB: even if AI algorithms assist in identifying recent developments or adjustments to military deployments by analysing satellite imagery
questions.optionC: given that the utilisation of AI can enhance cyber security and augment capabilities in threat detection, thereby safeguarding national security
questions.optionD: although the rapid advancement of AI technology has led to the emergence of diverse applications
questions.optionE: because striking a balance between reaping the benefits of AI and upholding civil rights poses a significant challenge
questions.explanation: "given that" sebep bağlacı, AI'nin istihbarat hizmetlerinde yarattığı dönüşümün nedenini verir: siber güvenliği ve tehdit tespitini güçlendirmesi bu dönüşümün mantıklı sebebidir.

questions.promptText: Programmes of archaeological research and conservation have been established in many medieval towns and cities ----.
questions.turkishTranslation: Birçok ortaçağ kasabası ve şehrinde arkeolojik araştırma ve koruma programları kurulmuştur ----.
questions.optionA: provided that more early medieval excavations have focused on rural settlements, towns, and trading settlements
questions.optionB: whether archaeologists working on later medieval sites have access to a wide range of documentary records
questions.optionC: since many important archaeological sites within towns and cities are threatened by urban growth and redevelopment
questions.optionD: although archaeology of High Medieval period in England differs from earlier medieval archaeology in many ways
questions.optionE: even if the knowledge about the archaeology of the High Middle Ages in England is a result of urban excavations
questions.explanation: "since" sebep bağlacı, koruma programlarının neden kurulduğunu açıklar: kentleşme ve yeniden yapılanmanın bu alanları tehdit etmesi bu programların gerekçesidir.

questions.promptText: If adolescents become a member of a group that promotes deviant behaviour, ----.
questions.turkishTranslation: Ergenler sapkın davranışı özendiren bir grubun üyesi olurlarsa, ----.
questions.optionA: friendship patterns are powerful influences on gang membership, as is the excitement of involvement in delinquent activity
questions.optionB: deviant behaviour is often characterised by the violation of social norms and the rejection of shared values
questions.optionC: then the ability of the parents to shape or regulate their children's behaviour might be diminished considerably
questions.optionD: the composition of a group can vary greatly from school to school and from neighbourhood to neighbourhood
questions.optionE: members of a peer group have similar behavioural patterns or goals
questions.explanation: "If ----, then" koşul yapısı kurulmuştur; C seçeneğindeki "then" bu koşula uygun mantıksal sonucu (ebeveyn etkisinin azalması) verir.

questions.promptText: Shy people often refrain from interacting with others or taking part in events, ----.
questions.turkishTranslation: Çekingen insanlar genellikle başkalarıyla etkileşime girmekten veya etkinliklere katılmaktan çekinirler, ----.
questions.optionA: as they generally find themselves unable to do so, consumed by a sense of dread, anxiousness, or uncertainty
questions.optionB: thus they communicate with other people to fulfil daily obligations though they find it challenging
questions.optionC: but participating in social activities can feel more like difficult hurdles to overcome
questions.optionD: although they might be temperamentally shy and feel psychological discomfort when accompanied by strangers
questions.optionE: instead shyness is often grouped in with other conditions and traits, such as fear and introversion
questions.explanation: "as" sebep bağlacı, çekingen insanların sosyal etkinliklerden kaçınma davranışının nedenini verir: korku ve kaygıyla boğulmuş hissetmeleri bu kaçınmanın gerekçesidir.

questions.promptText: Given the complexity of the types of mental disorders, ----.
questions.turkishTranslation: Zihinsel bozukluk türlerinin karmaşıklığı göz önüne alındığında, ----.
questions.optionA: scientists are developing treatments for mental disorders by studying the chemical effects of neurotransmitters in the brain
questions.optionB: the signs, symptoms, and treatment methods can differ hugely from one person to another
questions.optionC: a seriously distorted and inappropriate body image characterises a number of mental disorders
questions.optionD: cognitive therapy, widely used to treat mental disorders, assumes that faulty thoughts cause dysfunctional behaviour
questions.optionE: individuals with certain mental disorders may repeat words spoken by others with a robot-like speech pattern
questions.explanation: "Given" sebep bağlacı zihinsel bozukluklardaki karmaşıklığı, B seçeneğindeki kişiden kişiye büyük farklılık gösteren belirti/tedavi sonucuna bağlar.

questions.promptText: Severe pain may disrupt sleep and lead to the development of sleep disorders such as insomnia; ----.
questions.turkishTranslation: Şiddetli ağrı, uykuyu bozabilir ve uykusuzluk gibi uyku bozukluklarının gelişmesine yol açabilir; ----.
questions.optionA: furthermore, it may restrict movement and result in too much bed rest, which causes deconditioning
questions.optionB: rather, disrupted sleep is not restorative because people wake up feeling tired, and their pain becomes more intense
questions.optionC: however, those suffering from pain cannot exert the physical or mental effort involved in maintaining social relationships
questions.optionD: in other words, there are many people who have difficulty in falling asleep
questions.optionE: therefore, the reason why some people experience higher levels of pain has yet to be clearly identified
questions.explanation: "furthermore" ekleme bağlacı, ağrının uykuya verdiği zarara ek olarak hareketi kısıtlayıp fazla yatak istirahatine ve kondisyon kaybına yol açtığını ekler.

questions.promptText: High self-esteem confers many benefits to people as well as producing positive psychological outcomes; ----.
questions.turkishTranslation: Yüksek özgüven, olumlu psikolojik sonuçlar üretmesinin yanı sıra insanlara birçok fayda sağlar; ----.
questions.optionA: moreover, those who lack self-esteem may avoid engaging in social interactions and fail to establish enduring relations with others
questions.optionB: therefore, self-esteem is generally thought to increase over the course of middle and late adolescence
questions.optionC: however, it might also have a dark side as it sometimes relates to maladaptive behaviour, such as heightened aggression
questions.optionD: for example, young people have higher self-esteem than elders when it comes to their physical appearance
questions.optionE: nonetheless, self-esteem is a multi-layered concept and people evaluate themselves along several different dimensions
questions.explanation: "however" yüksek özgüvenin faydalarıyla, saldırganlık gibi olumsuz davranışlarla ilişkili "karanlık yönü" arasında zıtlık kurar; C bu karşıtlığı tamamlar.

questions.promptText: Digestive problems often have negative consequences, and for those with weak or unsettled digestion, life can be miserable; ----.
questions.turkishTranslation: Sindirim sorunları genellikle olumsuz sonuçlara yol açar ve zayıf ya da düzensiz sindirime sahip olanlar için hayat sefil olabilir; ----.
questions.optionA: in other words, the digestion process affects how rapidly oral medications enter the blood circulation
questions.optionB: therefore, fasting may be required to avoid them or a certain type of food must be excluded from one's diet
questions.optionC: on the contrary, poor digestive health may be linked to a large variety of factors, such as infections and disordered gut bacteria
questions.optionD: instead, herbal medicines can improve the complex functioning of the digestive system, helping to relieve acidity and nausea
questions.optionE: as a result, food passes from the stomach into the small intestine during digestion and is mixed from pancreatic secretions
questions.explanation: "therefore" sonuç bağlacı, sindirim sorunlarının olumsuz sonuçlarından kaçınmak için oruç tutma veya belirli gıdaları diyetten çıkarma gibi önlemleri mantıklı sonuç olarak bağlar.

questions.promptText: ----, there are lethal ones that aim to reduce bird numbers, as a means of preventing damage to the environment.
