questions.optionA: When chemicals are used to control birds that pose significant hazards to places such as airports and rubbish dumps
questions.optionB: Whereas some chemical methods of control generally attempt to modify bird behaviour without causing mortality
questions.optionC: Once people use toxicants, stressing agents, or reproductive inhibitors to tackle overpopulation of birds
questions.optionD: Because birds that are often controlled through regular use of chemicals are small species such as rock pigeons and house sparrows
questions.optionE: While chemicals are highly toxic to birds and may cause both primary and secondary poisoning of non- target species
questions.explanation: "Whereas" ölümcül olmayan, davranış değiştirmeye yönelik kimyasal yöntemlerle, cümlenin devamındaki ölümcül yöntemler arasında zıtlık kurar; B bu karşıtlığın ilk tarafını verir.

questions.promptText: Proponents of globalisation see it as the answer to fundamental problems that plague poor countries ----.
questions.turkishTranslation: Küreselleşmenin destekçileri, onu yoksul ülkeleri kasıp kavuran temel sorunların cevabı olarak görürler ----.
questions.optionA: although the view that globalisation fosters cultural interaction has become pervasive
questions.optionB: because it is thought to provide plenty of opportunities for sustainable development and socioeconomic growth
questions.optionC: if it had not increased the scope, volume, and velocity of global cooperation
questions.optionD: even if it is associated with lower consumer prices and improved efficiency and production
questions.optionE: just like immigration is an unfavourable outcome of globalisation, with different political and cultural dimensions
questions.explanation: "because" sebep bağlacı, küreselleşme yanlılarının onu yoksul ülkelerin çözümü olarak görme nedenini verir: sürdürülebilir kalkınma ve sosyoekonomik büyüme fırsatları sunması.

questions.promptText: The mathematical activity of the Babylonians seems to have been motivated, at first, by the practical everyday needs of running their society; ----.
questions.turkishTranslation: Babillilerin matematiksel faaliyetlerinin, başlangıçta toplumlarını yönetmenin pratik günlük ihtiyaçlarından kaynaklandığı görülmektedir; ----.
questions.optionA: by contrast, the Babylonians used a simple stylus to make marks in the clay and developed a form of writing based on cuneiform symbols
questions.optionB: thus, some of the tasks defined in later texts had no apparent practical application and clearly indicated an interest in pursuing mathematics for its own sake
questions.optionC: however, the Babylonians kept extensive records of their society and their mathematics on hardy sun- baked clay tablets
questions.optionD: for instance, many problems described in early tablets were concerned with calculating the number of workers needed for building irrigation canals and the total expense of wages
questions.optionE: hence, a popular theory suggests that the Babylonians' number system was based on the observation that there are 365 days in the year
questions.explanation: "for instance" örnek bağlacı, matematiğin pratik günlük ihtiyaçlardan doğduğu iddiasını, kanal işçisi sayısı ve maaş hesaplama gibi somut örneklerle destekler.

questions.promptText: ----, there has been a marked decline in its population due to the excessive hunting for its valuable skin, which began in the 1940s.
questions.turkishTranslation: ----, 1940'larda başlayan değerli derisi için yapılan aşırı avlanma nedeniyle popülasyonunda belirgin bir düşüş olmuştur.
questions.optionA: When large areas in the black caiman's habitat were cleared by loggers and converted into farms
questions.optionB: Even if hunting remains a big threat to the black caiman and humans chase the crocodile for a variety of reasons
questions.optionC: Given that the black caiman was legally protected in most countries despite poorly enforced laws
questions.optionD: While the large size of the black caiman made it an easy target for hunters, who killed millions for the leather industry
questions.optionE: Although the black caiman, a large species of crocodile, once existed in great numbers in the Amazon Basin
questions.explanation: "Although" türün bir zamanlar bol sayıda bulunmasıyla, sonraki cümledeki nüfusundaki belirgin azalma arasında zıtlık kurar; E bu bolluk durumunu verir.

questions.promptText: In addition to being an unreliable power source, ----
questions.turkishTranslation: Güvenilmez bir enerji kaynağı olmasının yanı sıra, ----
questions.optionA: wind turbines pose a serious threat to migrating bird populations
questions.optionB: wind turbines have been widely used in Europe, particularly in the Netherlands and Denmark
questions.optionC: most of the limitations of wind turbines have been overcome thanks to current technology
questions.optionD: smaller wind turbines are utilised to provide power to individual homes
questions.optionE: wind turbines are most cost-effective in areas with consistently strong winds
questions.explanation: "In addition to" ekleme ifadesi rüzgar türbinlerinin güvenilmezliğine ek bir olumsuz özellik gerektirir; A seçeneği göçmen kuşlara tehdit oluşturmasını bu ikinci olumsuzluk olarak ekler.

questions.promptText: Although many people enjoy the low cost and taste of fast food, ----
questions.turkishTranslation: Birçok insan fast food'un düşük maliyetinden ve tadından hoşlansa da, ----
questions.optionA: sales of fast food have dramatically increased over the past 50 years, employing hundreds of thousands of workers
questions.optionB: the idea of eating outside the home was encouraged by fast food, which contributed to the explosion of restaurants
questions.optionC: fast food has spread around the world, offering a wide variety of local and national tastes
questions.optionD: it is known that in the 1950s, the hamburger and French fries became the iconic American meal with the advent of fast food chains
questions.optionE: elitists have always looked down on fast food, regarding it as yet another manifestation of Western popular culture
questions.explanation: "Although" fast food'u beğenen çoğunlukla, onu hor gören elitler arasında zıtlık kurar; E bu karşıt görüşü vererek cümleyi tamamlar.

questions.promptText: Even if most of the herbal medicines are safe to use, ----
questions.turkishTranslation: Bitkisel ilaçların çoğu kullanım açısından güvenli olsa da, ----
questions.optionA: they often complement conventional treatments, providing effective remedies for chronic illnesses such as asthma
questions.optionB: their sales continue to grow year after year since many pharmaceutical companies manufacture and market them
questions.optionC: they not only provide nutrients, but when needed, they also strengthen and support the action of the digestive system
questions.optionD: it is essential to take them only under the guidance of a well-trained practitioner to avoid negative consequences
questions.optionE: people have become increasingly knowledgeable about their role in maintaining well-being
questions.explanation: "Even if" bitkisel ilaçların güvenli olmasına rağmen hâlâ dikkat gerektirdiğini vurgular; D seçeneği uzman gözetimi şartını ekleyerek bu zıtlığı tamamlar.

questions.promptText: ---- ; however, humans cause a great deal of harm to them by overharvesting their limited resources and polluting them with oil and plastics.
questions.turkishTranslation: ---- ; ancak insanlar, sınırlı kaynaklarını aşırı şekilde kullanarak ve onları petrol ve plastiklerle kirleterek onlara büyük zarar vermektedir.
questions.optionA: The oceans regulate the climate, provide us with food, and produce at least half of the world's oxygen
questions.optionB: Only a few rich nations can afford the expensive technologies required for seabed mining and mineral extraction
questions.optionC: The need for marine biologists has increased because of the growing interest in conservation of the oceans
questions.optionD: The institutions and laws that govern oceans are too fragmented and weak due to the lack of global collaboration
questions.optionE: In the past, changes in ocean circulation amplified changes in climate, which may now account for global warming
questions.explanation: "however" okyanusların insanlığa sağladığı faydalarla, insanların onlara verdiği zarar arasında zıtlık kurar; A seçeneği bu faydaları (iklim düzenleme, besin, oksijen) sıralar.

questions.promptText: People have very little incentive to engage in tasks in which they feel incompetent ----
questions.turkishTranslation: İnsanlar, kendilerini yetersiz hissettikleri görevlere girişmek için çok az motivasyona sahiptir ----
questions.optionA: even if they lack intrinsic interest and have a low level of motivation
questions.optionB: unless they believe that their actions will have the desired consequences
questions.optionC: although they frequently suffer from excessive self-doubt about their capabilities
questions.optionD: once they set attainable goals and maintain strong commitment to them
questions.optionE: because their perseverance and meticulous work will eventually bring success
questions.explanation: "little incentive ----" ifadesine "unless" ile bir istisna eklenir: kişi eylemlerinin istenen sonuçları doğuracağına inanmadıkça bu isteksizlik sürer.

questions.promptText: The knowledge acquired through curiosity can promote intellectual development, ----
questions.turkishTranslation: Merak yoluyla edinilen bilgi, entelektüel gelişimi destekleyebilir, ----
questions.optionA: whereas it stimulates important academic skills such as questioning, experimenting, and evaluating
questions.optionB: because it may not be welcomed positively in certain cultures due to the disturbance to personal privacy
questions.optionC: though, if too much, it can lead to problems like unhealthy obsession with trivia and hazardous risk- taking
questions.optionD: but learners become more inclined to explore novel information in greater depth once their curiosity is aroused
questions.optionE: so adults tend to avoid thrill-and-adventure seeking and other forms of sensory curiosity as they approach old age
questions.explanation: "though" merakın zihinsel gelişime olan faydasına, aşırıya kaçtığında doğabilecek olumsuz sonuçları (takıntı, riskli davranış) karşıt olarak ekler.

questions.promptText: People often underestimate the amount of caffeine they consume on a daily basis ----
questions.turkishTranslation: İnsanlar günlük olarak tükettikleri kafein miktarını genellikle küçümserler ----
questions.optionA: although caffeine is also found in tea, coke, and hot chocolate drinks
questions.optionB: so that it can provide benefits like increased alertness and enhanced sensory activity
questions.optionC: as the overconsumption of caffeine may produce irritability, anxiety, and insomnia
questions.optionD: because they mostly think of it in relation to coffee as a beverage, regardless of other caffeine-laden drinks
questions.optionE: given that they find it difficult to imagine eating a meal without having coffee
questions.explanation: "because" sebep bağlacı, insanların kafein tüketimini neden küçümsediğini açıklar: kafeini sadece kahveyle ilişkilendirip diğer kaynakları göz ardı etmeleri.

questions.promptText: Vaccination introduces dead or weakened disease-causing substances into the body ----
questions.turkishTranslation: Aşılama, vücuda ölü veya zayıflatılmış hastalık yapan maddeleri sokar ----
questions.optionA: although vaccines have successfully provided protection against diseases such as polio, smallpox, and diphtheria
questions.optionB: once scientists have recognised that vaccines must fulfil several criteria to be effective in protecting large number of individuals
questions.optionC: so that the production of specific antibodies that can provide individuals with active immunity can be elicited
questions.optionD: while more serious side effects such as autoimmune reactions can occur along with muscle aches
questions.optionE: because the large variety of cold viruses and their frequent mutation have prevented the development of an effective vaccine
questions.explanation: "so that" amaç bağlacı, ölü/zayıflatılmış mikropların vücuda verilme amacını açıklar: bağışıklık sağlayan antikorların üretimini tetiklemek.

questions.promptText: Given that social norms are not absolute and compliance to norms is rarely total, ----.
questions.turkishTranslation: Sosyal normların mutlak olmadığı ve normlara uyumun nadiren tam olduğu göz önüne alındığında, ----.
questions.optionA: people base their choices and values on social norms, not simply on their view of what benefits them
questions.optionB: internalisation of social norms plays an essential role in a person's identity development
questions.optionC: it is usual for community members to diverge from social norms under certain circumstances
questions.optionD: humans have a natural sense of the right and wrong that helps them formulate social norms
questions.optionE: most of us typically conform to these prevailing social norms in order to avoid social rejection
questions.explanation: "Given that" sosyal normların kesin olmadığı ve uyumun tam olmadığı öncülünden, C seçeneğindeki normlardan sapmanın olağan olması mantıksal sonucu çıkar.

questions.promptText: While the 1594 Peasants' Revolt in Austria was first thought to be an uprising by peasants urged by their clergy to defend themselves against the Catholic Counter-Reformation, ----.
questions.turkishTranslation: 1594 Avusturya Köylü Ayaklanması, başlangıçta köylülerin din adamları tarafından Katolik Karşı Reformasyon'a karşı kendilerini savunmaya teşvik edilmesiyle çıkan bir isyan olarak düşünülse de, ----.
questions.optionA: Freigeld, a feudal tax peasants had to pay whenever their property was transferred as a result of sale or death, was among the highest taxes
questions.optionB: the peasants declared that they had taken up arms only to free themselves from unjust taxes with which the nobles oppressed them
questions.optionC: all other taxes imposed on the peasants had been greatly increased, and thus their top economic grievances were heavy taxes
questions.optionD: they were highly determined to continue their rebellion against the taxes when they marched to Vienna and threatened to torch the capital's suburbs
questions.optionE: some of the peasants expressed their willingness to be submissive and to pay the taxes levied on them
questions.explanation: "While" ayaklanmanın dini sebeple başladığına dair ilk görüşle, köylülerin gerçek amacının adaletsiz vergilerden kurtulmak olduğunu söyleyen B seçeneği arasında zıtlık kurulur.

questions.promptText: Because aerobatic flying involves abrupt and extreme manoeuvres, which are unnecessary for normal flights, ----.
questions.turkishTranslation: Akrobatik uçuş, normal uçuşlar için gereksiz olan ani ve aşırı manevraları içerdiğinden, ----.
questions.optionA: both airplanes and helicopters, can perform all the same aerobatic manoeuvres, and more, as can their full-scale counterparts
questions.optionB: dangerous manoeuvres, such as loops, rolls, and dives, have become an integral part of military flight training
questions.optionC: in an aerobatic competition, each pilot is required to fly a specific sequence of aerobatic manoeuvres, called a "sequence," which are scored by a panel of judges
questions.optionD: the ability to fly an aircraft upside down was first demonstrated by the French aviator Adolphe Pégoud in 1913
questions.optionE: it places extra structural and stability demands on an aircraft and imposes specific physical requirements on the pilot
questions.explanation: "Because" sebep bağlacı, akrobatik uçuşun ani ve aşırı manevralar içermesinin sonucunu verir: uçağa ek yapısal taleplerin ve pilota fiziksel gereksinimlerin dayatılması.

questions.promptText: Although e-government seems to simply mark the shift from the paper to digital environment, ----.
questions.turkishTranslation: E-devlet, kağıttan dijital ortama geçişi basitçe işaret ediyor gibi görünse de, ----.
questions.optionA: most countries relying on e-government services claim that they will have become a totally paperless society by 2050
questions.optionB: more and more government institutions and agencies are now providing web-based information instead of paper-based information
questions.optionC: the greatest benefits of e-government do not arise from replicating paper-based processes in a computer system, but from using technology to reengineer these processes
questions.optionD: e-government applications are highly promoted as they reduce paperwork and decrease time required to respond
questions.optionE: e-government has led to a change from traditional paper filing to electronic filing in official services
questions.explanation: "Although ... seems to simply mark" ifadesi, kâğıttan dijitale geçişin basit görünümüne rağmen bu geçişin kurumlar arasında giderek yaygınlaştığı somut gelişmeyle sürdürülür; B bu devam eden eğilimi verir.

questions.promptText: As cognitive therapy is employed for a broad spectrum of illnesses and is often used in conjunction with other treatment interventions, ----.
questions.turkishTranslation: Bilişsel terapi geniş bir hastalık yelpazesi için kullanıldığından ve genellikle diğer tedavi yöntemleriyle birlikte uygulandığından, ----.
questions.optionA: it is a psychosocial therapy assuming that irrational thinking patterns cause maladaptive behaviour
questions.optionB: it also deals with cognitive distortions, which may take the form of abnormal beliefs about others' actions
questions.optionC: it might be difficult to measure overall success rates for the therapy and to accurately estimate its efficiency in treating a specific disease
questions.optionD: it focuses primarily on changing thoughts in order to adjust psychological problems
questions.optionE: it is administered in an outpatient setting (clinic or doctor's office) by a therapist trained in cognitive therapy techniques
questions.explanation: "As" sebep bağlacı, kognitif terapinin geniş bir hastalık yelpazesinde ve başka tedavilerle birlikte kullanılmasının sonucunu verir: belirli bir hastalıktaki başarı oranını ölçmenin güçleşmesi.

questions.promptText: Once people have become aware that their daily routines lead to sleep disturbances, ----.
questions.turkishTranslation: İnsanlar günlük rutinlerinin uyku bozukluklarına yol açtığının farkına vardıklarında, ----.
questions.optionA: going to bed at the same time every night has been shown to help them establish a conscious rhythm of slowing down as that time approaches
questions.optionB: sleep aids, though they are effective for occasional use, may disrupt sleep rather than promote it over the long term
questions.optionC: sleep deprivation most significantly affects the nervous system, impairing cognitive function as well as spatial orientation and coordination
questions.optionD: they can adopt lifestyle measures, such as altering eating habits and practising regular exercise, to improve the amount and quality of sleep
questions.optionE: they may also suffer from physical conditions, such as neurologic disorders, obstructive sleep apnea, and chronic pain
questions.explanation: "Once ... aware" farkındalığın ardından gelen eylemi işaret eder; D seçeneği bu farkındalık sonrası alınabilecek yaşam tarzı önlemlerini vererek mantıksal sırayı tamamlar.

questions.promptText: Without natural predators like birds and bats that keep pests under control, losses in crops would be much higher and the use of pesticides would severely impair the production quality, ----.
questions.turkishTranslation: Zararlıları kontrol altında tutan kuşlar ve yarasalar gibi doğal avcılar olmasaydı, mahsul kayıpları çok daha yüksek olur ve pestisit kullanımı üretim kalitesini ciddi şekilde zedelerdi, ----.
questions.optionA: while pesticides may create a new problem as pests develop resistance over time, forcing farmers to change to another chemical to combat the same pest
questions.optionB: unless natural predators, as well as pollinators and organisms that help create productive soil, reduce the need for pesticides
questions.optionC: so pesticides cannot replace the services provided by natural predators that save farmers billions each year
questions.optionD: yet pesticides are usually non-selective, killing both the pests and helpful organisms such as pollinators and weeds
questions.optionE: because scientists are working to develop ways to overcome harmful effects of pesticides and make agricultural production more environmentally friendly
questions.explanation: "so" sonuç bağlacı, doğal avcılar olmadan pestisitlerin üretim kalitesini bozacağı öncülünden, pestisitlerin doğal avcıların sağladığı hizmetin yerini tutamayacağı sonucuna bağlanır.

questions.promptText: ----; however, human activities contribute to the increases in extinction rates as they cause global environmental changes.
questions.turkishTranslation: ----; ancak insan faaliyetleri, küresel çevresel değişimlere neden oldukları için yok olma oranlarındaki artışa katkıda bulunmaktadır.
questions.optionA: Some animal extinctions are occurring so quickly that they represent a modern mass extinction of similar intensity to those documented in geological records
questions.optionB: The most important human influences leading to the extinction of species are excessive exploitation of forests and habitat disturbance
questions.optionC: Extinction is a natural occurrence induced by an unpredictable catastrophe or ecological interactions
questions.optionD: The high level of biodiversity loss during the past centuries has been best documented for invertebrate species
questions.optionE: Biodiversity can be promoted in ecological reserves, which are protected areas established for the conservation of endangered species
questions.explanation: "however" türlerin yok oluşunun doğal bir süreç olmasıyla, insan faaliyetlerinin bu oranı artırması arasında zıtlık kurar; C bu doğal sürecin tanımını verir.

questions.promptText: Prior to nine months, infants can retain memories for weeks or even months, ----.
questions.turkishTranslation: Dokuz aydan önce, bebekler haftalarca ya da aylarca anıları hafızada tutabilirler, ----.
questions.optionA: yet sleep is a dominant activity during the early months, which facilitates the consolidation of memories
questions.optionB: as studies of infant imitation and memory have further contributed to the understanding of the infants' representational ability
questions.optionC: because their developmental deficits may involve lack of attention, heightened distractibility, and short-term memory impairment
questions.optionD: but they retrieve those memories only if sufficient cues are present to allow them to recognise the familiarity of an event
questions.optionE: thus memories can be altered when they encounter new material that is not compatible with stored information
questions.explanation: "but" bebeklerin anıları haftalarca/aylarca saklayabilmesiyle, bu anılara ancak yeterli ipucu varsa erişebilmeleri arasında bir sınırlama/zıtlık kurar; D bu sınırlamayı verir.

questions.promptText: Peer relationships with negative outcomes are usually observed among teens searching for a particular emotion they lack in their lives; ----.
questions.turkishTranslation: Olumsuz sonuçlar doğuran akran ilişkileri genellikle hayatlarında eksik hissettikleri belirli bir duyguyu arayan gençler arasında görülür; ----.
questions.optionA: on the other hand, research indicates that peers could be fairly detrimental to an adolescent's development
questions.optionB: in contrast, most parents fear that their children will befriend the wrong crowd and end up in trouble
questions.optionC: nonetheless, adolescents are more likely to conform to their peers' opinions when it comes to day-to-day matters
questions.optionD: moreover, adolescents who have positive relationships with their parents tend to easily engage in social interaction with their peers
questions.optionE: for instance, teens joining cliques that bully or harass have low self-esteem and seek approval or a sense of dominance
questions.explanation: "for instance" örnek bağlacı, eksik oldukları duyguyu arayan gençlerin olumsuz akran ilişkileri kurma genellemesini, zorbalık yapan gruplara katılma örneğiyle somutlaştırır.

questions.promptText: ----; however, televised concerts and free outdoor concerts in Hyde Park and Covent Garden, have greatly increased its popularity.
questions.turkishTranslation: ----; ancak televizyonda yayınlanan konserler ve Hyde Park ile Covent Garden'daki ücretsiz açık hava konserleri, popülerliğini büyük ölçüde artırmıştır.
questions.optionA: Works of opera are always performed in the original language at the Royal Opera House
questions.optionB: Opera has always been regarded to have a somewhat elitist reputation in Britain
questions.optionC: London houses three permanent opera companies and numerous smaller opera groups
questions.optionD: Mainstream, obscure, traditional, and innovative music are all to be found in profusion in England
questions.optionE: Britain is a major centre for the classical recording industry, which supports a large community of musicians
questions.explanation: "however" operanın elitist imajıyla, televizyon yayınları ve ücretsiz açık hava konserleri sayesinde artan popülaritesi arasında zıtlık kurar; B bu elitist imajı verir.

questions.promptText: Although the majority of the European countries gave up uniforms for most of their governmental officers at the end of World War I, ----.
questions.turkishTranslation: Avrupa ülkelerinin çoğu, I. Dünya Savaşı'nın sonunda devlet memurlarının çoğu için üniformalardan vazgeçmiş olsa da, ----.
questions.optionA: uniforms were introduced to relieve them from buying expensive fashionable clothes needed for representing their country
questions.optionB: civilian uniforms distinguish rank by the amount and quality of the embroidery unlike military uniforms
questions.optionC: most European diplomatic uniforms were quite similar in shape but varied in colour
questions.optionD: several countries decided to keep their richly embroidered diplomatic uniforms
questions.optionE: diplomats frequently ran into trouble when trying to attend formal events at European courts
questions.explanation: "Although" çoğu ülkenin üniformalardan vazgeçmesiyle, bazı ülkelerin bunları koruması arasında zıtlık kurar; D bu istisnai durumu vererek cümleyi tamamlar.

questions.promptText: Because time management can have an effect on employees' productivity in the workplace, ----.
questions.turkishTranslation: Zaman yönetimi, çalışanların işyerindeki verimliliği üzerinde etkili olabileceğinden, ----.
questions.optionA: setting goals, meeting deadlines, staying organised, and reducing distractions are the main components of time management
questions.optionB: heavy workload often leads to high stress levels although it has been claimed to enhance productivity during working hours
questions.optionC: many of the barriers to time management are associated with employees' mental well-being and self-efficacy
questions.optionD: employees may differ from each other in scheduling their tasks and choosing the most effective way to accomplish them
questions.optionE: most employers are now offering information and assistance for employees who want to make better use of their time
questions.explanation: "Because" sebep bağlacı, zaman yönetiminin verimliliğe etkisinin sonucunu verir: işverenlerin çalışanlara zamanlarını daha iyi kullanmaları için destek sunmaları bu etkinin doğal uzantısıdır.

questions.promptText: With the exception of sign languages, speech is the primary means of communication in all human communities; ----.
questions.turkishTranslation: İşaret dilleri dışında, konuşma tüm insan topluluklarında birincil iletişim aracıdır; ----.
questions.optionA: for example, no single method is suited to study the different structures and motor systems involved in speech
questions.optionB: nonetheless, the rapid rate of speech is quite impressive when the perspective of production and the motor control processes it entails
questions.optionC: therefore, it is often the only means by which a particular language can be studied, because the majority of languages do not have a written form
questions.optionD: indeed, the aim of speech research is to understand the relation of the units and organisation of linguistic structures to the generation of speech signals
questions.optionE: however, large amounts of speech data have been collected and analysed by experiments to discover the structures of speech organisation
questions.explanation: "therefore" sonuç bağlacı, konuşmanın temel iletişim aracı olmasının sonucunu verir: yazılı biçimi olmayan dillerin incelenebilmesi için konuşmanın çoğu zaman tek yol olması.

questions.promptText: Although many activities in coursebooks for language classrooms are particularly designed for teaching purposes and do not promote natural language use, ----.
questions.turkishTranslation: Dil sınıfları için ders kitaplarındaki birçok etkinlik özellikle öğretim amacıyla tasarlanmış olup doğal dil kullanımını desteklemese de, ----.
questions.optionA: they fail to create a direct link with the world outside the classroom and thus cannot increase students' motivation to learn a second language
questions.optionB: coursebooks are generally comprised of texts with vocabulary and structures that are mostly associated with written discourse
questions.optionC: teachers can provide students with opportunities to interact with each other to fulfil tasks that represent real-life situations
questions.optionD: students might lack skills they will need to communicate effectively in the real world if they are not engaged in tasks that closely mirror daily communication
questions.optionE: it is quite common for coursebooks to place insufficient emphasis on speaking competence and for teachers to feel that more material is required
questions.explanation: "Although" ders kitabı aktivitelerinin doğal dil kullanımını desteklememesiyle, öğretmenlerin gerçek yaşamı yansıtan görevlerle bunu telafi edebilmesi arasında zıtlık kurar; C bu telafiyi verir.

questions.promptText: Conventional wisdom holds that adolescents have low self-esteem and feel more insecure than adults, ----.
questions.turkishTranslation: Yaygın görüş, ergenlerin özgüveninin düşük olduğunu ve yetişkinlerden daha güvensiz hissettiklerini öne sürer, ----.
questions.optionA: yet excessive responsibilities and obligations might restrict the young person's pursuit of self-discovery
questions.optionB: while most research indicates that they tend to have considerable confidence in their academic and artistic abilities
questions.optionC: because adolescents' greater facility with abstract thinking permits the application of advanced reasoning and logical processes to ideological matters
questions.optionD: but transition from childhood into adolescence often brings internal turmoil, preventing adolescents from establishing a sense of identity
questions.optionE: so adolescent boys do not generally rush to their parents whenever they are upset, worried, or in need of assistance
questions.explanation: "while" ergenlerin düşük özgüvenli olduğuna dair genel kanıyla, araştırmaların onların akademik/sanatsal yetilerinde özgüven sahibi olduğunu göstermesi arasında zıtlık kurar; B bu bulguyu verir.

questions.promptText: It is usually assumed that crime data are accurate and reflect the actual state of affairs; ----.
questions.turkishTranslation: Suç verilerinin doğru olduğu ve gerçek durumu yansıttığı genellikle varsayılır; ----.
questions.optionA: therefore, historical data may not be entirely reliable because the conditions under which crime rose or fell may have little to do with the efficiency of the police system
questions.optionB: on the contrary, juvenile crimes are solved at a faster rate because juveniles do not have the professional savvy that hardened criminals have in eluding the police
questions.optionC: accordingly, the police have maintained statistics on various forms of crime as well as imprisonment rates since they have a vested interest in keeping crime-rate low
questions.optionD: however, an undetermined percentage of all crimes go unreported, either because the victim did not report the crime or because the report was ignored
questions.optionE: in other words, the resurgence in crime in the post-World War II world is due to factors that are entirely different from those that propelled crime in the 19th century and earlier
questions.explanation: "however" suç verilerinin doğru olduğu varsayımıyla, bazı suçların bildirilmeden kalması gerçeği arasında zıtlık kurar; D bu çelişkiyi ortaya koyar.

questions.promptText: Each child diagnosed with an autistic disorder differs from every other in the suite of symptoms they display and the characteristics and intensity of those symptoms; ----.
questions.turkishTranslation: Otistik bozukluk tanısı alan her çocuk, gösterdiği belirtiler kümesi ile bu belirtilerin özellikleri ve yoğunluğu açısından diğerlerinden farklıdır; ----.
questions.optionA: therefore, people with autism can have mental or emotional problems that co-exist with their autism
questions.optionB: thus, general descriptions of autistic behaviour and characteristics do not apply equally to every child
questions.optionC: moreover, some higher-functioning people with autistic disorders may appear overly formal and polite
questions.optionD: however, they may attempt to engage with adults and peers in a way which strikes others as odd
questions.optionE: therefore, children with autistic disorders may differ markedly from other children in many ways
questions.explanation: "thus" sonuç bağlacı, otizmli her çocuğun belirtilerinin birbirinden farklı olması öncülünden, genel tanımların her çocuğa aynı şekilde uymayacağı mantıksal sonucuna bağlanır.

questions.promptText: ----, a large body of testimony from contemporary writers identifies him as the inventor of printing by movable type in the Western world.
questions.turkishTranslation: ----, dönemin yazarlarından gelen pek çok kanıt onu Batı dünyasında hareketli harflerle baskının mucidi olarak tanımlamaktadır.
questions.optionA: Since the first major work to originate from Gutenberg's workshop was the forty-two-line Bible
questions.optionB: Although no piece of printing in existence bears the name of Johannes Gutenberg
questions.optionC: While Gutenberg was already experimenting with some kind of printing technique
questions.optionD: Even though Gutenberg's printing technique allowed the rapid duplication of texts
questions.optionE: Given that Gutenberg's parents made it impossible for him to be part of the patrician class
questions.explanation: "Although" doğrudan kanıt (baskı üzerinde Gutenberg'in adının bulunmaması) ile, çağdaş yazarların tanıklıklarının onu mucit olarak göstermesi arasında zıtlık kurar; B bu kanıt eksikliğini verir.

questions.promptText: Elephant society revolves around stable herds of females who raise calves cooperatively under the leadership of an elderly, experienced matriarch ----.
questions.turkishTranslation: Fil toplumu, yaşlı ve deneyimli bir dişi liderin önderliğinde yavruları ortaklaşa yetiştiren kararlı dişi sürüleri etrafında döner ----.
questions.optionA: just as little is known about the social lives of males after they leave their natal herd in adolescence
questions.optionB: although new research suggests that mature males, too, play a crucial educational role
questions.optionC: because elder elephants of both sexes can pass their knowledge onto youngsters
questions.optionD: even though mature bulls are attractive targets for hunters and enjoy less legal protection than females
questions.optionE: while scientists say that elephants have huge ranges and therefore they are really difficult to track
questions.explanation: "although" fil toplumunun dişi sürüler etrafında şekillendiği genel bilgiyle, yeni araştırmaların yetişkin erkeklerin de eğitici rol oynadığını göstermesi arasında zıtlık kurar; B bu yeni bulguyu verir.

questions.promptText: Although freeways were originally meant to alleviate traffic in big cities, ----.
questions.turkishTranslation: Otoyollar başlangıçta büyük şehirlerdeki trafiği hafifletmek amacıyla tasarlanmış olsa da, ----.
questions.optionA: they actually increased traffic levels, by encouraging the use of the automobile over public transportation
questions.optionB: access to the city by automobile allowed people to arrive at their destinations faster
questions.optionC: the expected volume of traffic must be estimated, with minimum and maximum levels established
questions.optionD: they are constructed according to strict guidelines regarding their design and structure
questions.optionE: their construction requires vast amounts of money and considerable workforce
questions.explanation: "Although" otobanların trafiği azaltma amacıyla, A seçeneğindeki gerçekte trafiği artırmış olmaları arasında doğrudan bir zıtlık (amaç vs. sonuç) kurar.

questions.promptText: Despite the popularity of low-carb diets in society, ----.
questions.turkishTranslation: Toplumda düşük karbonhidratlı diyetlerin popülerliğine rağmen, ----.
questions.optionA: an excessive intake of carbohydrates has been shown to lead to an elevated risk of heart disease
questions.optionB: most food science experts recommend that adult humans get the majority of their energy from carbohydrates
questions.optionC: complex carbohydrates, such as starch and glycogen, are used by living creatures for energy storage
questions.optionD: research indicates that carbohydrates are not essential for chemical signalling processes that assist functioning of cells
questions.optionE: it is a fact that carbohydrates eaten today may be deposited in the body as fat tomorrow
questions.explanation: "Despite" düşük karbonhidratlı diyetlerin popülerliğiyle, uzmanların enerjinin büyük kısmının karbonhidrattan alınmasını önermesi arasında zıtlık kurar; B bu uzman görüşünü verir.

questions.promptText: While the most common cause of colour blindness is genetic, ----.
questions.turkishTranslation: Renk körlüğünün en yaygın nedeni genetik olmakla birlikte, ----.
questions.optionA: it can also result from diseases such as diabetes, Alzheimer’s, and Parkinson’s
questions.optionB: it does not allow people to differentiate between various shades of certain colours
questions.optionC: there is actually a very limited range of colours the eye can pick up correctly
questions.optionD: eyes with various defective cells can confuse three colours – red, green, and blue
questions.optionE: its inheritance is through female carriers passing the gene to 50% of their sons
questions.explanation: 'While' en yaygın nedenin genetik olduğunu belirtir; 'also' ile boşluk bu nedene ek bir başka neden (hastalıklar) sunarak zıtlık/ekleme ilişkisini tamamlar.

questions.promptText: While there has been much research into the biological basis of schizophrenia, ----.
questions.turkishTranslation: Şizofreninin biyolojik temeli üzerine çok sayıda araştırma yapılmış olmasına rağmen, ----.
questions.optionA: its classical symptoms include delusions and hallucinations
questions.optionB: for many people with it, brain development takes a different pathway from an early stage
questions.optionC: symptoms start with subtle changes in childhood thinking and behaviour
questions.optionD: the disorder still remains one of the true mysteries of medicine
questions.optionE: there are a number of blood tests for definitively diagnosing schizophrenia
questions.explanation: 'While' çok araştırma yapıldığını belirtir; 'still remains a mystery' bu araştırmalara rağmen hastalığın çözülememiş olmasıyla beklenen zıtlığı kurar.

questions.promptText: ----, there has been a rise in home cooking thanks to simpler recipes and celebrity chefs.
questions.turkishTranslation: ----, daha basit tarifler ve ünlü şefler sayesinde evde yemek yapma eğiliminde bir artış yaşanmıştır.
questions.optionA: Even if there are now better-quality ingredients available to all of us than ever before
questions.optionB: Despite the fact that our reliance on restaurants, and take-out food has increased
questions.optionC: Given that dining out at fancy restaurants makes some people feel wealthier
questions.optionD: As professional cooking is all about preparing the tastiest food for the customers
questions.optionE: If replicating restaurant food without restaurant equipment is possible
questions.explanation: 'Despite the fact that' restoran/paket yemeğe bağımlılığın arttığını söyler, ama cümle ev yemeğinin artışından bahseder; bu da beklenenin tersi bir sonuçla zıtlık kurar.

questions.promptText: Hare and rabbit offspring are very different with hares being born fully furred and with open eyes ----.
questions.turkishTranslation: Yaban tavşanı ve ev tavşanı yavruları birbirinden çok farklıdır; yaban tavşanları tüylü ve açık gözlerle doğar ----.
questions.optionA: while the arctic rabbits’ coat changes colour for camouflaging in the winter to blend in with the snow
questions.optionB: even if rabbits do not grow fur until over a week after they are born and rely on their parents’ care
questions.optionC: whereas rabbits are born unprotected against cold and cannot see for around ten days
questions.optionD: even though rabbits live in social groups for safety in numbers rather than living alone like hares do
questions.optionE: since rabbits are herbivores and feast almost exclusively on weeds
questions.explanation: 'Whereas' tavşanların yavaş yunus (açık göz, kürklü) olan yabani tavşanlarla doğrudan karşıtlığını kurar; tavşanlar görmeden ve korumasız doğduğu için zıtlık tamamlanır.

questions.promptText: The first sea traders stayed close to the coast so they knew where they were ----.
questions.turkishTranslation: Denizlerdeki ilk tüccarlar, nerede olduklarını bilmek için kıyıya yakın seyrederlerdi ----.
questions.optionA: now that the sea transport industry looks to have slowly overcome its challenges with the latest advances in technology
questions.optionB: even though sea transportation of people and goods has been necessary for society for thousands of years
questions.optionC: despite road transport playing an important economic role in all developed countries and causing considerable carbon emission
questions.optionD: whereas in modern times, powerful engines and satellite navigation greatly reduce the risks of long sea voyages
questions.optionE: even if the fuel prices have increased and fuel saving in sea transport systems has attracted serious attention
questions.explanation: 'Whereas' eski denizcilerin kıyıya yakın kalma zorunluluğunu, modern dönemdeki motor/navigasyon teknolojisinin riskleri azaltmasıyla karşıtlık kurarak açıklar.

questions.promptText: Smaller, sub-toxic exposures to chemicals might be referred to as contamination; ----
questions.turkishTranslation: Kimyasallara karşı daha küçük, zehirlilik sınırının altındaki maruziyetlere kirlenme denilebilir; ----
questions.optionA: therefore, with the advances in technology, new industrial uses for existing chemicals are found
questions.optionB: on the other hand, larger ones are considered to represent poisoning or pollution
questions.optionC: nonetheless, many poisonous chemicals are present naturally in the environment
questions.optionD: as a result, humans are responsible for many of the toxic chemicals
questions.optionE: instead, the topic of contamination has caused disagreements among chemists
questions.explanation: 'On the other hand' küçük maruziyetler (kontaminasyon) ile büyük maruziyetler (zehirlenme/kirlenme) arasında doğrudan karşılaştırmalı zıtlık kurar.

questions.promptText: Because patients who suffer from anorexia nervosa do not usually admit that they have a disorder, ----.
questions.turkishTranslation: Anoreksiya nervozadan muzdarip hastalar genellikle bir bozuklukları olduğunu kabul etmedikleri için, ----.
questions.optionA: normalisation of eating patterns and the development of a normal body image can be attained after the treatment
questions.optionB: the sensations of hunger and satiety are impaired, with the result that these two states become confused
questions.optionC: it becomes extremely difficult to engage them into the care process before they collapse
questions.optionD: the treatment involves refeeding, which is critical for all patients whose weight is 85 percent or less of that expected
questions.optionE: some anorexics come from achievement-oriented families that promote physical fitness and dieting
questions.explanation: 'Because' hastaların bozukluğu kabul etmediğini belirtir; bu sebep doğrudan tedaviye başlamadaki zorluğu (sonuç) açıklar.

questions.promptText: Today scientists are able to target and manipulate certain genes of many organisms ranging from bacteria to humans, ----.
questions.turkishTranslation: Bugün bilim insanları, bakterilerden insanlara kadar birçok canlının belirli genlerini hedefleyip üzerinde değişiklik yapabilmektedir, ----.
questions.optionA: for example, the genetic code allows an organism to translate the genetic information found in its chromosomes into usable protein
questions.optionB: on the contrary, the discovery around 1950 that genes are made of DNA led to a virtual explosion of scientific advances in the analysis of the genetic material
questions.optionC: similarly, bacteria with genetic additions such as resistance against antibiotics often have competitive advantages over others
questions.optionD: in other words, classic genetics is the study of hereditary laws of individuals passing genes to their descendants
questions.optionE: nonetheless, it poses risks and naturally raises fundamental questions about the ethics of genetic manipulation
questions.explanation: 'Nonetheless' gen manipülasyonundaki bu yetenek ile buna rağmen ortaya çıkan riskler/etik sorular arasında beklenen zıtlığı kurar.

questions.promptText: Amphibians (frogs, salamanders, and etc.) have been around so long that they watched the dinosaurs come and go; ----.
questions.turkishTranslation: Amfibiler (kurbağalar, semenderler vb.) dinozorların gelip geçişine şahit olacak kadar uzun süredir var olmuştur; ----.
questions.optionA: thus, studies on the effects of atrazine on amphibians have led one US group to take legal action to have atrazine banned
questions.optionB: in other words, today more than a third of the world’s amphibian species are threatened with extinction, which presents a big problem
questions.optionC: however, for the last three decades, their populations around the world have been declining dramatically
questions.optionD: on the contrary, many of them are breeding and thousands of tadpoles swim in the ditches, ponds, and streams
questions.optionE: accordingly, human activities are changing the global climate and are leading to the extinctions of large numbers of species of amphibians
questions.explanation: 'However' amfibiyenlerin dinozorlardan bu yana uzun süre var olmasıyla, son otuz yılda nüfuslarının dramatik düşüşü arasında beklenmedik zıtlığı kurar.

questions.promptText: Children try to construct meaning through their world knowledge, which is partial and limited, ----.
questions.turkishTranslation: Çocuklar, kısmi ve sınırlı olan dünya bilgileri aracılığıyla anlam kurmaya çalışırlar, ----.
questions.optionA: as classroom activities that are meaningful and entertaining can create different kinds of opportunities for learning
questions.optionB: whereas they take part in classroom activities with their own understandings of the purposes and expectations of their teachers
questions.optionC: so teachers need to examine classroom activities from the children’s point of view to assess whether they will understand what to do
questions.optionD: although engaging them in classroom activities seems to require less effort when compared to adult learners
questions.optionE: unless classroom activities are designed to improve children’s cognitive skills and ignite their imagination
questions.explanation: Çocukların bilgisinin sınırlı olması, 'so' ile mantıksal sonucuna bağlanır: öğretmenlerin etkinlikleri çocuk bakış açısından değerlendirmesi gerekir.

questions.promptText: Malaria still keeps being the largest cause of childhood illness for those under five in sub- Saharan Africa ----.
questions.turkishTranslation: Sıtma, Sahra altı Afrika'da beş yaşından küçük çocuklar arasında hâlâ en büyük çocukluk dönemi hastalığı nedenidir ----.
questions.optionA: although those who live in areas where malaria is epidemic can contract the disease repeatedly, never fully recovering between bouts of acute infection
questions.optionB: once the malaria parasite enters the host’s bloodstream, where it travels to the liver and develops for a short period before re-entering the bloodstream
questions.optionC: given that developing an effective vaccine has proved to be a serious challenge as the malaria parasite is far more complex than a virus or bacteria
questions.optionD: seeing that it is introduced into other parts of the world by refugees, military personnel, and travellers returning from malarial areas
questions.optionE: while malaria is characterised by recurrent symptoms of chills and fever, which may last for between a week and a month
questions.explanation: 'Given that' sıtmanın hâlâ en büyük çocuk ölüm nedeni olmasının sebebini açıklar: etkili aşı geliştirmenin parazitin karmaşıklığı nedeniyle zor olması.

questions.promptText: Naturalists have long puzzled over the function of the bird toucan’s large bill, ----.
questions.turkishTranslation: Doğa bilimciler, tukan kuşunun büyük gagasının işlevi konusunda uzun süredir kafa yormaktadır, ----.
questions.optionA: instead it wanders through the forests and adjacent clearings in small family groups
questions.optionB: so it is thought to play a significant role in attracting a mate
questions.optionC: thus they are characterised by their bill with a downcurved tip and sharp edges
questions.optionD: but observers suggest that its bill is a weapon used to defend the nest cavity
questions.optionE: as the bill enables the bird to pluck berries from the tips of branches
questions.explanation: 'As' (çünkü) gagasının işlevine dair bilim insanlarının kafasını karıştıran soruya pratik bir cevap sunar: dalların ucundaki meyveleri koparmaya yarar.

questions.promptText: Once a reading disorder has been diagnosed in a child, ----.
questions.turkishTranslation: Bir çocukta okuma bozukluğu tespit edildiğinde, ----.
questions.optionA: mental retardation or cultural and language differences may be mistaken for reading disorders and may complicate a diagnosis
questions.optionB: it is caused by neurological abnormalities that trigger impairments in the regions of the brain that control visual and language processing
questions.optionC: he or she must be carefully guided to adopt strategies that will improve the recognition of letters and words
questions.optionD: it typically occurs in combination with writing disorders, which are characterised by problems with spelling, punctuation, and grammar
questions.optionE: children from families with a history of a reading disorder are more likely to develop disorders themselves
questions.explanation: 'Once' tanı konulduktan sonraki aşamayı belirtir; mantıksal olarak sıradaki adım tanıdan sonra çocuğun yönlendirilmesi/tedavisidir.

questions.promptText: While cemeteries have enabled archaeologists to study everything from early medieval social structure to production and trade, ----.
questions.turkishTranslation: Mezarlıklar, arkeologların erken Orta Çağ toplumsal yapısından üretim ve ticarete kadar her şeyi incelemesine olanak sağlamış olsa da, ----.
questions.optionA: research on early medieval habitation, by contrast, is still in its relative infancy
questions.optionB: they were found with regularity in western Europe from the time of the Industrial Revolution
questions.optionC: they often contained a large variety of artefacts in addition to skeletal remains
questions.optionD: archaeologists have relied on evidence from these sites to create a better understanding of the division of labour
questions.optionE: gender-linked roles were dynamic and repeatedly negotiated within specific communities
questions.explanation: 'While... by contrast' mezarlıklar sayesinde çok şey öğrenilmesiyle, yerleşim yerleri araştırmasının henüz emekleme aşamasında olması arasında zıtlık kurar.

questions.promptText: The field of artificial intelligence has been dominated by computer scientists; ----.
questions.turkishTranslation: Yapay zeka alanına bilgisayar bilimciler hâkim olmuştur; ----.
questions.optionA: for example, recent applications of artificial intelligence technology include machines that assist doctors in diagnoses and the ones that can spot credit card fraud
questions.optionB: as a result, creating a machine to think by simulating human thought highlights the complexities and subtleties of the human mind
questions.optionC: in other words, despite significant advances in computer technology and information processing, many people are sceptical that a machine will ever replicate human cognition
questions.optionD: even so, it has important implications for psychologists as well because in creating machines that replicate human thought, much is learned about the processes the human brain uses to think
questions.optionE: on the contrary, the ability of some artificial intelligence programs to solve problems based on facts rather than on a predetermined series of steps is what most closely resembles thinking
questions.explanation: 'For example' bilgisayar bilimcilerinin alana hakimiyetini, bu hakimiyetin ürettiği somut uygulama örnekleriyle (hastalara yardım eden makineler vb.) destekler.

questions.promptText: Universal biological markers such as emergence of speech and onset of puberty do not emerge at a uniform age for everyone ----.
questions.turkishTranslation: Konuşmanın ortaya çıkışı ve ergenliğin başlaması gibi evrensel biyolojik göstergeler herkeste aynı yaşta ortaya çıkmaz ----.
questions.optionA: as long as puberty is a critical milestone in many societies, celebrated often by rites of passage, such as schooling, work and criminal responsibility
questions.optionB: since they are dependent on genetic variations in different racial and ethnic groups and on environmental factors such as nutrition or socialisation practices
questions.optionC: although the movement of individual children through childhood is not followed with much precision and age is treated as an approximate benchmark
questions.optionD: while each society has its own ways of dividing the life span and of treating the individuals who fall into different age groups
questions.optionE: even if the age at which adolescence is supposed to end and adulthood starts varies substantially depending on socio-economic and cultural factors
questions.explanation: 'Since' biyolojik işaretçilerin herkeste aynı yaşta ortaya çıkmamasının nedenini verir: genetik ve çevresel faktörlere bağlı olmaları.

questions.promptText: While ancient astronomers noticed some spots on the Sun's surface, ----.
questions.turkishTranslation: Eski çağ astronomları Güneş'in yüzeyindeki bazı lekeleri fark etmiş olsalar da, ----.
questions.optionA: Christoph Scheiner’s suggestion that sunspots were satellites of the Sun was later dismissed
questions.optionB: they tried to devise sophisticated tools to observe celestial bodies
questions.optionC: it was not until the invention of the telescope that scientists could look systematically at the Sun
questions.optionD: they advanced an interest in sunspots, developing a number of theories
questions.optionE: Galileo Galilei debated on the nature of sunspots through letters to Marc Welser
questions.explanation: 'While' antik astronomların lekeleri fark ettiğini belirtir; buna karşılık sistematik gözlemin ancak teleskop icadıyla mümkün olduğu zıtlığı kurulur.

questions.promptText: ----, scientists are turning to this area as a potential screening target for early signs of Alzheimer’s, an incurable neurodegenerative disease.
questions.turkishTranslation: ----, bilim insanları bu alana, tedavisi olmayan nörodejeneratif bir hastalık olan Alzheimer'ın erken belirtileri için potansiyel bir tarama hedefi olarak yönelmektedir.
questions.optionA: Even if the still-growing brain branches off to form the retina during an embryo’s development
questions.optionB: As evidence builds that changes in the brain can manifest in the retina
questions.optionC: Although retina is closely related to brain tissue and can be examined through the pupil
questions.optionD: While the retina, composed of several layers of neurons, is a part of the nervous system
questions.optionE: Unless retinal screenings are used to mark the onset of symptoms for neurological disorders
questions.explanation: 'As' (arttıkça/çünkü) retinadaki değişikliklerin beyindeki değişiklikleri yansıttığına dair artan kanıtı, bilim insanlarının retinayı tarama hedefi yapmasının nedeni olarak sunar.

questions.promptText: While 'literacy' is basically thought of as the ability to read and to write, ----.
questions.turkishTranslation: 'Okuryazarlık' temelde okuma ve yazma becerisi olarak düşünülse de, ----.
questions.optionA: the central role of language in the emergence of key literacy-related skills raises important questions about the nature of literacy development
questions.optionB: children’s literacy development is a product of both early experiences, such as parent-child book reading, and later experiences, such as reading instruction at school
questions.optionC: those in poor countries must be supported to acquire literacy so that they can take an active part in the development of their countries
questions.optionD: the definition of literacy has been expanded, involving the use of various sources such as audio- visual materials and computers
questions.optionE: most students and their parents are still not aware of the importance of developing digital literacy to improve school success
questions.explanation: 'While' okuryazarlığın temel (okuma-yazma) tanımını verir; boşluk bu dar tanımın genişletilmiş hâliyle zıtlık/karşılaştırma kurar.

questions.promptText: ----, although it did not have as much impact in the scientific arena as the development of still photography, which had wrought a revolution in astronomy.
questions.turkishTranslation: ----, astronomide devrim yaratan sabit fotoğrafçılığın gelişimi kadar bilim dünyasında etki yaratmamış olsa da.
questions.optionA: Astronomy was regarded as a way of recording the outer world through our senses and observation capability
questions.optionB: Cinema takes advantage of optical illusions of continuous movement from a series of still images
questions.optionC: The advent of cinema in the 1890s was a highly significant advancement in recording technology
questions.optionD: Cinematography was limited in the accurate representation of mundane life until the late 1920s
questions.optionE: The employment of cinema as general reportage was always secondary to its role as a medium of entertainment
questions.explanation: Ana cümle sinemanın önemli bir kayıt teknolojisi gelişimi olduğunu söyler; 'although' bu önemle, fotoğrafçılık kadar bilimsel etki yaratmaması arasında zıtlık kurar.

questions.promptText: ----, but it took centuries to grow into the ferocious force that would strike fear across the then known world.
questions.turkishTranslation: ----, ancak o zamanlar bilinen dünyada korku salacak zalim bir güce dönüşmesi yüzyıllar sürdü.
questions.optionA: The myth involving the Roman way of living endured long after the last soldiers of the empire died
questions.optionB: The Roman army is remembered today as the mightiest fighting machine that the ancient world had ever seen
questions.optionC: Soldiers in the Roman army continued to erect forts and collect taxes even at times of war
questions.optionD: Rome’s army was raised on an as-need basis from the citizenry based on property qualifications
questions.optionE: Roman soldiers were more literate than the general population and were more likely to leave records of their lives
questions.explanation: 'But' bugün efsanevi bir güç olarak hatırlanan Roma ordusunun bu haline ancak yüzyıllar içinde ulaştığını belirterek bugünkü ün ile tarihsel süreç arasında zıtlık kurar.

questions.promptText: Although no single security technology can make a system completely safe, ----.
questions.turkishTranslation: Hiçbir güvenlik teknolojisi tek başına bir sistemi tamamen güvenli hale getiremese de, ----.
questions.optionA: using them together with recognised security practices provides many impediments to intruders and malware
questions.optionB: the cyber security community has failed to respond to the growing threat with new technologies and guidelines
questions.optionC: companies whose computer systems get attacked are more often held liable for the harm it causes their customers
questions.optionD: software developers now take security more seriously than they did at the turn of the century
questions.optionE: many see security not as the top priority but as a trade-off with other objectives, such as functionality and performance
questions.explanation: 'Although' tek bir teknolojinin yetersizliğini kabul eder; boşluk bunların birlikte kullanılmasının yine de koruma sağladığını belirterek beklenen zıtlığı tamamlar.

questions.promptText: Although cholera, one of the most devastating of all human diseases, is endemic in some areas of the world, ----.
questions.turkishTranslation: İnsanlığın en yıkıcı hastalıklarından biri olan kolera, dünyanın bazı bölgelerinde endemik olsa da, ----.
questions.optionA: treatment strategies have been devised that have cut the fatality rate of cholera to 1% in the last decades
questions.optionB: severe diarrhoea and vomiting that characterise this disease can lead to death due to dehydration
questions.optionC: it is usually associated with massive migrations of people, such as those occurring during war or famine
questions.optionD: people recovering from it continue to shed the organism in their faeces for weeks to months after the initial infection
questions.optionE: one of the ways to prevent cholera is to identify and treat cholera carriers in areas where it is endemic
questions.explanation: 'Although' kolerayı bazı bölgelerde endemik (doğal yerleşik) olarak tanımlar; boşluk bunun aksine, hastalığın insan göçleriyle de bağlantılı olduğunu söyleyerek zıtlık kurar.

questions.promptText: It is easy to get distracted halfway through a newspaper article, ----.
questions.turkishTranslation: Bir gazete makalesinin ortasında dikkatin dağılması kolaydır, ----.
questions.optionA: but reading long novels is not a challenge when the narrative structure is easier to follow
questions.optionB: since news agencies deliberately choose thought- provoking articles that hook their readers
questions.optionC: even though the newspapers write about dull and uninteresting topics such as trivial disputes between individuals
questions.optionD: so that narratives can be a universal form of communication and much has been written about them
questions.optionE: while a best-selling and critically-acclaimed novel can only deal with the society’s dilemmas
questions.explanation: 'But' gazete makalesinde dikkatin kolay dağılmasıyla, kurgusu daha kolay takip edilen uzun romanlarda bu sorunun yaşanmaması arasında zıtlık kurar.

questions.promptText: ----, there are also great environmental benefits such as advances in productivity that has been brought about by chemical use.
questions.turkishTranslation: ----, kimyasal kullanımının getirdiği verimlilik artışları gibi büyük çevresel faydalar da vardır.
questions.optionA: Before the direct importance of climate’s effect on agriculture has been a key focus of studies on the potential agriculture policies
questions.optionB: Because considerable uncertainty remains about the global influence of chemical use on agricultural production
questions.optionC: While it is easy to see some of the environmental harm caused by modern chemical-intensive agricultural production
questions.optionD: As long as human activities negatively affect the fertility of soil and agricultural production
questions.optionE: Given that agriculture is thought to be a principal source of water pollution, especially in developed nations
questions.explanation: 'While... also' kimyasal tarımın çevresel zararını kabul ederken ana cümledeki 'also' ile büyük faydaların da var olduğunu ekleyip zıtlık/denge kurar.

questions.promptText: Small, blood-sucking bugs native to the American continent seriously afflict thousands of people every year with various diseases, ----.
questions.turkishTranslation: Amerika kıtasına özgü küçük, kan emici böcekler her yıl binlerce insanı çeşitli hastalıklarla ciddi şekilde etkilemektedir, ----.
questions.optionA: but none of the infections carried by them have garnered as much attention as the widely-known Zika virus
questions.optionB: even if they are thought to be predominantly impactful in those who have been already struggling with serious health issues
questions.optionC: so the rates are overwhelmingly high among immigrants, many of whom live in poverty with limited access to health care
questions.optionD: though public health professionals need more studies to be done to eradicate the threats posed by these bugs
questions.optionE: yet the damage they bring to the health-care systems in South America harms a great number of people
questions.explanation: 'But' bu böceklerin taşıdığı birçok hastalık olmasına karşın, hiçbirinin Zika virüsü kadar dikkat çekmediğini belirterek zıtlık kurar.

questions.promptText: Although there is an increasing number of articles and books about insomnia, ----
questions.turkishTranslation: Uykusuzlukla ilgili makale ve kitap sayısı giderek artsa da ----
questions.optionA: the subject has become quite popular in recent years
questions.optionB: sleep disorders seem to be common among teenagers
questions.optionC: there is considerable evidence that it can actually be treated
questions.optionD: few are based on scientific research and clinical practice
questions.optionE: most writers suggest effective solutions for the problem
questions.explanation: 'Although' uykusuzluk hakkında çok yayın olduğunu belirtir; boşluk bu çokluğa karşın yayınların büyük kısmının bilimsel temelden yoksun olduğunu söyleyerek zıtlık kurar.

questions.promptText: Even if infants are well cared for during the first two years of life, ----.
questions.turkishTranslation: Bebekler hayatlarının ilk iki yılında iyi bakılmış olsa bile, ----.
questions.optionA: the process is fundamental to create the bond between child and parent
questions.optionB: they can develop the ability to calm themselves and foster alternative behaviours
questions.optionC: their future development will be hampered if they do not continue getting the nurturing they need
questions.optionD: parents can use hundreds of opportunities that arise daily to help them develop
questions.optionE: they begin to babble and produce sounds like ba, da, and ma
questions.explanation: 'Even if' ilk iki yılda iyi bakım verilse de, bu bakımın sürmemesi hâlinde gelişimin olumsuz etkileneceğini belirterek beklenen koşullu zıtlığı tamamlar.

questions.promptText: Travelling around the Great Lakes in the United States requires a lot of planning ----
questions.turkishTranslation: Amerika Birleşik Devletleri'ndeki Büyük Göller bölgesinde gezmek çok fazla planlama gerektirir ----

questions.promptText: Because much of the information about Greek fashions has come from marble statues, ----

questions.promptText: -----, we are more likely to select healthy food options.

questions.optionB: Until extensive menus require large quantities of raw materials and storage space
questions.optionC: As fast food chains could be located in almost any type of building

questions.promptText: A bite from a rabid animal does not guarantee that one will get rabies ----
questions.turkishTranslation: Kuduz bir hayvanın ısırması, kişinin kuduz olacağını garanti etmez ----

questions.optionC: as the transmission of rabies is almost always through the bite of an infected animal

questions.optionA: but the virus used in vaccines keeps evolving to become harmful again

questions.promptText: ----, not everyone perceives the same events as equally stressful or experience them in the same way
questions.turkishTranslation: ----, herkes aynı olayları eşit derecede stresli algılamaz veya onları aynı şekilde deneyimlemez

questions.promptText: Even if the two-minute commute from bed to desk can be counted as one of the benefits of working from home, ----.
questions.turkishTranslation: Yataktan masaya iki dakikalık yolculuk, evden çalışmanın avantajlarından biri olarak sayılabilse de, ----.

questions.optionB: it can also turn out to be a perilous sign of blurred boundaries between professional and personal lives
questions.optionC: it is possible to communicate effectively with colleagues and managers from anywhere using technology

questions.optionE: it is often because you are spending too much time on activities that are not in line with your personal values
questions.explanation: 'Even if... also' iki dakikalık mesafenin bir fayda olarak görülmesini kabul edip, bunun aynı zamanda sınırların bulanıklaşmasının riskli bir işareti olabileceğini ekleyerek zıtlık kurar.

questions.promptText: Just as archaeologists are contesting shipwreck hunters over historical disasters, ----.
questions.turkishTranslation: Arkeologlar, tarihi felaketler konusunda batık avcılarıyla çekişirken, ----.

questions.optionC: marine biologists are trying to compete with the mining industry in preserving nature’s secret treasure troves

questions.optionE: the huge technological leap into deep waters in the past century enabled scientists to explore more minerals
questions.explanation: 'Just as' arkeologlar ile batık avcıları arasındaki çekişmeye, deniz biyologları ile madencilik sektörü arasındaki benzer çekişmeyi paralel bir örnek olarak bağlar.

questions.promptText: While human populations have expanded since the Industrial Revolution, with technologies becoming increasingly capable of pervasive impacts, ----.
questions.turkishTranslation: Sanayi Devrimi'nden bu yana insan nüfusu artarken ve teknolojiler yaygın etkiler yaratma konusunda giderek daha yetenekli hale gelirken, ----.
questions.optionA: biodiversity is no longer a rallying point for conservationists who are concerned about the rapid simplification of natural systems
questions.optionB: actions that protect biodiversity reduce soil erosion and promote scientific interest
questions.optionC: biodiversity can be naturally thought of as the result of a magnificent and eternal process of change
questions.optionD: biodiversity is in decline, as a result of human activities, especially the fragmentation of forests and other wild habitats
questions.optionE: protection of habitat is mainly treated by the recovery of some endangered and threatened species
questions.explanation: 'While' insan nüfusunun ve etkili teknolojilerin artışını anlatır; bu artış, biyoçeşitliliğin insan faaliyetleri nedeniyle azalmasıyla mantıksal sonuç ilişkisi kurar.

questions.promptText: Although platypus populations were formerly reduced by hunting for the fur trade, ----.
questions.turkishTranslation: Daha önce kürk ticareti için avlanma nedeniyle platipus nüfusu azalmış olsa da, ----.
questions.optionA: serious concern is raised because the platypus range follows densely populated regions
questions.optionB: effective government conservation efforts have resulted in a successful comeback
questions.optionC: the species' habitat may be disrupted by dams, irrigation projects, or pollution
questions.optionD: they spend most of their time on land and have a few physical traits that can be modified
questions.optionE: some other less aquatic species can also be fairly common in suitable habitats
questions.explanation: 'Although' geçmişteki avlanmayla nüfusun azaldığını belirtir; boşluk bu geçmiş olumsuzluğa karşın etkili korumayla başarılı bir geri dönüş yaşandığını söyleyerek zıtlık kurar.

questions.promptText: Since dam technology has advanced with increasing knowledge of design principles and a better understanding of foundation and material properties, ----.
questions.turkishTranslation: Baraj teknolojisi, tasarım ilkeleri konusunda artan bilgi ve temel ile malzeme özelliklerinin daha iyi anlaşılmasıyla gelişmiş olduğundan, ----.
questions.optionA: there is no longer a question regarding safety of construction and operational processes
questions.optionB: it is estimated that about 150,000 dams around the world are still sustainable
questions.optionC: national governments have already become involved in providing standardised regulations
questions.optionD: the major issue is to monitor deterioration as the structures and equipment get older
questions.optionE: dam failures cause loss of life and property damage in downstream reaches
questions.explanation: 'Since' baraj teknolojisindeki gelişmeyi sebep olarak verir; bu gelişme, artık inşaat/işletme güvenliğinin sorgulanmaması sonucuna mantıksal olarak bağlanır.

questions.promptText: ----, traditional ways of adorning the body changed as Native Americans had more contact with European traders and White settlers.
questions.turkishTranslation: ----, Yerli Amerikalıların Avrupalı tüccarlar ve beyaz yerleşimcilerle daha fazla temas kurmasıyla birlikte, vücudu süsleme konusundaki geleneksel yöntemler değişti.
questions.optionA: As much as Native Americans wore jewellery and other body decorations to honour spirits or to indicate social status
questions.optionB: Although Native American body decoration practices and jewellery designs were practiced for many hundreds of years
questions.optionC: Because the Native American jewellery had social and religious significance, as well as decorative qualities
questions.optionD: Providing Native Americans across the North American continent adorned their bodies in a variety of different ways
questions.optionE: Given that Native American body decoration was very important to the religious and social life of tribal members
questions.explanation: 'Although' uzun yüzyıllar süren geleneksel uygulamayı belirtir; ana cümle bu süreklilikle, Avrupalılarla temas sonucu değişimin yaşanması arasında zıtlık kurar.

questions.promptText: ----, Telmatobius culeus has the slowest metabolism of all frogs, to lessen its demand for oxygen.
questions.turkishTranslation: ----, Telmatobius culeus, oksijen ihtiyacını azaltmak için bütün kurbağalar arasında en yavaş metabolizmaya sahiptir.
questions.optionA: As though its baggy skin contains vast amounts of capillaries that enable the amphibian to absorb oxygen from the water
questions.optionB: Supposing that it has had to adapt its movement, metabolism, and even its skin

questions.optionD: As long as it bobs up and down to create ripples that let oxygen-rich water flow over its skin

questions.explanation: 'While' en büyük sucul kurbağa olma özelliğini belirtir; bu büyüklükle, oksijen talebini azaltmak için en yavaş metabolizmaya sahip olması arasında zıtlık/karşıtlık kurulur.

questions.promptText: Many people go through a time period, in their early teens, when they are obsessed with that ‘choose your own adventure in life’ slogan, ----.
questions.turkishTranslation: Birçok insan ergenliğin ilk yıllarında, 'hayatında kendi maceranı seç' sloganına kapılıp gittiği bir dönemden geçer, ----.
questions.optionA: but the older they get, the more they learn that the world refuses to let them control it

questions.optionE: however, the more they try to find certainty through science, the more it evades their curiosity
questions.explanation: 'But' gençlikteki 'hayatını kendin seç' saplantısıyla, büyüdükçe dünyanın kontrole izin vermediğini öğrenmeleri arasında zıtlık kurar.

questions.promptText: Child-care providers are simply viewed as supporters of employed parents, ----.
questions.turkishTranslation: Çocuk bakıcıları sadece çalışan ebeveynlerin destekçisi olarak görülür, ----.

questions.optionB: so children whose caregivers are encouraging can easily gain social skills like developing empathy for others

questions.optionE: while parents do not generally need to monitor caregivers remotely if they are close relatives of the child
questions.explanation: 'But... also' bakıcıların sadece ebeveyn destekçisi olarak görülen sınırlı rolüne, aslında erken öğrenme ve bilişsel gelişime katkı sağladıklarını ekleyerek zıtlık kurar.

questions.promptText: Some parts of Sicily offer the sense of isolation to those who want to cut themselves off from the world ----.
questions.turkishTranslation: Sicilya'nın bazı bölgeleri, kendilerini dünyadan koparmak isteyenlere bir yalnızlık hissi sunar ----.

questions.explanation: 'Because' Sicilya'nın bazı kesimlerinin tecrit hissi vermesinin sebebini verir: bu yerlerin Akdeniz'in çok yukarısındaki kayalık burunlarda yer alması.

questions.promptText: Although they are usually worn for practicalreasons, so that the wearer can keep track of the time, ----
questions.turkishTranslation: Saatler genellikle pratik nedenlerle, yani kullanıcının zamanı takip edebilmesi için takılsa da, ----

questions.explanation: 'Although... also' saatlerin pratik amaçla giyilmesini kabul edip, aynı zamanda zenginlik/statü/stil ifade eden bir mücevher olduklarını ekleyerek zıtlık kurar.

questions.promptText: While most ancient societies were governed by kings,----.
questions.turkishTranslation: Antik toplumların çoğu krallar tarafından yönetilirken,----.

questions.promptText: When long-tailed ducks venture beneath the waves in search of fish, ---.

questions.promptText: Early civilizations were well aware that plants were attacked by diseases; ----.
questions.turkishTranslation: Eski uygarlıklar, bitkilerin hastalıklardan etkilendiğinin oldukça farkındaydı; ----.

questions.promptText: ----, there is nowhere in the universe where it will disappear altogether.

questions.promptText: Even though many people still remain unconvinced that global warming is a real phenomenon, ----.
questions.turkishTranslation: Birçok insan küresel ısınmanın gerçek bir olgu olduğuna hâlâ ikna olmamış olsa da, ----.

questions.optionB: the consequences for our lives are still uncertain and absolutely way too complex
questions.optionC: it is reassuring that everything around us changed simply through chance

questions.promptText: ---- if doing so helps them to pursue the goals that are aligned with their values.
questions.turkishTranslation: ---- eğer bunu yapmak, değerleriyle uyumlu hedefleri gerçekleştirmelerine yardımcı oluyorsa.
questions.optionA: Meditative practices may not be beneficial for everyone with depression
questions.optionB: The study of how people react to mind-altering practices like meditation is still in its infancy
questions.optionC: Psychologically flexible people show willingness to welcome uncomfortable states
questions.optionD: Psychologists call the ability to walk through bad experiences ‘resilience’
questions.optionE: Those with lower than average signs of post- traumatic stress disorder have higher scores of psychological flexibility
questions.explanation: 'If' koşulu, rahatsız edici durumlara açık olmanın (psikolojik esneklik), bu durumun değerlerle uyumlu hedeflere yardımcı olması koşuluna bağlanmasıyla örtüşür.

questions.promptText: Because of the health hazards that lead poses for humans and other animals, ----.
