questions.optionE: today, physiologists understand that the human body is able to excrete about two milligrams of lead efficiently each day
questions.explanation: 'Because of' kurşunun sağlık tehlikesini sebep olarak verir; bu sebep tetraetil kurşunun yakıt katkı maddesi olarak yasaklanması sonucuna mantıksal olarak bağlanır.

questions.promptText: Unless rich countries help poor ones adopt greener technologies, ----.
questions.turkishTranslation: Zengin ülkeler yoksul ülkelere daha çevreci teknolojiler benimsemelerinde yardımcı olmazsa, ----.
questions.optionA: some projects that lie in the heart of environmental protection could come to a halt
questions.optionB: it is in their interest to help establish a sustainable energy future for all the world’s inhabitants
questions.optionC: they barely depend on fossil fuels, which are damaging to both human health and the environment
questions.optionD: every country, regardless of their economic power, is expected to contribute to global welfare
questions.optionE: energy consumption in the rich world would always dwarf that in poor countries
questions.explanation: 'Unless' koşulu, zengin ülkelerin yardım etmemesi durumunda çevre koruma projelerinin durma riskini mantıksal sonuç olarak verir.

questions.promptText: Provided that loan programmes are properly designed, effectively managed and a high rate of recovery is achieved, ----.
questions.turkishTranslation: Kredi programları düzgün tasarlanır, etkili bir şekilde yönetilir ve yüksek bir geri ödeme oranı elde edilirse, ----.

questions.promptText: Many researchers and clinicians observe that the traditional Chinese medicine can hope to function in full partnership with Western medicine ----.
questions.turkishTranslation: Birçok araştırmacı ve klinisyen, geleneksel Çin tıbbının Batı tıbbıyla tam bir ortaklık içinde işlev görebileceğini gözlemlemektedir ----.

questions.promptText: Today, the sanitary landfill is the major method of disposing waste materials in North America and other developed countries, ----.
questions.turkishTranslation: Bugün sağlıklı atık sahaları, Kuzey Amerika ve diğer gelişmiş ülkelerde atık malzemelerin bertaraf edilmesinde başlıca yöntemdir, ----.
questions.optionA: while some older landfills are being mined for useful products such as methane gas that can be used as fuel

questions.optionE: though considerable efforts are being made to find alternative methods, such as recycling and composting
questions.explanation: 'While' sıhhi çöp depolamanın günümüzdeki ana yöntem olduğunu belirtir; eski depolama alanlarının artık metan gazı için işlenmesi bu güncel durumla karşıtlık/zıt örnek oluşturur.

questions.promptText: The popularity of many flat-faced dog breeds such as French bulldogs has risen dramatically in recent years ----.
questions.turkishTranslation: Fransız bulldogu gibi düz yüzlü köpek ırklarının popülerliği son yıllarda büyük ölçüde artmıştır ----.
questions.optionA: because French bulldogs have short faces that can make breathing difficult
questions.optionB: even though French bulldogs are not seen as dangerous as other dog breeds
questions.optionC: although there are regular assertions that they are prone to many health issues
questions.optionD: given that there is limited reliable evidence on the wider general health of flat-faced dogs
questions.optionE: while it enables ongoing identification of breed health-related priorities
questions.explanation: 'Although' bu ırkların sağlık sorunlarına eğilimli olduğu iddialarını kabul eder; ana cümle buna karşın popülerliklerinin dramatik şekilde artmasıyla zıtlık kurar.

questions.promptText: The pleasures of chocolate, tea, and coffee drinking have been known to humans for centuries, ----.
questions.turkishTranslation: Çikolata, çay ve kahve içmenin verdiği zevkler insanlar tarafından yüzyıllardır bilinmektedir, ----.
questions.optionA: while caffeine is a member of the alkaloid family, a group of compounds obtained from numerous plants
questions.optionB: because full characterisation of caffeine’s molecular structure was completed by a German chemist
questions.optionC: since researchers identified the active agents in tea and chocolate and gave them various names
questions.optionD: but the isolation of caffeine from these everyday treats was accomplished only in the early 1800s
questions.optionE: although caffeine is one of the most widely used central nervous system stimulants worldwide
questions.explanation: 'But' çikolata/çay/kahvenin yüzyıllardır bilinen keyfiyle, kafeinin bu içeceklerden ancak 1800'lerin başında izole edilebilmesi arasında zaman bakımından zıtlık kurar.

questions.promptText: Individuals with social phobia fear being humiliated while doing something in public, ----.
questions.turkishTranslation: Sosyal fobisi olan bireyler, herkesin önünde bir şey yaparken küçük düşmekten korkar, ----.
questions.optionA: because those who receive treatment can completely overcome their fears in social life

questions.optionE: whereas it generally develops after puberty and peaks after the age of 30
questions.explanation: 'And therefore' halk önünde rezil olma korkusunu sebep olarak verir; bu sebep mantıksal sonucuyla, bu tür durumlardan kaçınma davranışına bağlanır.

questions.promptText: Unless they regard the material they are taught as worth learning, ----.
questions.turkishTranslation: Öğretilen materyali öğrenmeye değer görmedikleri sürece, ----.
questions.optionA: classrooms are rather intricate microcosms where students spend a great deal of their life and find out who they are
questions.optionB: time pressure under which most teachers work prevents them from meeting their students' needs
questions.optionC: students will not be motivated to take part in classroom activities and interact with each other
questions.optionD: subjects related to students' everyday experiences stimulate their interest and induce them to study with vigour
questions.optionE: making learning process more enjoyable and interesting encourages further student involvement
questions.explanation: 'Unless' koşulu, öğrenciler öğretilen materyali öğrenmeye değer görmedikçe sınıf etkinliklerine motive olmayacakları mantıksal sonucuna bağlanır.

questions.promptText: While chronic stress can bring on significant mental health issues along with other problems, ----.
questions.turkishTranslation: Kronik stres, diğer sorunların yanı sıra önemli ruh sağlığı sorunlarına da yol açabilse de, ----.
questions.optionA: stress can be prevented from becoming a problem in the first place by following a healthy diet
questions.optionB: employees should be trained in stress management before they experience stress-related problems in the workplace
questions.optionC: work-related stress often leads to depression or anxiety, causing a high rate of loss in employee productivity
questions.optionD: short-term stress, such as working to meet an imminent deadline, can be beneficial
questions.optionE: stress may trigger headaches, digestive disorders and cardiovascular disease
questions.explanation: Bağlaç "While" iki yan cümle arasında karşıtlık kurar: kronik stres zihinsel sorunlara yol açarken, kısa süreli stresin (örn. yaklaşan bir teslim tarihi) aksine faydalı olabileceği belirtilmelidir; bu karşıtlığı sağlayan tek seçenek D'dir.

questions.promptText: ---, advertisers will quickly be discouraged from attempting to use such approaches because of public disapproval.
questions.turkishTranslation: ---, reklamcılar kamuoyunun onaylamaması nedeniyle bu tür yaklaşımları kullanmaktan kısa sürede caydırılacaktır.
questions.optionA: Even if a successful return on investment is forthcoming from subliminal advertisements
questions.optionB: Because companies desire high profits from their investments, including advertising
questions.optionC: As a result of a rapid growth in online advertising in many sectors
questions.optionD: Whereas there is no credible evidence that subliminal advertising will yield benefits
questions.optionE: Although proponents provide no rationale to guide the use of subliminal adverts
questions.explanation: "Even if" ile kurulan boşluk, reklamcıların halkın tepkisi yüzünden caydırılacağı sonucuyla karşıtlık oluşturmalıdır: yatırımdan başarılı bir geri dönüş (ROI) gelse bile kamu onaylamazlığı nedeniyle bu yöntemden vazgeçilir; bu mantığı veren tek seçenek A'dır.

questions.promptText: In addition to the obvious detrimental effects of sport injury on physical functioning, ----.
questions.turkishTranslation: Spor sakatlanmalarının fiziksel işleyiş üzerindeki belirgin zararlı etkilerine ek olarak, ----.
questions.optionA: athletes are mainly able to focus primary attention on their rehabilitation programs
questions.optionB: any injury that occurs during a sports event is called a sport injury
questions.optionC: most negative emotions tend to dissipate over the first month following the injuries
questions.optionD: sport injury can have a harmful effect on various aspects of psychological functioning
questions.optionE: injury appears to spur athletes’ use of coping strategies and seeking support from others
questions.explanation: "In addition to" ile başlayan cümle, fiziksel etkilere EK olarak başka bir olumsuz etkiden bahsetmeyi gerektirir; spor sakatlığının psikolojik işlevsellik üzerindeki zararlı etkisini belirten D, bu ekleme mantığına uyar.

questions.promptText: Even though Egyptian medicine went into decline about 1200 BCE, ----.
questions.turkishTranslation: Mısır tıbbı MÖ 1200 civarında gerilemeye başlamış olsa da, ----.
questions.optionA: ancient Egyptians began to develop the world's first sophisticated medical practice sometime before 2000 BCE
questions.optionB: its reputation as the best in the ancient world continued for many centuries to follow
questions.optionC: there is evidence suggesting that most treatments for disease were based on trial-and-error experimentation
questions.optionD: it is assumed that Egyptian priests gained their understanding of the human body by preparing mummies
questions.optionE: religion in ancient Egypt played an integral role in the treatment of all kinds of diseases
questions.explanation: "Even though" ile kurulan karşıtlıkta, Mısır tıbbı MÖ 1200'de çökmüş OLSA DA, ününün yüzyıllarca sürdüğü belirtilmelidir; bu zıtlığı sağlayan B doğru cevaptır.

questions.promptText: Visiting buildings gives you the best chance to experience architecture in relation to the world of light, sound, setting, and people, ----.
questions.turkishTranslation: Binaları ziyaret etmek, mimariyi ışık, ses, mekân ve insanlar dünyasıyla ilişkili olarak deneyimlemek için size en iyi fırsatı verir, ----.
questions.optionA: though visits to buildings are enjoyable and provide a chance to see how architecture changes the real world
questions.optionB: but to understand the underlying architecture of buildings you need to study them through drawing
questions.optionC: as many books on architecture and the history of architecture are rich in various kinds of visuals
questions.optionD: and there is no readily-available prescription on how to become a good architect
questions.optionE: even so, architecture is about changing the world, making it better, more comfortable, and more beautiful Visiting buildings gives you the best chance to experience architecture in relation to the world of light, sound, setting, and people, ----. (2021 NİSAN YDS)
questions.explanation: Cümledeki "but" bağlacı, binaları ziyaret etmenin verdiği deneyimle mimariyi KAVRAMAK için gereken farklı bir yöntem (çizim yoluyla inceleme) arasında karşıtlık kurar; bu zıtlığı veren B doğru cevaptır.

questions.promptText: Consumers are less likely to adopt innovations that demand radical behaviour changes ----.
questions.turkishTranslation: Tüketicilerin radikal davranış değişiklikleri gerektiren yenilikleri benimseme olasılığı daha düşüktür ----.
questions.optionA: as certain habits are more likely to be rapidly adopted
questions.optionB: unless they are convinced that the effort will be worthwhile
questions.optionC: although innovators represent about 2.5% of the population
questions.optionD: whereas marketers are interested in identifying producers’ needs
questions.optionE: since they tend to have more favourable attitudes toward taking risks
questions.explanation: "Unless" (meğerki/olmadıkça) bağlacı bir koşul kurar: tüketiciler radikal davranış değişikliği gerektiren yenilikleri, çabanın değeceğine ikna OLMADIKÇA benimsemeye daha az isteklidir; bu koşulu veren B doğru cevaptır.

questions.promptText: Irish people fear that international populations of Ireland’s cities threaten the native culture, ----.
questions.turkishTranslation: İrlandalılar, İrlanda şehirlerindeki uluslararası nüfusun yerli kültürü tehdit ettiğinden korkmaktadır, ----.
questions.optionA: as cultural education is mandatory for all permanent residents of Ireland
questions.optionB: yet Irish artists are encouraged to focus on traditional rather than modern art projects
questions.optionC: and thus foreigners seeking good job opportunities stay in big cities like Dublin and Belfast
questions.optionD: but the survival of traditional music, dance, and storytelling proves otherwise
questions.optionE: so Ireland's popularity as a tourist destination is ensured by its profound cultural heritage
questions.explanation: "But" bağlacı, yerli kültürün tehdit altında olduğu korkusuyla, geleneksel müzik/dans/hikaye anlatıcılığının hayatta kalmasının bu korkuyu YALANLAMASI arasında karşıtlık kurar; bu zıtlığı veren D doğru cevaptır.

questions.promptText: Esperanto, an artificial language invented in 1887 for international use, is considered by many to be one of the easiest languages to master ----.
questions.turkishTranslation: 1887'de uluslararası kullanım için icat edilen yapay bir dil olan Esperanto, çoğu kişi tarafından öğrenilmesi en kolay dillerden biri olarak kabul edilir ----.
questions.optionA: but UNESCO has affirmed the value of establishing it as a universal second language
questions.optionB: although the Polish linguist Ludwik L. Zamenhof hoped to bring all of the peoples of the Earth together by inventing such a language
questions.optionC: in order that the number of speakers can reach several million in varying levels of proficiency
questions.optionD: because it is known for its simplicity, beauty and flexibility as a medium for translation
questions.optionE: even if Esperantists believe in the positive outcomes in learning and teaching this language
questions.explanation: Esperanto'nun öğrenilmesi en kolay dillerden biri sayılmasının NEDENİ istenmektedir; "because" ile basitlik, güzellik ve çeviri kolaylığı gibi özelliklerini veren D, bu sebep-sonuç ilişkisini kurar.

questions.promptText: Although classical music is claimed to improve children’s intelligence, ----.
questions.turkishTranslation: Klasik müziğin çocukların zekâsını geliştirdiği öne sürülse de, ----.
questions.optionA: there may not be a correlation between intelligence and appreciation for classical music
questions.optionB: parents’ time is probably better spent exposing their children to classical music right after birth
questions.optionC: playing classical music to babies will inevitably make them grow up smarter
questions.optionD: parents may not overlook the possibility to enhance the cognitive ability of their children
questions.optionE: it is usually enough for parents to rely on classical music alone for the cognitive development of their children
questions.explanation: "Although" ile kurulan karşıtlıkta, klasik müziğin zekayı geliştirdiği İDDİA EDİLSE DE, bu iddiayı zayıflatan bir bilgi gelmelidir; zeka ile klasik müzik beğenisi arasında korelasyon olmayabileceğini söyleyen A, bu zıtlığı sağlar.

questions.promptText: When a prey animal or an unsuspecting human approaches, ----
questions.turkishTranslation: Bir av hayvanı veya habersiz bir insan yaklaştığında, ----
questions.optionA: the box jellyfish is regarded as one of the most venomous creatures in the ocean
questions.optionB: the box jellyfish is found in coastal waters of northern Australia
questions.optionC: the cells of the box jellyfish are triggered instantly and they deliver toxins
questions.optionD: the box jellyfish gets its name from its cube- shaped bell
questions.optionE: the venom of the box jellyfish is fatal to humans, affecting the nervous system
questions.explanation: "When" ile kurulan zaman cümlesinde, bir av hayvanı veya habersiz bir insan yaklaştığı ANDA gerçekleşen tepki belirtilmelidir; hücrelerin anında tetiklenip toksin salgılamasını anlatan C, bu zamansal nedensellik ilişkisine uyar.

questions.promptText: Because people usually do not want to participate in surveys, ----
questions.turkishTranslation: İnsanlar genellikle anketlere katılmak istemediğinden, ----

questions.optionE: surveys have long remained a popular tool for collecting information from people
questions.explanation: "Because" ile verilen sebep (insanların anketlere katılmak istememesi), bir SONUÇ gerektirir; araştırmacıların katılımcılara motive edici ödül sunmasını anlatan A, bu sebep-sonuç ilişkisini tamamlar.

questions.promptText: As the climate warmed and the human population grew and spread geographically, ----
questions.turkishTranslation: İklim ısınıp insan nüfusu büyüyüp coğrafi olarak yayıldıkça, ----
questions.optionA: walking upright on two feet has long been considered to be a human characteristic
questions.optionB: humans began to develop the first ‘civilised’ human settlements

questions.optionD: we do not know when exactly humans started making clothes and footwear
questions.optionE: the task of understanding the nature of early human life has been very difficult
questions.explanation: "As" ile verilen sebep (iklimin ısınması ve nüfusun yayılması), bir SONUÇ gerektirir; insanların sıcak ve kuru kalma yolları bulma gereksinimini anlatan C, bu nedensellik ilişkisine uyar.

questions.promptText: The rearing of livestock has brought great wealth to Uruguay, ----
questions.turkishTranslation: Hayvancılık, Uruguay'a büyük bir zenginlik kazandırmıştır, ----
questions.optionA: even if it has been described as a giant city with many farms
questions.optionB: although recently tourism and banking have also contributed to the national income

questions.explanation: Boşluktan önceki cümle hayvancılığın Uruguay'a getirdiği zenginlikten bahseder; "although" ile son zamanlarda turizm ve bankacılığın da ulusal gelire katkı sağladığını ekleyen B, zenginlik kaynağına dair bir KARŞITLIK/ek bilgi sunar.

questions.promptText: ----, the American Marshall Plan helped to jump-start the Austrian economy, laying the foundation for the country’s present-day prosperity.
questions.turkishTranslation: ----, Amerikan Marshall Planı, Avusturya ekonomisinin yeniden başlamasına yardımcı olarak ülkenin günümüzdeki refahının temelini atmıştır.
questions.optionA: Regardless of the capital city Vienna’s humble origins as a Roman army camp on the Danube River

questions.optionC: Because no one thought at the time that Austria would receive international aid following World War II
questions.optionD: Although until recently its government has been dominated by two political parties

questions.explanation: "Despite" ile kurulan karşıtlıkta, II. Dünya Savaşı ve kıtlıkların verdiği hasara RAĞMEN, Marshall Planı'nın Avusturya ekonomisini canlandırdığı belirtilmelidir; bu zıtlığı veren E doğru cevaptır.

questions.promptText: Obese people usually eat more than those of average weight, ----.
questions.turkishTranslation: Obez kişiler genellikle ortalama ağırlıktaki kişilerden daha fazla yemek yer, ----.
questions.optionA: but research shows that gaining weight can be almost as difficult as losing it
questions.optionB: thus, obese people may eat less food but get more calories

questions.promptText: The underlying cause of dyslexia, which is a learning disability, is not known, -----
questions.turkishTranslation: Bir öğrenme bozukluğu olan disleksinin altında yatan neden bilinmemektedir, -----

questions.promptText: The rearing of livestock has brought great wealth to Uruguay, ----
questions.turkishTranslation: Hayvancılık, Uruguay'a büyük bir zenginlik kazandırmıştır, ----
questions.optionA: even if it has been described as a giant city with many farms
questions.optionB: although recently tourism and banking have also contributed to the national income
questions.optionC: as the capital city of Montevideo is also the largest city with a population of around 1.5 million

questions.optionE: as long as the population of livestock outnumbers the human population
questions.explanation: 138. soruyla aynı cümle: "although" ile hayvancılığın getirdiği zenginliğe KARŞITLIK/ek olarak turizm ve bankacılığın da gelire katkıda bulunduğunu belirten B doğru cevaptır.

questions.promptText: Because there has been growing public awareness regarding cultural and ethnic differences around the world, ----.
questions.turkishTranslation: Dünya çapında kültürel ve etnik farklılıklara yönelik kamuoyu farkındalığı giderek arttığından, ----.
questions.optionA: tourists, who search for unfamiliar environments and cultures, also search for familiar facilities available for them
questions.optionB: the true cultural heritage of the host society maintains its integrity by keeping tourists on the other side of the curtain
questions.optionC: culture is seen as a dynamic living concept and changes continually in order to embrace the needs of present-day society

questions.optionE: there has been increasing demand for tourism products that offer cultural authenticity rather than standard concepts
questions.explanation: "Because" ile verilen sebep (kültürel farklılıklara yönelik artan kamuoyu farkındalığı), bir SONUÇ gerektirir; standart değil kültürel özgünlük sunan turizm ürünlerine talebin artmasını anlatan E, bu nedensellik ilişkisine uyar.

questions.promptText: Although all archaeologists agree that keeping careful records of an excavation is essential to good practice, ----.
questions.turkishTranslation: Tüm arkeologlar bir kazının dikkatli kayıtlarını tutmanın iyi bir uygulama için gerekli olduğu konusunda hemfikir olsa da, ----.
questions.optionA: there is a close relationship between their interpretation and that of archaeological museums
questions.optionB: they are concerned with the activities of people and nature that create evidence of a cultural past
questions.optionC: artefacts, sculptures and drawings found in caves help them learn about early humans
questions.optionD: many mapping techniques developed for use on land have also been adapted for underwater archaeology
questions.optionE: there is no certain consensus on what exactly constitutes archaeological data
questions.explanation: "Although" ile kurulan karşıtlıkta, tüm arkeologlar kayıt tutmanın gerekliliği konusunda hemfikir OLSA DA, arkeolojik veriyi neyin oluşturduğu konusunda fikir birliği olmadığı belirtilmelidir; bu zıtlığı sağlayan E doğru cevaptır.

questions.promptText: As more people suffer from insecure attachment styles in their relationships with others, ----.
questions.turkishTranslation: Diğer insanlarla ilişkilerinde güvensiz bağlanma stillerinden muzdarip olan insanların sayısı arttıkça, ----.

questions.optionB: seeing possessions as an extension of themselves starts to decrease
questions.optionC: the needs for security are more complex than just the basics for physical survival
questions.optionD: possessions do not make them feel secure by substituting for the loved ones
questions.optionE: the behaviour of seeking emotional comfort from material objects is likely to rise
questions.explanation: "As" ile verilen sebep (güvensiz bağlanma stillerinin artması), bir SONUÇ gerektirir; maddi nesnelerden duygusal rahatlık arama davranışının artacağını belirten E, bu nedensellik ilişkisine uyar.

questions.promptText: While mainstream cultural artefacts (films, books, fashion, etc.) produced specifically for and about girls have been popular for more than two centuries, ----.
questions.turkishTranslation: Özellikle kızlar için ve kızlar hakkında üretilen ana akım kültürel ürünler (filmler, kitaplar, moda vb.) iki yüzyıldan fazla bir süredir popüler olsa da, ----.
questions.optionA: academic research on girls and their complex relationship with girl culture is still fairly new to the communication discipline
questions.optionB: early research on this topic tended to focus on girls as audiences and as vulnerable to the effects of mass culture
questions.optionC: communication scholars examining girl culture today have been greatly influenced by girls’ or girlhood studies
questions.optionD: a new area that is mainly interested in how girls actively negotiate and even resist these cultural artefacts is needed
questions.optionE: many researchers have examined the Internet as a space fostering girls' self-expression and community building
questions.explanation: "While" bağlacı, kızlara yönelik kültürel ürünlerin iki yüzyıldan fazla popüler OLMASIYLA, akademik araştırmanın bu alanda HALA yeni olması arasında karşıtlık kurar; bu zıtlığı veren A doğru cevaptır.

questions.promptText: When bacteria sense that their numbers have reached a critical threshold, ----.
questions.turkishTranslation: Bakteriler sayılarının kritik bir eşiğe ulaştığını algıladıklarında, ----.
questions.optionA: the drugs that will interrupt this process are still being researched
questions.optionB: they switch on the production of substances that attack their human host
questions.optionC: we are not still sure about how to prevent them from increasing in number
questions.optionD: some are mostly resistant to many common antibiotics, making an infection hard to treat
questions.optionE: plant products have been reported to have no significant effect on their growth
questions.explanation: "When" ile kurulan zaman cümlesinde, bakterilerin sayılarının kritik eşiğe ulaştığını FARK ETTİĞİ ANDA gerçekleşen tepki belirtilmelidir; konak organizmaya zarar veren maddelerin üretilmeye başlamasını anlatan B, bu nedensellik ilişkisine uyar.

questions.promptText: It may be a long time before scientists can confirm that biological life exists in places other than Earth, ----.
questions.turkishTranslation: Bilim adamlarının biyolojik yaşamın Dünya dışındaki yerlerde de var olduğunu doğrulayabilmesi uzun zaman alabilir, ----.
questions.optionA: but recent discovery of tiny life forms in some extreme conditions and inhospitable environments has raised hopes
questions.optionB: as scientists have long known that amino acids and nucleotides, the main ingredients for building proteins and DNA, can be found in meteors and comets
questions.optionC: while it takes a lot of intellectual effort on the part of ordinary people to understand the dynamics of life in outer space
questions.optionD: though professional associations informing the public about microbial life in space have not been very successful
questions.optionE: so the discovery of the bacteria in Antarctica, which live by extracting nutrition from the air, indicates that life can thrive without complex organic material
questions.explanation: "But" bağlacı, Dünya dışında yaşamın kanıtlanmasının uzun zaman alacağı bilgisiyle, umut veren yeni keşifler arasında karşıtlık kurar; aşırı koşullarda yaşam formları bulunmasının umutları artırdığını belirten A, bu zıtlığı sağlar.

questions.promptText: ----, few realise that moderate to vigorous physical activity done regularly completely changes our bodies from the inside out.
questions.turkishTranslation: ----, çok az kişi düzenli olarak yapılan orta ile yüksek yoğunluklu fiziksel aktivitenin vücudumuzu baştan sona tamamen değiştirdiğinin farkındadır.
questions.optionA: Since regular movement prevents certain cancers and lowers the risk of diabetes
questions.optionB: As scientists have developed methods for measuring intensity of aerobic exercise
questions.optionC: While most people inherently know that they are supposed to leave sedentary habits
questions.optionD: Although many are not aware that being physically active expands lung capacity
questions.optionE: Unless prolonged sitting denies people some of the health advantages of regular exercise
questions.explanation: "Since" ile verilen sebep (düzenli hareketin bazı kanserleri önlemesi ve diyabet riskini düşürmesi), insanların bu bilinen faydaların ötesindeki daha kapsamlı etkiyi FARK ETMEDİĞİ sonucuna zemin hazırlar; bu ilişkiyi veren A doğru cevaptır.

questions.promptText: ----, food shortages will be inevitable, leading to mass starvation and unrest.
questions.turkishTranslation: ----, gıda kıtlığı kaçınılmaz olacak ve kitlesel aç kalmaya ve huzursuzluğa yol açacaktır.
questions.optionA: Because many governments are committed to avoiding a reduction in farming subsidies and financial speculation nowadays
questions.optionB: Unless a solution to the dramatic increase in world population and the demand for food is found
questions.optionC: While the growing population in some parts of the world increasingly demand a more varied diet
questions.optionD: Since the increase in oil prices has appeared in many developing nations in the last several decades
questions.optionE: If worldwide drought, which affects wide territories, is seen as the consequence of climate change
questions.explanation: "Unless" (eğer ... olmazsa) bağlacı bir koşul kurar: nüfus artışı ve gıda talebine çözüm BULUNMADIKÇA, gıda kıtlığının kaçınılmaz olacağı belirtilmelidir; bu koşulu veren B doğru cevaptır.

questions.promptText: The consequences of eating disorders need to be taken seriously, ----.
questions.turkishTranslation: Yeme bozukluklarının sonuçları ciddiye alınmalıdır, ----.
questions.optionA: whereas there is growing interest in and worry about their potential risks and treatment methods
questions.optionB: while evidence is now emerging that they occur in a wide range of socioeconomic groups
questions.optionC: given that they might increase one's risk of developing conditions such as high blood pressure and diabetes
questions.optionD: though clinical depression and anxiety disorders have been reported to commonly co-occur with eating disorders
questions.optionE: so patients who engage in binge eating, which is highly associated with obesity, suffer from numerous health issues
questions.explanation: "Given that" (göz önüne alındığında) ile verilen sebep, yeme bozukluklarının ciddiye alınması GEREKTİĞİ sonucunu haklı çıkarmalıdır; yüksek tansiyon ve diyabet gibi durumların riskini artırabileceğini belirten C, bu sebep-sonuç ilişkisine uyar.

questions.promptText: Most classic research indicates that it is extremely difficult to identify boys from girls on behavioural grounds when children are under two years of age ----.
questions.turkishTranslation: Klasik araştırmaların çoğu, çocuklar iki yaşın altındayken onları davranışsal açıdan erkek ya da kız olarak ayırt etmenin son derece zor olduğunu göstermektedir ----.
questions.optionA: unless there are some external cultural indicators of gender such as clothing
questions.optionB: so that the impact of gender in young children's lives could be examined in great detail
questions.optionC: if young children know about gender and acquire gendered ways of being and thinking from an early age
questions.optionD: given that preschool children often actively maintain gender stereotypes in their own behaviours and that of their peers
questions.optionE: because there has recently been a focus on how boys and girls play with the toys they choose
questions.explanation: "Unless" (meğerki) bağlacı bir istisna/koşul kurar: davranışsal olarak kız-erkek ayrımı yapmak zor OLMAKLA BİRLİKTE, kıyafet gibi dışsal kültürel göstergeler olmadıkça bu zorluk geçerlidir; bu istisnayı veren A doğru cevaptır.

questions.promptText: Although the Roman Empire finally fell in 476, ----
questions.turkishTranslation: Roma İmparatorluğu 476'da sonunda çökmüş olsa da, ----
questions.optionA: the Romans claimed that Romulus founded the city in 753 BCE
questions.optionB: citizenship was given to every free male inhabitant of the empire
questions.optionC: leading generals wanted more opportunities to win wealth and glory
questions.optionD: its influence is still felt in the calendars and alphabets still in use today
questions.optionE: the Roman Republic had a complex political and administrative system
questions.explanation: "Although" ile kurulan karşıtlıkta, Roma İmparatorluğu 476'da ÇÖKMÜŞ OLSA DA, etkisinin bugün hala takvim ve alfabelerde hissedildiği belirtilmelidir; bu zıtlığı sağlayan D doğru cevaptır.

questions.promptText: Although the prices of the first gramophone recordings were incredibly high, ----
questions.turkishTranslation: İlk gramofon kayıtlarının fiyatları inanılmaz derecede yüksek olsa da, ----
questions.optionA: the recording industry was slow to move into the world of music
questions.optionB: each went on to sell more than a million copies
questions.optionC: they were all written by the prolific composers of the era
questions.optionD: the business was shaped by technological advances
questions.optionE: musicians lacked electronic amplification for recording
questions.explanation: "Although" ile kurulan karşıtlıkta, ilk gramofon kayıtlarının fiyatı inanılmaz yüksek OLSA DA, her birinin milyonlarca kopya satmayı başardığı belirtilmelidir; bu zıtlığı sağlayan B doğru cevaptır.

questions.promptText: Although the early principles behind the calculation of an IQ score still hold, ----
questions.turkishTranslation: IQ puanının hesaplanmasının ardındaki erken dönem ilkeleri hâlâ geçerliliğini korusa da, ----
questions.optionA: IQ scores are determined in a different manner today and are known as deviation IQ scores
questions.optionB: some people consistently score higher than others on IQ tests
questions.optionC: psychologists have traditionally been interested in creating intelligence tests
questions.optionD: two-thirds of all individuals fall within 15 IQ points above or below the average score of 100
questions.optionE: IQ scores have proven very beneficial in identifying students in need of special attention
questions.explanation: "Although" ile kurulan karşıtlıkta, IQ hesaplamasının ilkeleri hala geçerli OLSA DA, bugün farklı bir yöntemle (sapma IQ puanları) hesaplandığı belirtilmelidir; bu zıtlığı sağlayan A doğru cevaptır.

questions.promptText: Because of increased migration, geographical proximity, and/or political conquest and colonisation, ----.
questions.turkishTranslation: Artan göç, coğrafi yakınlık ve/veya siyasi fetih ve sömürgeleştirme nedeniyle, ----.
questions.optionA: bilingualism is often defined as proficiency in both languages
questions.optionB: in many countries, monolingualism represents the natural or norm of language development
questions.optionC: multilingual education programs aim for proficiency in more than two languages
questions.optionD: bilingual education is the instruction that uses two languages as the media of instruction
questions.optionE: few countries today can claim monolingualism as the norm
questions.explanation: "Because of" ile verilen sebep (göç, coğrafi yakınlık, siyasi fetih/sömürgecilik), bir SONUÇ gerektirir; bugün tek dilliliği norm olarak kabul edebilecek çok az ülke kaldığını belirten E, bu nedensellik ilişkisine uyar.

questions.promptText: Washing and cooking take care of most harmful microbes on or in food, ----.
questions.turkishTranslation: Yıkama ve pişirme, yiyecek üzerindeki veya içindeki zararlı mikropların çoğunu halleder, ----.
questions.optionA: while others are usually killed by stomach acid or blocked by the immune system
questions.optionB: although the toxic kinds, such as hepatitis virus, are more commonly known
questions.optionC: because nowadays people are not taking food safety very seriously
questions.optionD: as most of the current produce seems especially worrisome to many people
questions.optionE: after transported fruits and vegetables are loaded with fatal chemicals
questions.explanation: "While" bağlacı, yıkama/pişirmenin yok ettiği zararlı mikroplarla, DİĞERLERİNİN mide asidi veya bağışıklık sistemi tarafından yok edilmesi arasında tamamlayıcı bir karşılaştırma kurar; bu ilişkiyi veren A doğru cevaptır.

questions.promptText: ---- , many countries began to adopt agricultural practices that are more oriented towards conservation and sustainability.
questions.turkishTranslation: ----, birçok ülke koruma ve sürdürülebilirliğe daha yönelik tarım uygulamalarını benimsemeye başladı.
questions.optionA: As long as they had a wide range of natural and economic resources at hand
questions.optionB: Although they were on the brink of starvation due to famine and drought
questions.optionC: As they came to realise the importance of addressing environmental issues
questions.optionD: Whether they confronted considerable technological challenges in urban areas
questions.optionE: Until they found solutions to the extinction of species in their natural habitats
questions.explanation: "As" ile verilen sebep, ülkelerin çevresel sorunları ele almanın ÖNEMİNİ FARK ETMESİ ile koruma/sürdürülebilirlik odaklı tarım uygulamalarını benimsemeleri arasında nedensellik kurar; bu ilişkiyi veren C doğru cevaptır.

questions.promptText: While being physically attractive seems to be a basic requirement for Internet celebrities, ----
questions.turkishTranslation: Fiziksel olarak çekici olmak internet ünlüleri için temel bir gereklilik gibi görünse de, ----
questions.optionA: they closely monitor the trends in youth culture that place special emphasis on beauty
questions.optionB: their popularity will decline if they cannot create fresh ideas and engage in successful projects
questions.optionC: they are chased by investors hoping to expand their business by associating their products with famous people
questions.optionD: they are often characterised as having the ideal beauty standards
questions.optionE: they earn huge amounts of money thanks to their collaboration with famous brands
questions.explanation: "While" bağlacı, fiziksel çekiciliğin temel bir gereklilik OLMASIYLA, yeni fikirler üretemezlerse popülerliklerinin düşeceği gerçeği arasında karşıtlık kurar; bu zıtlığı veren B doğru cevaptır.

questions.promptText: Although Egypt was subject to outside influences, ----
questions.turkishTranslation: Mısır dış etkilere açık olsa da, ----
questions.optionA: the Egyptians settled on the fertile strip of land created by the Nile in the North African desert
questions.optionB: the role played by the pharaoh, that of a link between men and gods, decreased with the disintegration of power
questions.optionC: the principal characteristics of its culture remained homogenous throughout the course of its long history
questions.optionD: the pyramids were built to testify to the pronounced hierarchical character of the Egyptian society
questions.optionE: Ramses III, who undertook extensive social and administrative reforms, was forced to defend it against fierce attacks
questions.explanation: "Although" ile kurulan karşıtlıkta, Mısır dış etkilere AÇIK OLSA DA, kültürünün temel özelliklerinin tarih boyunca değişmeden kaldığı belirtilmelidir; bu zıtlığı sağlayan C doğru cevaptır.

questions.promptText: Owing to the increasing numbers of individuals and families who could no longer afford to purchase housing, ----
questions.turkishTranslation: Artık ev satın almaya gücü yetmeyen birey ve aile sayısının artması nedeniyle, ----
questions.optionA: the American nation’s supply of low-cost rental housing was shrinking
questions.optionB: an ample boom was observed in the investment of housing construction
questions.optionC: after the mid-1970s, the poor became more numerous and they got poorer
questions.optionD: new homelessness became so visible in the early 1980s in the US
questions.optionE: there was a lack of federal commitment to the production of public housing
questions.explanation: "Owing to" (nedeniyle) ile verilen sebep (konut alamayan kişi ve ailelerin artması), bir SONUÇ gerektirir; düşük maliyetli kiralık konut arzının azalmasını anlatan A, bu nedensellik ilişkisine uyar.

questions.promptText: ---- unless it is integrated into a meaningful curricular and instructional framework.
questions.turkishTranslation: ---- anlamlı bir müfredat ve öğretim çerçevesine entegre edilmediği sürece.
questions.optionA: Technology is regarded to have the potential to improve education
questions.optionB: Technology should be viewed as one tool among many
questions.optionC: The use of technology requires teachers to confront their beliefs about learning
questions.optionD: It is believed that technology has little influence on education
questions.optionE: Technology provides an excellent platform for learning environments
questions.explanation: "Unless" (anlamlı bir müfredat çerçevesine entegre edilmedikçe) koşulu, teknolojinin eğitime etkisinin SINIRLI kalacağı sonucuyla uyumlu olmalıdır; teknolojinin eğitime az etkisi olduğuna inanıldığını belirten D, bu koşulla örtüşür.

questions.promptText: Even though the new methods of Samuel Christian Hahnemann — the creator and developer of the treatment called homeopathy — were initially met with ridicule, ----
questions.turkishTranslation: Homeopati adı verilen tedavinin yaratıcısı ve geliştiricisi Samuel Christian Hahnemann'ın yeni yöntemleri başlangıçta alayla karşılansa da, ----
questions.optionA: the system was based on the idea that substances producing symptoms of sickness in healthy people would have a curative effect
questions.optionB: homeopathic remedies used in holistic treatments were often a fraction of the cost of conventional drugs
questions.optionC: by the time of his death, they were accepted over the world as a result of the great success he had with his new cure
questions.optionD: he was disturbed by the medical system of his time, believing that its cures were crude and some of its strong drugs did more harm than good to patients
questions.optionE: with the formation of the American Medical Association, which restricted alternative practices, homeopathy declined for half a century
questions.explanation: "Even though" ile kurulan karşıtlıkta, Hahnemann'ın yöntemleri başlangıçta alay konusu OLSA DA, ölümüne kadar dünya çapında kabul gördüğü belirtilmelidir; bu zıtlığı sağlayan C doğru cevaptır.

questions.promptText: A 2003 study of car-crash victims found that those with more fat were less likely to suffer abdominal injuries, ----
questions.turkishTranslation: 2003 yılında yapılan bir araç kazası kurbanları çalışması, daha fazla yağlı olanların karın yaralanmaları yaşama olasılığının daha düşük olduğunu buldu, ----
questions.optionA: so you are more likely to experience some kind of trauma even months after the accident happened
questions.optionB: and no matter what protective measures you may have taken before a possible accident, it may still happen in the end
questions.optionC: since there is no correlation between total weight of passengers and the risk of getting injured
questions.optionD: but the fat-as-airbag principle may not actually be so protective as some people might think it must be
questions.optionE: although one’s body fat can, in fact, act as some sort of shock absorber in violent collisions
questions.explanation: "But" bağlacı, daha fazla yağın karın yaralanması riskini azaltması bulgusuyla, bu "yağ-hava yastığı" ilkesinin sanıldığı kadar koruyucu OLMAYABİLECEĞİ uyarısı arasında karşıtlık kurar; bu zıtlığı veren D doğru cevaptır.

questions.promptText: People do not have a problem with obsessive compulsive disorder ----
questions.turkishTranslation: İnsanlar obsesif kompulsif bozuklukla bir sorun yaşamazlar ----
questions.optionA: as compulsions are undesired actions that people find themselves forced into doing over and over to reduce anxiety
questions.optionB: when the disorder causes considerable emotional discomfort and a high level of anxiety
questions.optionC: while the approach for treating it is quite similar to the treatments for anxiety, fear, and intense anger
questions.optionD: unless their repetitive thoughts and actions begin to seriously harm their relationships or their sense of freedom
questions.optionE: because it could be very severe and require them to act in collaboration with a therapist or counsellor
questions.explanation: "Unless" (meğerki) bağlacı bir koşul/istisna kurar: tekrarlayan düşünce ve davranışlar ilişkileri veya özgürlük hissini ciddi şekilde ZARARLAMADIKÇA, insanların obsesif kompulsif bozuklukla sorunu olmadığı belirtilmelidir; bu koşulu veren D doğru cevaptır.

questions.promptText: ----, Alsace's long history of political insecurity and the devastation caused by the two world wars have impoverished the region.
questions.turkishTranslation: ----, Alsace'ın uzun süren siyasi güvensizlik geçmişi ve iki dünya savaşının yol açtığı tahribat bölgeyi yoksullaştırmıştır.

questions.optionB: While the region became the focus of territorial dispute between France and Germany in the mid-to- late 1800s

questions.explanation: "Although" ile kurulan karşıtlıkta, Alsace'ın toprakları verimli ve demir-kömür madenleri zenginlik kaynağı OLSA DA, bölgenin yoksullaştığı belirtilmelidir; bu zıtlığı sağlayan C doğru cevaptır.

questions.promptText: Some Roman baths might have been functioning, at least partially, into the fifth century, ----
questions.turkishTranslation: Bazı Roma hamamları, en azından kısmen, beşinci yüzyıla kadar işlevini sürdürmüş olabilir, ----
questions.optionA: so that it was the inability of later ancient administrations to maintain the vast and complicated water systems
questions.optionB: but after many repairs, the Thermae of Agrippa was still open as a luxury establishment in the fifth century

questions.promptText: Throughout the Tanzimat era, Ottoman statesmen believed that as long as the European powers respected their country’s sovereignty, ----
questions.turkishTranslation: Tanzimat dönemi boyunca, Osmanlı devlet adamları Avrupa güçleri ülkelerinin egemenliğine saygı gösterdiği sürece ----

questions.optionB: they prevented the acquisition of immovable properties within the borders of the state by the citizens of neighbouring countries

questions.optionD: there was little or no danger in allowing Europeans ever greater access to their country’s economy
questions.optionE: seeking or accepting aid from a foreign power would mean to people nothing more than years of exile in distant lands
questions.explanation: "As long as" (sürece) ile kurulan koşulda, Avrupa güçleri ülkenin egemenliğine saygı duyduğu SÜRECE, ekonomiye daha fazla erişim izni vermekte az tehlike görüldüğü belirtilmelidir; bu koşulu veren D doğru cevaptır.

questions.promptText: As the Dakota tribes along the Minnesota River in the US were fed up with settlers flooding into their territory, ----
questions.turkishTranslation: ABD'deki Minnesota Nehri boyunca yaşayan Dakota kabileleri, topraklarına akın eden yerleşimcilerden bıktığından, ----
questions.optionA: they were less powerful and thus failed to defeat the settlers
questions.optionB: the settlers were determined to fight against the Dakota tribes
questions.optionC: they decided to respond with attacks to push the settlers off their reservation
questions.optionD: the settlers reached an agreement on the territorial issues with the Dakota tribes
questions.optionE: the new settlers of Dakota started a riot to rebel against the tribal chiefs
questions.explanation: "As" ile verilen sebep (Dakota kabilelerinin yerleşimcilerin topraklarına akınından bezmesi), bir SONUÇ gerektirir; yerleşimcileri topraklarından çıkarmak için saldırılarla karşılık vermeye karar vermelerini anlatan C, bu nedensellik ilişkisine uyar.

questions.promptText: Because we are bombarded with so much information and misinformation about what might cause cancer, ----
questions.turkishTranslation: Kanserin nedeni olabilecek şeyler hakkında bu kadar çok bilgi ve yanlış bilgi bombardımanına uğradığımız için, ----
questions.optionA: it is often hard to separate myth from reality
questions.optionB: it affects every one of us in the same way
questions.optionC: the chance of being diagnosed is one in two
questions.optionD: there are some things we can do to reduce our risks of getting cancer
questions.optionE: the extent of public confusion was exposed in a survey last year
questions.explanation: "Because" ile verilen sebep (kanserin nedenleri hakkında bilgi ve yanlış bilgi bombardımanı), bir SONUÇ gerektirir; efsaneyi gerçeklikten ayırmanın genellikle zor olmasını belirten A, bu nedensellik ilişkisine uyar.

questions.promptText: For a long time, punishment was viewed as a useful child-rearing tool, ----
questions.turkishTranslation: Uzun bir süre boyunca ceza, yararlı bir çocuk yetiştirme aracı olarak görülmüştür, ----

questions.optionB: furthermore, it evokes strong negative feeling in a child that he or she relates to the person applying it
questions.optionC: therefore, punishment draws attention to the negative behaviour rather than the desired alternative
questions.optionD: yet, it is now recognised that it generally does not lead to the desired behavioural outcome for children
questions.optionE: hence, parents punishing their children for an inappropriate action are not providing an example of the correct behaviour
questions.explanation: "Yet" bağlacı, cezanın uzun süre yararlı bir çocuk yetiştirme aracı olarak görülmesiyle, şimdi genellikle istenen davranışsal sonucu VERMEDİĞİNİN kabul edilmesi arasında karşıtlık kurar; bu zıtlığı veren D doğru cevaptır.

questions.promptText: While each researcher has their own way of analysing and interpreting animal remains, ----
questions.turkishTranslation: Her araştırmacının hayvan kalıntılarını analiz etme ve yorumlama konusunda kendine özgü bir yolu olsa da, ----
questions.optionA: it must be remembered that sample size and preservation quality ultimately influence the outcome
questions.optionB: animal remains aid in the interpretation of ancient resource choices
questions.optionC: it is fundamental to determine the locations and social complexity of archaeological sites
questions.optionD: animal remains can be used to provide information about a variety of issues in the study of societies
questions.optionE: some methods, terms and analytical tools are considered standard
questions.explanation: "While" bağlacı, her araştırmacının hayvan kalıntılarını analiz etme konusunda kendine özgü bir yöntemi OLMASIYLA, bazı yöntem ve terimlerin standart sayılması arasında karşıtlık kurar; bu zıtlığı veren E doğru cevaptır.

questions.promptText: Even though animal behaviourists have traditionally avoided linking human emotions, such as grief, with responses by animals, ----
questions.turkishTranslation: Hayvan davranış bilimciler geleneksel olarak keder gibi insani duyguları hayvanların tepkileriyle ilişkilendirmekten kaçınmış olsalar da, ----
questions.optionA: grief in animals may take forms that are difficult for humans to recognise as mourning
questions.optionB: observations suggest that the ways in which we mourn might be uniquely human
questions.optionC: a growing body of evidence shows that species ranging from dolphins to ducks mourn the passing of relatives
questions.optionD: research on grief in wild monkeys that live in social units has been surprisingly limited so far
questions.optionE: we think that humans are the only species that grieves over the loss of loved ones
questions.explanation: "Even though" ile kurulan karşıtlıkta, davranış bilimcilerin geleneksel olarak insani duyguları hayvan tepkileriyle İLİŞKİLENDİRMEKTEN KAÇINMASINA KARŞIN, giderek artan kanıtların yunuslardan ördeklere kadar türlerin yas tuttuğunu göstermesi belirtilmelidir; bu zıtlığı sağlayan C doğru cevaptır.

questions.promptText: ----, language, as a complicated phenomenon of the human mind, does not seem to be restricted to a single region in the brain.
questions.turkishTranslation: ----, insan zihninin karmaşık bir olgusu olan dil, beyinde tek bir bölgeyle sınırlı görünmemektedir.
questions.optionA: If neurolinguists want to examine the functioning of the human brain in more detail
questions.optionB: Even if certain tasks are fulfilled through coordination among neurons
questions.optionC: Although it is localised mainly on the left side of the brain
questions.optionD: As it is a concrete manifestation of the human mind
questions.optionE: When the brain is overwhelmed with long and complex sentences
questions.explanation: "Although" ile kurulan karşıtlıkta, dil beyinde temel olarak sol yarımkürede YOĞUNLAŞMIŞ OLSA DA, tek bir bölgeyle sınırlı görünmediği belirtilmelidir; bu zıtlığı sağlayan C doğru cevaptır.

questions.promptText: ----, someone who is successful in several fields is often called a Renaissance man or Renaissance woman.
questions.turkishTranslation: ----, birkaç alanda başarılı olan kişiye genellikle Rönesans adamı veya Rönesans kadını denir.
questions.optionA: In order to better understand the masterpieces of the brilliant Renaissance artists such as Michelangelo and Raphael
questions.optionB: While the Renaissance affected every area of human activity and knowledge, from art to zoology
questions.optionC: Because the Renaissance produced individuals with a wide range of interests who excelled in a number of different areas
questions.optionD: Although most historians shared the view of the period as a rebirth after the darkness of the Middle Ages
questions.optionE: After science advanced when Renaissance humanists discovered and spread ancient works on mathematics, medicine, and other topics
questions.explanation: "Because" ile verilen sebep, Rönesans'ın birçok alanda üstün olan, geniş ilgi alanlarına sahip bireyler yetiştirmesi ile bu kişilere "Rönesans insanı" denmesi arasında nedensellik kurar; bu ilişkiyi veren C doğru cevaptır.

questions.promptText: Peer pressure is what causes people to do things that are popular in order to fit in with others, ----
questions.turkishTranslation: Akran baskısı, insanların başkalarına uyum sağlamak için popüler olan şeyleri yapmalarına neden olan şeydir, ----
questions.optionA: while middle school students influence each other to a great extent
questions.optionB: however, peers are the people who are of similar age, such as classmates
questions.optionC: in other words, some individuals resist peer pressure and prioritise their own personal views
questions.optionD: so it can be very powerful driving force in the lives of adolescents
questions.optionE: as psychologists use positive peer pressure as a method to change a child’s behaviour
questions.explanation: "So" bağlacı bir SONUÇ kurar: akran baskısının insanları uyum sağlamak için popüler şeyler yapmaya itmesinin SONUCU OLARAK, ergenlerin hayatında güçlü bir itici güç olabileceği belirtilmelidir; bu sonucu veren D doğru cevaptır.

questions.promptText: According to skeletal therapists, it is vital that women strengthen their bodies in their 40s, ----
questions.turkishTranslation: İskelet terapistlerine göre, kadınların 40'lı yaşlarında vücutlarını güçlendirmeleri hayati önem taşır, ----

questions.optionC: but hunched shoulders and poor posture can lead to a range of health issues in the old age
questions.optionD: as long as muscles work optimally to support the skeleton and the body is positioned correctly
questions.optionE: even though bad posture is known to give them an awkward look and might lead to serious ailments in time
questions.explanation: "As long as" (sürece) koşulu, kasların iskeleti optimal şekilde desteklediği ve vücudun doğru konumlandığı SÜRECE, kadınların 40'lı yaşlarda vücutlarını güçlendirmelerinin önemini açıklamalıdır; bu koşulu veren D doğru cevaptır.

questions.promptText: Fast food has emerged as one of the biggest enemies of health, especially for children, ----
questions.turkishTranslation: Fast food, özellikle çocuklar için sağlığın en büyük düşmanlarından biri haline gelmiştir, ----
questions.optionA: thus its high consumption makes sense when the prices are considered
questions.optionB: provided that the most common cause of obesity is the wide availability of fast food
questions.optionC: while people are highly concerned about the nutritional deficiency of foods like burgers
questions.optionD: so the fast food industry has received a lot of critical attention in recent years
questions.optionE: as many fast food restaurants have started to provide healthier alternatives such as salads
questions.explanation: "While" bağlacı, fast food'un sağlığın en büyük düşmanlarından biri olmasıyla, insanların burger gibi yiyeceklerin besin yetersizliğinden yüksek düzeyde kaygı duyması arasında ilişkilendirici bir karşılaştırma kurar; bu ilişkiyi veren C doğru cevaptır.

questions.promptText: Even though some studio suggest that exposure to the blue light emitted by digital devices could be a risk factor for developing certain eye conditions, ----
questions.turkishTranslation: Bazı çalışmalar dijital cihazlar tarafından yayılan mavi ışığa maruz kalmanın belirli göz hastalıklarının gelişmesi için bir risk faktörü olabileceğini öne sürse de, ----
questions.optionA: it has also been revealed that long hours of screen time may trigger headaches
questions.optionB: most parents worry that digital devices can ruin their children's eyesight
questions.optionC: many scientists think that the evidence to support this claim is not very strong
questions.optionD: there are other eye issues that our screens can bring on, such as dry or tired eyes
questions.optionE: some companies are marketing special glasses that protect our eyes from the blue light
questions.explanation: "Even though" ile kurulan karşıtlıkta, mavi ışığın göz hastalıklarına risk faktörü olabileceği İDDİA EDİLSE DE, bu iddiayı destekleyen kanıtın güçlü olmadığını düşünen bilim adamları belirtilmelidir; bu zıtlığı sağlayan C doğru cevaptır.

questions.promptText: While Willis Carrier, who was among the most relentless researchers and promoters of air conditioning, is known as the father of air conditioning, ----
questions.turkishTranslation: Klima araştırmacıları ve destekçileri arasında en yılmazlardan biri olan Willis Carrier, klimanın babası olarak bilinse de, ----
questions.optionA: the range of processes and products involved in air conditioning cannot be attributed to a single person
questions.optionB: for centuries, ice and water had been manipulated to cool air circulating in theatres, hospitals, and factories
questions.optionC: air conditioning began to be marketed as a comfort device for domestic consumption during the 1930s
questions.optionD: the development of industrial air conditioning dominated the newly created industry at the beginning of the 20th century
questions.optionE: technologies were being developed in the refrigeration industry contemporaneously with Carrier’s work in humidification
questions.explanation: "While" bağlacı, Willis Carrier'ın "klimanın babası" olarak tanınmasıyla, klimayla ilgili süreç ve ürünlerin TEK bir kişiye atfedilemeyeceği gerçeği arasında karşıtlık kurar; bu zıtlığı veren A doğru cevaptır.

questions.promptText: ----, the diseases which were also brought posed serious challenges to their way of life.
questions.turkishTranslation: ----, aynı zamanda getirilen hastalıklar da onların yaşam tarzı için ciddi zorluklar oluşturdu.
questions.optionA: Given that the Native Americans were initially hospitable to the European settlers
questions.optionB: Although the Native Americans benefited from access to new technology and trade came with the early European settlers

questions.optionE: Even though the Native Americans and European immigrants had difficulties in communication due to language problems
questions.explanation: "Although" ile kurulan karşıtlıkta, Yerli Amerikalıların yeni teknoloji ve ticarete erişimden FAYDALANMALARINA KARŞIN, getirilen hastalıkların yaşam tarzlarına ciddi zorluklar getirdiği belirtilmelidir; bu zıtlığı sağlayan B doğru cevaptır.

questions.promptText: Although many people equate creativity with intelligence, ----
questions.turkishTranslation: Birçok insan yaratıcılığı zekâyla eşdeğer görse de, ----

questions.optionE: creative individuals tend to share certain characteristics, including a tendency to be more impulsive or spontaneous
questions.explanation: "Although" ile kurulan karşıtlıkta, birçok kişi yaratıcılığı zekayla EŞİTLEMESİNE KARŞIN, bu iki kavramın eş anlamlı olmadığı ve yaratıcı olmak için yüksek IQ gerekmediği belirtilmelidir; bu zıtlığı sağlayan C doğru cevaptır.

questions.promptText: Since virtually all cultures on earth have some form of fortune-telling, ----
questions.turkishTranslation: Dünyadaki hemen hemen tüm kültürlerde bir tür fal bakma biçimi bulunduğundan, ----

questions.promptText: Most people have experienced foodborne illness ----

questions.promptText: The literature on treatment for learning disabilities primarily discusses school-based treatments, ----

questions.promptText: The body faces many dangers such as physical damage and infectious diseases ----.

questions.promptText: Although whales and dolphins spend their lives in water, ----.

questions.promptText: Despite being the best thing he had written up to that time, when Sir Arthur Conan Doyle wrote the first Sherlock Holmes story, ----

questions.promptText: Although airborne radar shares much in common with surface and naval sets, ----

questions.optionE: Despite the fact that albatrosses can live to a great age
questions.explanation: "Because" albatrosların denizde günler/haftalarca kalmasını, zararsızca deniz suyu içebilme fizyolojik zorunluluğunun nedeni olarak sunar.

questions.promptText: ---- , but the creation of genetic techniques to safely halt or reverse age-related conditions in humans has so far proven improbable.
questions.turkishTranslation: ----, ancak insanlarda yaşa bağlı durumları güvenli bir şekilde durduracak veya tersine çevirecek genetik tekniklerin geliştirilmesi şimdiye kadar pek mümkün olmamıştır.
questions.optionA: Some researchers have doubts whether a new genetic technique could be developed as a first step towards the medical world’s fabled ‘elixir of youth’
questions.optionB: It has long been known that manipulating certain genes in an organism can slow ageing and extend its lifespan
questions.optionC: More proof will be needed before new genetic treatments using stem cells can be promoted as the key to turning back the clock on old age
questions.optionD: Ageing of the body is a dynamic process, as often reported by a number of researchers
questions.optionE: The efficacy of new methods utilised to prevent ageing is still questionable
questions.explanation: "But" genlerin yaşlanmayı geciktirebildiğinin uzun zamandır bilinmesiyle, insanlarda güvenli bir tersine çevirme tekniğinin henüz geliştirilememesi arasındaki zıtlığı kurar.

questions.promptText: Because bodybuilders exert large amounts of energy, ----
questions.turkishTranslation: Vücut geliştiriciler büyük miktarda enerji sarf ettikleri için, ----
questions.optionA: they are judged on the physical appearance of their muscles and encouraged to focus on body image
questions.optionB: they try to achieve the body type that will help them be effective competitors in their sport
questions.optionC: bodybuilding is the development of the physique through exercise, often for competitive exhibition
questions.optionD: their metabolism generally requires more energy than the average person
questions.optionE: bodybuilding is an activity that includes weight training in order to build muscle mass
questions.explanation: "Because" harcanan büyük enerjiyi sebep olarak verir; metabolizmalarının ortalama insana göre daha fazla enerjiye ihtiyaç duyması bunun doğal sonucudur.

questions.promptText: While people can generally cough voluntarily, ----
questions.turkishTranslation: İnsanlar genellikle isteyerek öksürebilseler de, ----
questions.optionA: infectious viruses can be easily transmitted between individuals through coughing
questions.optionB: most people cough once or twice an hour during the day to clear irritants off the airway
questions.optionC: environmental pollutants, such as cigarette smoke and dust, can also cause a cough
questions.optionD: the cough that accompanies a cold usually lasts one to two weeks
questions.optionE: vitamins and minerals may be helpful in treating conditions that lead to coughs
questions.explanation: "While" öksürüğün istemli olarak yapılabilmesiyle, çevresel kirleticilerin de istemsizce öksürüğe yol açabilmesi arasındaki karşıtlığı ("also" ile eklenen ikinci sebep) kurar.

questions.promptText: When mental disorders, physical conditions, and functional decline coincide, ----
questions.turkishTranslation: Zihinsel bozukluklar, fiziksel durumlar ve fonksiyonel gerileme bir araya geldiğinde, ----
questions.optionA: older adults face a greatly increased risk of hospitalisation and placement in long-term care facilities
questions.optionB: some older adults have been found to be relatively active well into their 80s and 90s
questions.optionC: it is important to note that older adults vary substantially in terms of their physical and mental health
questions.optionD: physical decline is associated with causing a number of mental disorders among older adults
questions.optionE: mental health problems such as depression are not a natural consequence of growing older
questions.explanation: "When" bu üç durumun aynı anda görülmesini bir koşul olarak sunar; bu koşulun sonucu olarak hastaneye yatış/bakım riskinin artması mantıksal olarak örtüşür.

questions.promptText: Unless there are substantial changes in the ways that humans affect ecosystems, ----
questions.turkishTranslation: İnsanların ekosistemleri etkileme şekillerinde köklü değişiklikler olmadıkça, ----
questions.optionA: we have already caused permanent losses in global biodiversity
questions.optionB: our knowledge of Earth’s species is still incomplete
questions.optionC: there could be as many as 30–50 million species on Earth
questions.optionD: there will be much larger losses of biodiversity in the near future
questions.optionE: the scale by which we consider biodiversity ranges from local to global
questions.explanation: "Unless" değişiklik yapılmaması koşuluyla gelecekte olacak bir sonucu bağlar; gelecekte daha büyük biyoçeşitlilik kayıplarının yaşanacağı ifadesi bu koşullu-gelecek ilişkisine uyar.

questions.promptText: ---- , our very lives depend on it to sustain agriculture and to keep our bodies healthy.
questions.turkishTranslation: ----, hayatımızın kendisi tarımı sürdürmek ve vücudumuzu sağlıklı tutmak için ona bağlıdır.
questions.optionA: Since scientists have long struggled to comprehend the complexities of the weather
questions.optionB: Just as the Earth’s atmosphere would remain stagnant without weather
questions.optionC: While cold weather might cause us discomfort or even more severe health conditions
questions.optionD: Given that humanity has, indeed, changed the weather
questions.optionE: If predicting the weather is still, in many ways, a haphazard occupation
questions.explanation: "While" havanın rahatsızlık/sağlık sorunu verebilmesiyle, yaşamın tarım ve sağlık için ona bağımlı olması arasında bir zıtlık/denge kurar: olumsuz yanına rağmen hayati önemi vurgulanır.

questions.promptText: ---- , the nations of Europe raced to colonise the continent.
questions.turkishTranslation: ----, Avrupa ulusları kıtayı sömürgeleştirmek için yarışa girdi.
questions.optionA: Given that almost all European interaction with Africa took place along the coasts until the 18th century
questions.optionB: Because African responses to the challenge of European imperialism were complex
questions.optionC: Even if colonial administrations enticed or coerced Africans into producing goods for export
questions.optionD: When technological advances made Africa’s interior readily accessible in the late 19th century
questions.optionE: Despite several factors that drove the European scramble for Africa in the 18th century
questions.explanation: "When" teknolojik gelişmelerin Afrika'nın iç kısımlarını erişilebilir kılmasını zamansal bir tetikleyici olarak verir; bunun sonucu Avrupa'nın kolonileşme yarışına girmesidir.

questions.promptText: ---- , the Romans became the first major society to wear seasonal clothing.
questions.turkishTranslation: ----, Romalılar mevsimlik giysiler giyen ilk büyük toplum oldu.
questions.optionA: Although Romans were very careful about the way they dressed
questions.optionB: As most of what we know about Roman clothing comes from written sources
questions.optionC: Because their empire grew so great and took them into very different climates
questions.optionD: Even if Romans made warm winter boots and the first known raincoat
questions.optionE: Whereas wealthy Romans had slaves to help choose their clothing
questions.explanation: "Because" imparatorluğun büyüyüp farklı iklimlere yayılmasını sebep olarak verir; bu, Romalıların sezonluk giyimi benimsemesinin mantıklı sonucudur.

questions.promptText: ----, the ethnic characteristics and traditions of the Balkan Peninsula’s food culture have been well preserved.
questions.turkishTranslation: ----, Balkan Yarımadası'nın yemek kültürünün etnik özellikleri ve gelenekleri iyi bir şekilde korunmuştur.
questions.optionA: Provided that it displays both Asian and western European influences
questions.optionB: Even if meat might not have played a central role in the past
questions.optionC: Even though the eastern influence has been very strong in the last several centuries
questions.optionD: As long as its food culture is shaped by the historic, social and climatic elements
questions.optionE: While the use of numerous spices constitutes the basics of its cuisine
questions.explanation: "Even though" güçlü doğu etkisine rağmen Balkanların yerel/etnik mutfak geleneklerinin korunmuş olması gibi beklenmedik bir durumu bağlar.

questions.promptText: The Sung dynasty Chinese (AD 960–1279) had the technology to make rockets, ----
questions.turkishTranslation: Sung hanedanlığı Çinlileri (MS 960-1279) roket yapma teknolojisine sahipti, ----
questions.optionA: so the first European picture of a rocket was made in 1400
questions.optionB: thus it was occasionally used as a weapon by Europeans
questions.optionC: because the earliest European recipe for black powder appeared in 1265
questions.optionD: but there is no definitive evidence that they did so
questions.optionE: as the origin of the rocket is shrouded in mystery
questions.explanation: "But" teknolojiye sahip olmalarıyla bunu gerçekten kullandıklarına dair kanıt olmaması arasındaki zıtlığı kurar.

questions.promptText: Because of its power and potential for both harm and good, ----
questions.turkishTranslation: Hem zarar hem de iyilik verme gücü ve potansiyeli nedeniyle, ----
questions.optionA: modern meteorology has made notable improvements in the critical discipline of predicting severe weather
questions.optionB: meteorologists are the only professionals who can keep their jobs and still be wrong half the time
questions.optionC: scientists have studied cloud seeding with the goal of making it rain in places experiencing prolonged droughts
questions.optionD: the weather has been a subject of intense interest and scrutiny by human beings since ancient times
questions.optionE: it seems unlikely that we will ever get to the point of being able to predict the weather with 100 percent
questions.explanation: "Because of" havanın gücü ve hem zarar hem fayda potansiyelini sebep olarak verir; insanların antik çağlardan beri havaya ilgi göstermesi bu sebebin doğal sonucudur.

questions.promptText: Forensic investigators must collect evidence while the crime scene is still fresh ----
questions.turkishTranslation: Adli tıp araştırmacıları olay yeri henüz taze iken kanıt toplamak zorundadır ----
questions.optionA: because forensic science is the use of scientific methods to investigate crimes
questions.optionB: since forensic scientists study evidence at the homes and workplaces of suspects
questions.optionC: although it is the job of forensic scientists to provide evidence at a criminal trial
questions.optionD: even if the area is unsafe and they have to work under armed guard
questions.optionE: as many sciences, from chemistry to engineering, are used in an investigation
questions.explanation: "Even if" kanıt toplama zorunluluğunun, alan güvensiz olsa ve silahlı koruma altında çalışmaları gerekse de devam ettiğini belirten bir ödün/karşıtlık bağlar.

questions.promptText: Although alchemy began as a way to turn other metals into gold, ----
questions.turkishTranslation: Simya, diğer metalleri altına çevirmenin bir yolu olarak başlamış olsa da, ----
questions.optionA: it matured into a system of thinking about nature that contributed to the development of modern chemistry
questions.optionB: alchemistic ideas and practices flourished in the ancient world within several cultural traditions
questions.optionC: a number of spectacular failures eventually led to the disappearance of alchemy in China
questions.optionD: alchemists continued in their relentless quest for gold well into the sixteenth century
questions.optionE: its objectives were to find ways of accelerating the rates at which metals could be changed into gold
questions.explanation: "Although" simyanın basit başlangıcıyla ulaştığı sonuç arasında bir zıtlık kurar; modern kimyaya katkı sağlayan bir düşünce sistemine evrilmesi bu beklenmedik gelişimi tamamlar.

questions.promptText: Although the available evidence shows no use of colour or decoration on early footwear, ----
questions.turkishTranslation: Elimizdeki kanıtlar erken dönem ayakkabılarda renk veya süsleme kullanımına dair bir işaret göstermese de, ----
questions.optionA: the existence of twenty-five-thousand-year-old clothing suggests that footwear may be older than is even presently known
questions.optionB: the elaborate weaving on some shoes seems to indicate that prehistoric people would care about the appearance of the shoes
questions.optionC: prehistoric shoes had to resist heavy usage, whether made from leather or from plant fibers
questions.optionD: the oldest known shoes are ten-thousand-year-old sandals found in a desert area of eastern Oregon of the US
questions.optionE: prehistoric humans would make their shoes shortly after killing animals, such as sheep and deer
questions.explanation: "Although" renk/süsleme kanıtı olmamasına rağmen görünüme önem verildiğini gösteren başka bir kanıtı (karmaşık dokuma) zıt bir şekilde bağlar.

questions.promptText: While most research on the role of genetics and the heritability of aggression has ruled out the idea of an aggressive gene, ----
questions.turkishTranslation: Genetiğin ve saldırganlığın kalıtsallığının rolüne ilişkin araştırmaların çoğu 'agresif gen' fikrini elemiş olsa da, ----
questions.optionA: most definitions of aggression indicate that it represents behaviours that are intended to hurt or harm another
questions.optionB: it is currently thought that one might inherit the biological susceptibility for being aggressive
questions.optionC: one of the most widely discussed theories of aggressive behavior is Albert Bandura’s social learning theory
questions.optionD: there are a number of different ways to conceptualise subtypes of aggressive behaviours
questions.optionE: much of the research on aggression has focused primarily upon children who are physically aggressive
questions.explanation: "While" "saldırganlık geni" fikrinin reddedilmesiyle, buna karşın biyolojik bir eğilimin kalıtsal olabileceği görüşü arasındaki ince zıtlığı kurar.

questions.promptText: ---- , it will not be possible to turn a draft into a finished piece of work.
questions.turkishTranslation: ----, bir taslağı tamamlanmış bir eser haline getirmek mümkün olmayacaktır.
questions.optionA: Although an author may have a hard time evaluating what he or she has written
questions.optionB: Even if an author thinks that characterisation is poor in his or her work
questions.optionC: Unless an author knows the strengths and weaknesses of a manuscript
questions.optionD: Because an author should realise that revision turns an amateur into a professional
questions.optionE: When rewriting and polishing lead an author to produce a good novel
questions.explanation: "Unless" taslağın bitmiş bir esere dönüşmemesi için gereken koşulu, yazarın güçlü/zayıf yanlarını bilmesi şartına bağlar.

questions.promptText: Some birds build nests simply to protect their young ----
questions.turkishTranslation: Bazı kuşlar sadece yavrularını korumak için yuva yaparlar ----
questions.optionA: since many small animals that live above the ground make their homes in trees
questions.optionB: until they have learned how to look after themselves and survive in the wild on their own
questions.optionC: given that they make mud huts that are placed in all kinds of places, from undergrowth to fence posts
questions.optionD: although sometimes a squirrel takes over an empty bird’s nest and makes its home there
questions.optionE: while colonies of wasps build their nests from the top downward
questions.explanation: "Until" yavruları korumanın zaman sınırını belirtir; yavruların kendi başlarına hayatta kalmayı öğrenene kadar bu korumanın sürdüğü anlamıyla uyumludur.

questions.promptText: Of the 20 amino acids that make up all proteins, 9 are considered essential ----
questions.turkishTranslation: Tüm proteinleri oluşturan 20 amino asitten 9'u temel olarak kabul edilir ----
questions.optionA: if thousands of proteins are assembled from some 20 different amino acids
questions.optionB: as the best sources of complete protein are lean meats, fish, low-fat dairy products, and eggs
questions.optionC: even if some foods are better sources of protein than others
questions.optionD: because they cannot be made in our bodies and must be obtained from the foods we eat

questions.explanation: "Because" bu 9 amino asidin "esansiyel" sayılma nedenini verir; vücutta üretilemeyip gıdalarla alınma zorunluluğu "essential" sıfatını mantıklı şekilde açıklar.

questions.promptText: Trans fat may be as harmful to your health as saturated fat ----
questions.turkishTranslation: Trans yağ, sağlığınız için doymuş yağ kadar zararlı olabilir ----
questions.optionA: because it increases blood cholesterol levels, among other adverse effects
questions.optionB: although major sources are hardened vegetable fat such as margarine
questions.optionC: as long as foods high in saturated fat include red meats and dairy products
questions.optionD: since a diet that has generous amounts of vegetables is naturally lower in fat
questions.optionE: even if a diet high in fat can also be unnecessarily high in calories

questions.promptText: ----, he was foremost an inventor and more interested in attracting public interest in his work than advancing scientific knowledge.
questions.turkishTranslation: ----, o her şeyden önce bir mucitti ve bilimsel bilgiyi ilerletmekten çok, işine kamuoyunun ilgisini çekmekle daha fazla ilgilenirdi.
questions.optionA: When the philosopher Alfred North Whitehead famously credited Thomas Edison with the discovery of a method of invention
questions.optionB: While Thomas Edison saw himself as a member of the larger scientific community and presented papers before the National Academy of Sciences
