questions.turkishTranslation: Gelişmiş ülkelerin kişisel ulaşım için otomobile aşırı bağımlı olması gibi meseleler, yakıt kaynaklarının sınırlı olması ve otomobillerin trafiğe ve kirliliğe neden olması nedeniyle sürdürülebilirlik açısından bir sorun oluşturmaktadır.
questions.optionA: Due to the restricted amount of fuel supplies and automobiles causing traffic and pollution, people’s excessive dependence on automobiles for individual transport in developed countries is one of the examples of problems hindering sustainability.
questions.optionB: In developed states, automobiles which bring about congestion and pollution are highly used for personal mobility despite insufficient fuel reserves, thereby creating an unsustainable future as well as many other concerns.
questions.optionC: To the detriment of sustainability, substantial use of automobiles for personal travel in developed countries is one of the challenging issues because of which fuel resources are exhausted, and traffic and pollution increase.
questions.optionD: Automobiles, predominantly used by people living in developed countries, pose a much more considerable threat to sustainability by depleting fuel supplies, disrupting traffic flow, and producing pollution when compared to other problems.
questions.optionE: One of many concerns related to the sustainability of fuel resources stems from the increased use of automobiles for travelling alone especially in developed states, which creates heavy traffic flow in addition to polluting the environment.
questions.explanation: A, nedeni ('given that' = 'due to') önce verip sonucu (sürdürülebilirliğe sorun oluşturması) aynı mantıkla aktarır; yakıt kaynaklarının kısıtlı olması ve trafik/kirliliğin birer sebep olduğu ilişki değişmez. Diğer seçenekler nedensellik yönünü tersine çevirir veya 'one of the issues' vurgusunu kaybeder.

questions.promptText: Hypochondriacs, those who have an excessive preoccupation with personal health, may falsely believe that they have a deadly disease and persist in this belief even after being assured by a physician that they do not have the disease.
questions.turkishTranslation: Kişisel sağlıklarına aşırı düşkün olan hipokondriaklar, ölümcül bir hastalıkları olduğuna yanlışlıkla inanabilir ve bir doktor hastalıkları olmadığına dair onları temin etse bile bu inançlarını sürdürebilirler.
questions.optionA: People who are extremely worried about personal health might erroneously believe that they have a life-threatening disease, and those who cling to this belief although they are told by a physician that they do not have the disease are called hypochondriacs.
questions.optionB: Hypochondriacs, strongly fixated on personal health, might mistakenly believe that they have been struck by a fatal disease, and because of this belief, they assert that a physician must absolutely guarantee that they do not have the disease.
questions.optionC: As hypochondriacs are highly obsessed with personal health, they might wrongly believe that they have a fatal disease and do not abandon this belief unless a physician ensures that they do not have the disease.
questions.optionD: Feeling an overriding concern for personal health, hypochondriacs might hold an erroneous belief that they suffer from a fatal disease and stick to this belief even if a physician confirms that they do not have the disease.
questions.optionE: Hypochondriacs, who are deeply interested in personal health, might wrongly believe that they suffer from a fatal disease, and therefore they have to see a physician to make sure that they do not have the disease so that they give up this belief.
questions.explanation: D, 'even after being assured' yapısını 'even if a physician confirms' ile karşılayarak doktor güvencesine rağmen inancın sürdüğü karşıtlık ilişkisini korur. C'deki 'unless' ise doktorun güvencesini inancın devamı için bir koşul gibi gösterip anlamı çarptırır.

questions.promptText: Many technology companies assume that training artificial intelligence on more data can help fix the problem of AIs replicating human prejudices, but it turns out that using larger data sets can produce more biased results.
questions.turkishTranslation: Birçok teknoloji şirketi, yapay zekayı daha fazla veriyle eğitmenin yapay zekanın insan önyargılarını tekrarlaması sorununu çözmeye yardımcı olabileceğini düşünür, ancak daha büyük veri kümeleri kullanmanın daha yanlı sonuçlar üretebildiği ortaya çıkmaktadır.
questions.optionA: Many technology companies still believe that they will overcome the issue of AIs copying human prejudices through training artificial intelligence on more data even after ending up with more biased outcomes by using larger data sets.
questions.optionB: Many technology companies believing that they could resolve the issue of AIs imitating human prejudices have increased the amount of data to train artificial intelligence; however, it has become obvious that the results are more biased when they include larger data sets.
questions.optionC: While many technology companies believe that training artificial intelligence on more data may help solve the problem of AIs mimicking human prejudices, it has become apparent that more biased outcomes might be acquired when larger data sets are employed.
questions.optionD: In order to handle the problem of AIs mimicking human prejudices, many technology companies have started to instruct artificial intelligence with more data, yet it has become clear that employing such large data sets can generate even more biased outcomes.
questions.optionE: Instructing artificial intelligence with more data is considered by many technology companies to be beneficial in addressing the problem of AIs copying human prejudices, though it has been argued that it will create more biased outcomes.
questions.explanation: C, 'assume... but it turns out' karşıtlığını 'believe... it has become apparent' ile aynı güçte verir; şirketlerin varsayımı ile ortaya çıkan gerçek sonucun (daha fazla önyargı) zıtlığı tam korunur. E'deki 'has been argued' ise kesinleşmiş bir gerçeği sadece bir iddiaya indirerek anlamı zayıflatır.

questions.promptText: An underwater robot has just been developed to autonomously check the bottom of the sea to identify rubbish using image recognition, which in turn could help control limited budgets for the clean-up of harmful materials.
questions.turkishTranslation: Görüntü tanıma kullanarak çöpü tespit etmek amacıyla deniz tabanını kendi başına kontrol edecek bir sualtı robotu geliştirildi ve bu da zararlı maddelerin temizliği için ayrılan sınırlı bütçelerin daha iyi yönetilmesine yardımcı olabilir.
questions.optionA: A recently developed underwater robot can autonomously probe the bottom of the sea to detect rubbish; however, the image recognition that the robot uses could strain the low budgets for the removal of hazardous materials.
questions.optionB: Although the budgets allocated for the development of an underwater robot with image recognition have been very small and hard to manage, the robot has recently proven useful in probing the sea floor on its own to detect rubbish and remove toxic materials.
questions.optionC: No matter how tight the budgets for the removal of hazardous materials are, a recently developed underwater robot, which relies on image recognition, is able to monitor the sea floor autonomously to spot rubbish and remove toxic materials.
questions.optionD: A recently developed underwater robot, equipped with image recognition, can monitor the bottom of the sea on its own to spot rubbish, and accordingly, it could be possible to manage tight budgets for the removal of hazardous materials.
questions.optionE: If image recognition is incorporated into a recently developed underwater robot so that it can monitor the sea floor autonomously to detect rubbish, tight budgets for the removal of hazardous materials can be managed more effectively.
questions.explanation: D, 'which in turn could help control limited budgets' sonuç ilişkisini 'and accordingly, it could be possible to manage tight budgets' ile birebir korur: robotun görüntü tanıma ile çöpü tespit etmesi, bütçenin daha iyi yönetilmesine yol açar. A'da bu sonuç tersine çevrilip olumsuz bir etki (bütçeyi zorlamak) gibi sunulur.

questions.promptText: The missing ingredients of a 2,300-year-old Chinese recipe for bronze have just been uncovered, making us acknowledge the level of sophistication in the practice of chemistry at the time.
questions.turkishTranslation: 2.300 yıllık bir Çin bronz tarifinin eksik malzemeleri ortaya çıkarıldı ve bu da o dönemdeki kimya uygulamasının ne kadar gelişmiş olduğunu kabul etmemizi sağladı.
questions.optionA: If the ingredients of a recipe that was missing for about 2,300 years had not been unravelled, today it would be impossible to appreciate how Chinese people of that time developed the practice of chemistry and bronze production.
questions.optionB: The disclosure of 2,300-year-old ingredients has made it possible for us to appreciate how Chinese people developed the practice of chemistry and managed to produce bronze as described in their recipes coming from that time.
questions.optionC: Though the ingredients of a recipe of bronze- making were unearthed about 2,300 years ago, it has recently been made possible to appreciate the degree of development Chinese people achieved at that time in the practice of chemistry, including bronze production.
questions.optionD: It is thanks to the recent discovery of ingredients in a Chinese recipe of bronze production dating back 2,300 years that we can now appreciate how developed the practice of chemistry was at that time.
questions.optionE: We can appreciate how developed the bronze recipes of Chinese people were because it has recently been made possible to produce bronze with the recipes as they did 2,300 years ago and achieve parallel developments in the practice of chemistry.
questions.explanation: D, 'have just been uncovered, making us acknowledge' nedensellik yapısını 'it is thanks to the recent discovery... that we can now appreciate' ile aynen verir; tarif 2300 yıllık, keşif ise yenidir ve bu detay korunur. Diğer seçenekler '2300 yıl önce' ile 'yeni keşif' zamanlarını birbirine karıştırır.

questions.promptText: A recent study has shown that when someone is thanked, it increases their chances of being helpful again, likely because they enjoy the feeling of being socially valued by other people.
questions.turkishTranslation: Yakın zamanda yapılan bir araştırma, bir kişiye teşekkür edildiğinde bu kişinin yeniden yardımsever olma olasılığının arttığını göstermiştir; bunun nedeni muhtemelen diğer insanlar tarafından sosyal olarak değerli görülme hissinden keyif almalarıdır.
questions.optionA: A helpful person who is thanked is even more likely to thank others in the future provided that they like how it makes them feel, as shown by a current study.
questions.optionB: A new study has revealed that a person can be more helpful towards others when they feel socially valued and thanked by those who appreciate receiving help.
questions.optionC: Being socially valued has been shown in a new study to affect the likelihood that someone will feel more willing to help others in return for thanks.
questions.optionD: A current study has revealed that someone is more likely to repeat helpful behaviour when thanked, probably due to the pleasure of being socially valued by others.
questions.optionE: A recent study has shown that someone who is thanked for their help is much more likely to be socially valued by others and feel the need to provide further help.
questions.explanation: D, teşekkür edilmenin yardımseverliği tekrar artırması ('increases their chances of being helpful again') ile bunun nedeni olan 'sosyal değer görmekten duyulan zevk' ilişkisini aynen 'more likely to repeat helpful behaviour... probably due to the pleasure of being socially valued' şeklinde korur. Diğer seçenekler neden ile sonucu karıştırır veya sırasını değiştirir.

questions.promptText: The use of antibiotics for spraying crops has increased exponentially in recent years in the US, with streptomycin predominantly used to control the bacterial disease that jeopardises apple and pear orchards.
questions.turkishTranslation: ABD'de ürünlere ilaç olarak antibiyotik kullanımı son yıllarda katlanarak artmıştır; streptomisin ise elma ve armut bahçelerini tehdit eden bakteriyel hastalığı kontrol etmek için ağırlıklı olarak kullanılmaktadır.
questions.optionA: In order to spray crops, antibiotics have been increasingly employed in recent years in the US, but apple and pear orchards are still at risk of serious harm from bacterial disease despite the heavy use of streptomycin.
questions.optionB: Streptomycin is one of the most commonly used antibiotics to spray crops in the US, where bacterial disease, which cannot be controlled in recent years, has struck apple and pear orchards.
questions.optionC: There has recently been a substantial increase in the use of antibiotics to spray crops in the US, however, without streptomycin, which is extensively employed to combat bacterial disease, apple and pear orchards would be destroyed.
questions.optionD: Streptomycin, which is intensely used to combat the bacterial disease that damages apple and pear orchards, has been widely blamed for the sharp increase in the use of antibiotics for spraying crops in recent years in the US.
questions.optionE: In recent years, a dramatic increase has been experienced in the exploitation of antibiotics to spray crops in the US, and among them is streptomycin, which is being largely used to control the bacterial disease that threatens apple and pear orchards.
questions.explanation: E, antibiyotik kullanımındaki keskin artış ('increased exponentially') ile streptomisinin bu antibiyotikler arasında elma/armut bahçelerini tehdit eden bakteriyel hastalığı kontrol etmek için kullanılan örnek olması ilişkisini aynen korur. Diğer seçenekler streptomisini artışın nedeni veya sonucu gibi göstererek ilişkiyi bozar.

questions.promptText: Although originally native to the Arabian Peninsula, aloe vera has become a global botanical product given that its leaves contain antioxidants that are essential to healthy skin.
questions.turkishTranslation: Aloe vera aslen Arap Yarımadası'na özgü olmasına rağmen, yaprakları sağlıklı cilt için gerekli olan antioksidanlar içerdiğinden küresel bir botanik ürün haline gelmiştir.
questions.optionA: Aloe vera was initially unique to the Arabian Peninsula; however, the importance of antioxidants in its leaves for healthy skin was realised across the entire world, and thus it has become a global botanical product.
questions.optionB: While aloe vera was first grown across the Arabian Peninsula, it has become a botanical product used all over the world because its leaves involve antioxidants that are vital to healthy skin.
questions.optionC: As aloe vera was initially grown on the Arabian Peninsula, the fact that its leaves contain antioxidants crucial to healthy skin was first discovered there, but later it became a global botanical product.
questions.optionD: The leaves of aloe vera contain antioxidants that are vital to healthy skin, which boosts its global recognition as a botanical product, yet it was the Arabian Peninsula which first grew it considering its benefits.
questions.optionE: Before aloe vera became a botanical product used throughout the entire world, it had initially been grown on the Arabian Peninsula, where its leaves involving antioxidants were used to ensure healthy skin.
questions.explanation: B, 'although originally native to... given that' karşıtlık+neden yapısını 'while... because' ile aynen korur: bitkinin kökeni Arap Yarımadası'dır ama yapraklarındaki antioksitanlar sayesinde küresel ürün olmuştur. Diğer seçenekler bu nedeni yanlış yere (keşif yeri, kronolojik sıra) kaydırır.

questions.promptText: As people have adopted sedentary lifestyles thanks to technological advances, there has been a global shift in their health conditions, which appears to be triggered by new living habits.
questions.turkishTranslation: İnsanlar teknolojik ilerlemeler sayesinde hareketsiz yaşam tarzlarını benimsedikçe, sağlık durumlarında küresel bir değişim yaşanmıştır ve bunun yeni yaşam alışkanlıkları tarafından tetiklendiği görülmektedir.
questions.optionA: People’s sedentary lifestyles have brought a worldwide change in their health conditions, and new living patterns mostly shaped by technological advances could account for this shift.
questions.optionB: As more and more people have had sedentary lifestyles due to technological advances, it has become inevitable for them to experience a worldwide change in their health conditions that might be related to new living patterns.
questions.optionC: Technological developments have caused people to cultivate new living habits, compelling them to have sedentary lifestyles, which seems to have induced a global change in their health conditions.
questions.optionD: Given that technological developments have led people to maintain sedentary lifestyles, there has been a worldwide change in their health conditions, and it seems to result from new living patterns.
questions.optionE: People have recently been engaged in sedentary lifestyles which include new living patterns impacted by technological developments, but these new patterns are thought to have prompted a global change in their health conditions.
questions.explanation: D, zincirleme nedensellik yapısını korur: teknolojik gelişmeler hareketsiz yaşam tarzına, bu da sağlıktaki küresel değişime yol açmış, ve bu değişimin sebebinin yeni yaşam alışkanlıkları olduğu ('seems to result from') belirtilmiştir. Diğer seçenekler bu üç unsurun sırasını veya nedensellik yönünü değiştirir.

questions.promptText: Despite the fact that most native speakers of a language can recognise the syllables of their own language, there is no agreement within phonetic theory as to what constitutes the basis of a syllable.
questions.turkishTranslation: Bir dilin anadili konuşmacılarının çoğu kendi dillerinin hecelerini tanıyabilse de, fonetik teoride bir hecenin temelini neyin oluşturduğu konusunda bir fikir birliği yoktur.
questions.optionA: Nearly all native speakers have an inherent ability to recognise syllables in a language, but what a syllable is composed of evades compliance within phonetic theory.
questions.optionB: Phonetic theory fails to realise what fundamentally makes up a syllable because many native speakers can identify the syllables of their own language.
questions.optionC: Given that there is no consensus in phonetic theory on what constitutes a syllable, most native speakers are rather inept at pinpointing syllables in their language.
questions.optionD: A consensus of what a syllable is fundamentally comprised of is lacking in phonetic theory; however, the majority of native speakers have syllabic recognition in their own language.
questions.optionE: Notwithstanding the recognisable ability of almost all native speakers to pinpoint syllables in their own language, the basis of a syllable is not determinable in phonetic theory.
questions.explanation: D, 'despite the fact that' karşıtlığını 'however' ile ters sırada ama aynı ilişkiyle verir: fonetik teoride hece tabanı konusunda uzlaşı yoktur, buna karşın anadili konuşanların hecelerini tanıyabildiği belirtilir. B ve C'de nedensellik yanlışlıkla kurulur (biri diğerinin sebebi gibi gösterilir), bu orijinalde yoktur.

questions.promptText: According to scientists’ predictions, today’s energy crisis will fuel deglobalisation, with supply chains and manufacturing kept within borders, a trend that has been boosted by the COVID-19 pandemic.
questions.turkishTranslation: Bilim insanlarının öngörülerine göre, günümüzün enerji krizi, tedarik zincirlerinin ve üretimin sınırlar içinde tutulmasıyla küreselleşmeden uzaklaşmayı körükleyecektir; bu eğilim COVID-19 pandemisiyle hız kazanmıştır.
questions.optionA: Scientists’ claims about the current energy crisis are particularly linked to deglobalisation, because of which we will have to manage supply chains and manufacturing within borders, as we did during the COVID-19 pandemic.
questions.optionB: Scientists’ statements about the energy crisis we are facing today show that we will have to manage supply chains and manufacturing within borders due to the deglobalisation triggered by the COVID-19 pandemic.
questions.optionC: Scientists suggest that the energy crisis currently witnessed will increase the rate of deglobalisation, which means that supply chains and manufacturing are to be maintained within borders, as happened during the COVID-19 pandemic.
questions.optionD: Scientists’ estimates about deglobalisation are similar to those of the COVID-19 pandemic in the sense that the virus that has erupted recently will require us to maintain supply chains and manufacturing within borders.
questions.optionE: Scientists have recently put that just as the COVID-19 pandemic has led supply chains and manufacturing to be maintained within borders, the energy crisis to be confronted now will spark off deglobalisation.
questions.explanation: C, 'will fuel deglobalisation... boosted by COVID-19' ilişkisini aynı yönde korur: enerji krizi küreselleşmenin tersine dönmesini artıracak, bu durum da COVID-19 sırasında olduğu gibi tedarik zincirlerinin sınır içinde tutulması anlamına gelir. E'de COVID-19'un etkisi enerji krizinin etkisiyle kıyaslanarak farklı bir mantıksal bağ (benzetme) kurulur, bu da asıl neden-sonuç ilişkisinden sapar.

questions.promptText: Cuba represents an incredible opportunity for the regional ecotourism sector as a whole, but a possible threat to established ecotourism destinations in the Caribbean and Mexico because of its high potential.
questions.turkishTranslation: Küba, yüksek potansiyeli nedeniyle bir bütün olarak bölgesel ekoturizm sektörü için muazzam bir fırsat sunarken, Karayipler ve Meksika'daki köklü ekoturizm destinasyonları için olası bir tehdit oluşturmaktadır.
questions.optionA: With its great potential, Cuba offers a phenomenal opportunity for the entire regional ecotourism sector, but this could potentially threaten long-standing ecotourism hubs in the Caribbean and Mexico.
questions.optionB: Cuba’s emergence as an attractive destination for the entire regional ecotourism sector is a mixed blessing, as it may disrupt the established appeal of established ecotourism hotspots in the Caribbean and Mexico.
questions.optionC: Despite its growing appeal as a potential asset to the regional ecotourism sector as a whole, Cuba may pose challenges to established ecotourism destinations in the Caribbean and Mexico as new ecotourism seekers consider alternative destinations.
questions.optionD: The regional ecotourism sector is in need of new and innovative ecotourism destinations, and Cuba may be the answer, even though it could pose a threat to established destinations in the Caribbean and Mexico.
questions.optionE: The regional ecotourism sector in its entirety sees potential in Cuba, but its considerable appeal poses a serious threat to the established ecotourism destinations in the Caribbean and Mexico.
questions.explanation: A, Küba'nın bölgesel ekoturizm sektörü için büyük bir fırsat olduğu ama yüksek potansiyeli nedeniyle Karayipler ve Meksika'daki yerleşik destinasyonlar için tehdit oluşturabileceği 'but' karşıtlığını değiştirmeden aktarır. E'deki 'poses a serious threat' kesinleştirmesi, orijinaldeki 'possible/potentially' belirsizliğini ortadan kaldırarak vurguyu kaydırır.

questions.promptText: The destructive effects of spending extended periods of time cut off from society have been recognised for centuries, if not thoroughly understood.
questions.turkishTranslation: Toplumdan uzun süre kopuk kalmanın yıkıcı etkileri, tam olarak anlaşılmasa da yüzyıllardır bilinmektedir.
questions.optionA: People may seclude themselves from others for long periods of time only although they realise that it might have harmful impacts; however, the reasons behind this practice have not been clearly explained for centuries.
questions.optionB: For centuries, we have been trying to find out why certain people keep themselves away from the public for a considerable amount of time and whether its impacts are detrimental.
questions.optionC: Separating yourself from other people for lengthy periods of time is thought to have harmful consequences that have often been observed but remain largely unexplained.
questions.optionD: While the devastating impacts of isolating yourself from the public for long periods of time have not fully comprehended, they have been acknowledged for centuries.
questions.optionE: It has been accepted for centuries that alienating yourself from the public can lead to damaging consequences, but why this may last for a long time has not been examined in detail.
questions.explanation: D, 'have been recognised for centuries, if not thoroughly understood' yapısındaki karşıtlığı ('tanınmış ama tam anlaşılmamış') 'have not fully comprehended... have been acknowledged for centuries' ile aynı yönde korur. E ise 'neden uzun sürdüğü' gibi orijinalde olmayan farklı bir soruya kayarak anlamı çarptırır.

questions.promptText: Flooded forests caused by the construction of hydropower dams can no longer act as carbon sinks and, as they decay, they release vast quantities of greenhouse gases.
questions.turkishTranslation: Hidroelektrik barajların yapımı nedeniyle sular altında kalan ormanlar artık karbon yutağı olarak işlev göremez ve çürüdükçe büyük miktarda sera gazı salarlar.
questions.optionA: Forests that have become waterlogged due to the building of hydropower dams cannot serve as carbon collectors any more, and they emit huge amounts of greenhouse gases as they decay.
questions.optionB: One of the adverse consequences of the building of hydropower dams is that forests could be flooded, which means they may not function as carbon sinks any more and will produce large quantities of greenhouse gases as they decay.
questions.optionC: Waterlogged forests caused by the construction of hydropower dams are vulnerable to decaying, and therefore, instead of serving as carbon collectors, they are more likely to release considerable amounts of greenhouse gases.
questions.optionD: As a result of the construction of hydropower dams, forests become waterlogged and cannot absorb carbon in sufficient amounts; rather, they release substantial quantities of greenhouse gases as they decay.
questions.optionE: Flooded forests caused by the erection of hydropower dams are bound to decay over time, and this is why the amount of carbon they absorb declines rapidly while the quantity of greenhouse gases they emit substantially increases.
questions.explanation: A, hidroelektrik barajların sel bastığı ormanların artık karbon yutağı olamadığı ve çürürken sera gazı saldığı iki ayrı olguyu 'and' bağlacıyla aynı kesinlikte ('can no longer... release') verir. C ve E'de çürümenin sel basmasının bir sonucu/zorunluluğu gibi gösterilmesiyle orijinalde olmayan ek bir nedensellik eklenir.

questions.promptText: Although modern ‘paleodiet’ movement proposes that our ancestors ate large amounts of meat, we still do not know the proportion of meat in their diet, nor how frequently meat was eaten.
questions.turkishTranslation: Modern 'paleo diyet' hareketi atalarımızın büyük miktarlarda et yediğini öne sürse de, diyetlerindeki et oranını ve etin ne sıklıkla yenildiğini hâlâ bilmiyoruz.
questions.optionA: Modern ‘paleodiet’ movement suggests that our ancestors consumed significant amounts of meat, yet evidence regarding the quantity of meat in their diet and the frequency of their meat eating is still lacking.
questions.optionB: Although modern ‘paleodiet’ movement is based on the assumption that our ancestors consumed meat in large amounts, it is difficult to be sure if they ate it frequently in huge amounts or not.
questions.optionC: Though modern ‘paleodiet’ movement suggests that our ancestors had to consume meat in large amounts, we still need convincing evidence to know the frequency and amount of their meat eating.
questions.optionD: Given that we are not sure of the frequency of our ancestors’ large amounts of meat consumption, modern ‘paleodiet’ movement cannot make claims about how much meat their diet contained.
questions.optionE: It would be possible to make assumptions on the amount of meat to be consumed according to modern ‘paleodiet’ movement if we had enough information about how much meat was eaten by our ancestors or how often they ate it.
questions.explanation: A, 'although... propose... but we still do not know' karşıtlığını 'suggests... yet evidence is still lacking' ile birebir korur; hem miktar hem sıklık bilgisinin eksik olduğu iki unsur da aktarılır. D ise nedensellik yönünü tersine çevirip, bilgi eksikliğini hareketin iddia edememesinin nedeni gibi gösterir.

questions.promptText: Mind-body spiritual practices, such as yoga and meditation, are asserted to help people soothe themselves, providing an antidote to the exalted self.
questions.turkishTranslation: Yoga ve meditasyon gibi beden-zihin ruhani uygulamalarının insanların kendilerini sakinleştirmesine yardımcı olduğu ve yüceltilmiş benliğe bir panzehir sunduğu iddia edilmektedir.
questions.optionA: Mind-body spiritual practices, such as yoga and meditation, have been shown to help people enjoy a feeling of serenity besides functioning as a suppressor for the exalted self.
questions.optionB: When people struggle to calm themselves down, they can try mind-body spiritual practices, such as yoga and meditation, which are claimed to constitute a counter-measure against the exalted self.
questions.optionC: People with an exalted self are recommended to benefit particularly from mind-body spiritual practices, such as yoga and meditation, to comfort themselves.
questions.optionD: Among the mind-body spiritual practices that have been thought to be a remedy helping people calm themselves down and pacify their exalted self are yoga and meditation.
questions.optionE: It is claimed that mind-body spiritual practices, such as yoga and meditation, provide people with assistance in calming themselves down, serving as a remedy against the exalted self.
questions.explanation: E, 'are asserted to help... providing an antidote' yapısını 'it is claimed that... provide assistance... serving as a remedy' ile aynı belirsizlik derecesinde (kanıtlanmamış bir iddia olarak) ve aynı iki işlevle (sakinleştirme + yüceltilmiş benliğe çözüm) korur. A'daki 'have been shown' ise iddiayı kanıtlanmış bir gerçeğe dönüştürerek kesinlik derecesini değiştirir.

questions.promptText: Learning about the universe and our place in it is one of the best experiences of childhood but few students try to explore the mysteries of the universe because of overwhelming workload at schools.
questions.turkishTranslation: Evren ve evrendeki yerimiz hakkında bilgi edinmek çocukluğun en güzel deneyimlerinden biridir, ancak okullardaki ağır iş yükü nedeniyle çok az öğrenci evrenin gizemlerini keşfetmeye çalışır.
questions.optionA: Regardless of excessive workload at schools, some students try to learn about the universe and our place in it and understand the mysteries of the universe, which is one of the best experiences of childhood.
questions.optionB: Huge workload at schools may discourage students from wondering about the universe and our place in it; however, there are those who try to investigate the mysteries of the universe, which is one of the best experiences of childhood.
questions.optionC: Although learning about the universe and our place in it is one of the best experiences of childhood, a small number of students try to investigate the mysteries of the universe due to excessive workload at schools.
questions.optionD: Despite being one of the best experiences of childhood, learning about the universe and our place in it and exploring the mysteries of the universe do not seem to attract the attention of most students because of huge workload at schools.
questions.optionE: There is a limited number of students who admit that learning about the universe and our place in it is one of the best experiences of childhood although investigating the mysteries of the universe may considerably increase the workload at schools.
questions.explanation: C, 'is one of the best experiences... but few students try... because of workload' yapısını 'although... a small number of students... due to excessive workload' ile aynı karşıtlık ve neden ilişkisiyle verir: az sayıda öğrencinin bunu keşfetmeye çalışmasının nedeni okul yüküdür. A ve B bu nedeni belirsizleştirip 'bazı öğrenciler deniyor' tonuna kaydırır.

questions.promptText: Because of a decrease in the sense of taste, older people often increase their salt intake as well as sugar, which can contribute to high blood pressure and nutrient loss.
questions.turkishTranslation: Tat alma duyusundaki azalma nedeniyle yaşlı insanlar genellikle tuz alımını şeker alımıyla birlikte artırır, bu da yüksek tansiyona ve besin kaybına yol açabilir.
questions.optionA: The rise in salt and sugar intake might lead to high blood pressure and nutrient loss as well as a decline in the sense of taste in older people.
questions.optionB: A decline in the sense of taste in older people frequently results in more salt and sugar consumption, potentially contributing to high blood pressure and nutrient loss.
questions.optionC: Older people frequently tend to have a decreased sense of taste as a result of the increase in their salt and sugar intake, leading to high blood pressure and nutrient loss.
questions.optionD: The contribution of high blood pressure and nutrient loss to the decline in the sense of taste in older people often manifests itself in increased salt and sugar consumption.
questions.optionE: An increased intake of salt and sugar, and therefore a decreased sense of taste often contribute to high blood pressure as well as nutrient loss in older people.
questions.explanation: B, zincirleme nedensellik sırasını ('tat duyusu azalması → tuz/şeker artışı → yüksek tansiyon ve besin kaybı') aynen korur: 'results in' ve 'contributing to' orijinaldeki 'because of' ve 'which can contribute to' ile eşleşir. Diğer seçenekler bu üç olgunun sıra/nedensellik ilişkisini tersine çevirir.

questions.promptText: The Crusaders have been suspected of returning to their countries with novel microorganisms, but it was the Portuguese, with their African exploration, who brought many in Europe into contact with tropical diseases for the first time.
questions.turkishTranslation: Haçlıların ülkelerine yeni mikroorganizmalarla döndüğünden şüphelenilmiştir, ancak Avrupalıları tropikal hastalıklarla ilk kez tanıştıranlar Afrika'yı keşfeden Portekizlilerdi.
questions.optionA: Although the Crusaders are thought to have brought new microorganisms when they returned to their countries, the Portuguese, in fact, introduced tropical diseases to a large number of people in Europe through their exploration of Africa.
questions.optionB: Despite the widespread suspicion that the African exploration by the Portuguese led many Europeans to be struck by tropical diseases, the Crusaders are thought to have brought unknown microorganisms when they returned to their countries.
questions.optionC: Tropical diseases in Europe first appeared when the Crusaders returned to their countries with microorganisms new to the Europeans; however, the Portuguese are believed to have introduced them through their African exploration.
questions.optionD: The Crusaders were not blamed for transferring tropical diseases to many in Europe because it was the Portuguese who returned to their countries from their African exploration with unfamiliar microorganisms.
questions.optionE: It has long been thought that the Portuguese, with their African exploration, caused tropical diseases to hit Europe, yet it was the Crusaders who had contact with new microorganisms for the first time and transmitted them to many people when they returned to their countries.
questions.explanation: A, 'have been suspected... but it was actually the Portuguese' karşıtlığını 'are thought to... but in fact, the Portuguese introduced' ile aynı yönde korur: şüphe Haçlılar üzerinde, gerçek fail ise Portekizlilerdir. B ve E bu şüphe/gerçek rollerini birbirine karıştırır, tam tersini söyler.

questions.promptText: Red supergiants form when a massive star runs out of hydrogen in its core and can no longer convert hydrogen into helium via nuclear fusion.
questions.turkishTranslation: Kırmızı süper devler, kütleli bir yıldızın çekirdeğindeki hidrojeni tükettiğinde ve nükleer füzyon yoluyla hidrojeni helyuma dönüştüremediğinde oluşur.
questions.optionA: Red supergiants are the outcome of a massive star’s depleting its hydrogen supplies in its core, due to its inability to turn helium into hydrogen through nuclear fusion.
questions.optionB: Red supergiants are created by a process in which a massive star fails to turn hydrogen into helium through nuclear fusion and therefore uses up its existing deposit of hydrogen.
questions.optionC: The emergence of a red supergiant leads to a massive star’s depleting the hydrogen in its centre and losing its ability to turn hydrogen into helium through nuclear fusion.
questions.optionD: The depletion of hydrogen at the centre of a massive star and its inability to produce helium out of hydrogen through nuclear fusion lead to the emergence of red supergiants.
questions.optionE: Red supergiants emerge if there is no longer enough hydrogen in the core of a massive star as it fails to make use of nuclear fusion to turn hydrogen into helium.
questions.explanation: D, 'form when... runs out of hydrogen and can no longer convert' nedensellik yönünü doğru korur: hidrojenin tükenmesi ve helyuma çevrilememe, kızıl süper devlerin oluşmasına yol açar ('lead to the emergence'). C'de bu neden-sonuç tersine çevrilmiş, süper devin oluşumu yıldızın hidrojen tükenmesine neden oluyormuş gibi gösterilmiştir.

questions.promptText: The use of natural gas is integrated into the economy of developed countries in many areas ranging from manufacturing to cooking, so decarbonising the natural gas systems is crucial to limit climate change.
questions.turkishTranslation: Doğal gazın kullanımı, üretimden yemek pişirmeye kadar birçok alanda gelişmiş ülkelerin ekonomisine entegre olmuştur, bu nedenle iklim değişikliğini sınırlamak için doğal gaz sistemlerinin karbondan arındırılması önem taşımaktadır.
questions.optionA: Although developed countries are aware of the importance of decarbonising natural gas systems to limit climate change, the use of natural gas is integrated into their economy in many areas of manufacturing and cooking.
questions.optionB: To limit their influence on climate change, many developed countries have given importance to decarbonise natural gas systems and integrated it into their economies in the areas ranging from manufacturing to cooking.
questions.optionC: Even if developed countries reduce the use of natural gas in their main economic fields such as manufacturing and cooking, it is still important for them to find ways of decarbonising the natural gas systems to control climate change.
questions.optionD: Given that the use of natural gas is an integral part of the economy of developed countries in many fields from manufacturing to cooking, it is essential to decarbonise the natural gas systems to keep climate change under control.
questions.optionE: Though developed countries keep using natural gas in many economic areas, among which manufacturing and cooking are the most important ones, they need to decarbonise natural gas systems due to climate change.
questions.explanation: D, 'is integrated... so decarbonising... is crucial' nedensellik yapısını 'given that... it is essential' ile aynı yönde ve aynı kesinlikte korur: doğal gazın ekonomiye derin entegrasyonu, karbonsuzlaştırmayı zorunlu kılar. A bu nedenselliği 'although' ile ters bir karşıtlığa çevirir.

questions.promptText: Caterpillars’ flesh contains more protein than chicken, so it is no surprise they are on the menu of so many insectivorous animals.
questions.turkishTranslation: Tırtılların eti tavuktan daha fazla protein içerir, bu yüzden bu kadar çok böcekçil hayvanın menüsünde yer almaları hiç de şaşırtıcı değildir.
questions.optionA: The flesh of caterpillars includes as much protein as chicken flesh does; therefore, one should not be surprised to learn that insect-eating animals like to eat them.
questions.optionB: Caterpillar flesh consists of higher amounts of protein compared to chicken flesh, which is unsurprisingly why they constitute a part of many insectivorous animals’ diet.
questions.optionC: It should be no surprise that, rather than eating chicken flesh which includes little protein, insect- eating animals feed on protein-rich caterpillar flesh.
questions.optionD: Due to higher amounts of protein in chicken, compared to caterpillar flesh, it is no surprise that chickens constitute a regular part of many insectivorous animals’ diet.
questions.optionE: Surprisingly enough, unlike chicken flesh, which contains a lower amount of protein, caterpillar flesh is an important item in the diet of insect-eating animals.
questions.explanation: B, 'contains more protein than chicken, so it is no surprise' nedensellik yapısını 'higher amounts of protein compared to chicken... which is unsurprisingly why' ile aynen korur. A'daki 'as much protein as' karşılaştırmayı eşitliğe çevirerek 'daha fazla' anlamını kaybeder, D ise protein üstünlüğünü tavuğa vererek tersine çevirir.

questions.promptText: Culturally shared ideas about language and its users are known as language ideologies, and they can profoundly shape attitudes toward speakers who do not speak prestigious dialects.
questions.turkishTranslation: Dil ve dilin kullanıcıları hakkında kültürel olarak paylaşılan fikirler dil ideolojileri olarak bilinir ve bunlar, prestijli diyalektleri konuşmayan kişilere yönelik tutumları derinden şekillendirebilir.
questions.optionA: It is probable that culturally shared ideas about a language and its users, also known as language ideologies, deeply affect the approaches to people who do not speak high-status dialects.
questions.optionB: Because culturally shared ideas about a language and its users are also known as language ideologies, the attitudes towards the speakers who do not speak prestigious dialects are totally shaped by these ideologies.
questions.optionC: Speakers often embrace language ideologies which can extremely affect their culturally shared ideas about language and the speakers who do not use highly-regarded dialects.
questions.optionD: People who do not speak highly-valued dialects most likely adopt attitudes promoted by language ideologies which are also known as culturally shared ideas about language and its users.
questions.optionE: Attitudes towards speakers who do not speak high-status dialects are constantly altered because of the culturally shared ideas about language and its speakers, also known as language ideologies.
questions.explanation: A, tanımı ('also known as language ideologies') ve etkisini ('deeply affect the approaches to people who do not speak high-status dialects') orijinaldeki 'profoundly shape attitudes toward' ile aynı yönde ve 'can' belirsizliğini ('it is probable') koruyarak verir. B bunu 'totally shaped' ile kesinleştirip aşırı iddialı hale getirir.

questions.promptText: Since the Middle Ages, humans have had a close relationship with honeybees as we have captured and reared them for their valuable and delicious honey.
questions.turkishTranslation: Orta Çağ'dan beri insanlar, değerli ve lezzetli balları için bal arılarını yakaladıkları ve yetiştirdikleri için bu hayvanlarla yakın bir ilişki içinde olmuşlardır.
questions.optionA: Since the Middle Ages, the relationship between humans and honeybees has been so close that humans have caught and raised them for their priceless and tasty honey.
questions.optionB: Since the Middle Ages, humans have caught and raised honeybees for their precious and tasty honey, so they have had a close relationship with these animals.
questions.optionC: The roots of the enduring connection between humans and honeybees have been dated before the Middle Ages, when we started to catch and rear them for their precious and tasty honey.
questions.optionD: Human beings’ close relationship with honeybees goes back to the Middle Ages although these animals were first captured and raised for their priceless and tasty honey.
questions.optionE: Since the Middle Ages, it is human beings who have been in direct contact with honeybees upon catching and rearing them for their precious and tasty honey.
questions.explanation: B, 'have had a close relationship... as we have captured and reared them' nedensellik yönünü korur: bal için yakalayıp yetiştirme, yakın ilişkinin nedenidir ('so they have had a close relationship'). A ise bu nedenselliği tersine çevirip ilişkinin yakınlığını yakalamanın nedeni gibi gösterir.

questions.promptText: While choosing a creative pastime activity, the important thing is to make sure that it is unrelated to tasks or surroundings that feel like work if you want to give your mind a rest.
questions.turkishTranslation: Yaratıcı bir boş zaman etkinliği seçerken önemli olan, eğer zihninize bir dinlenme fırsatı vermek istiyorsanız, bu etkinliğin iş gibi hissettiren görevlerle veya ortamlarla ilgisi olmadığından emin olmaktır.
questions.optionA: Even if you are in a work-related surrounding to complete a task, it is important to spare time and do a creative pastime activity unrelated to work to refresh your mind.
questions.optionB: Making a creative choice in your pastime activity is important if you want to achieve mental rest when you are away from work-related tasks and surroundings.
questions.optionC: Though adopting a creative pastime activity to soothe your mind is an important thing, you need to make sure it is not connected to work-related tasks or surroundings.
questions.optionD: Choosing a creative pastime activity is important if you want to ease your mind from the tasks and surroundings you associate with work.
questions.optionE: It is essential to avoid tasks or surroundings that resemble work when deciding which creative pastime activity to take on if you wish to ensure mental rest.
questions.explanation: E, odak noktasını orijinaldeki gibi 'işe benzeyen görev/ortamlardan kaçınma' şartına koyar ve bunun zihinsel dinlenme için gerekli olduğunu ('if you wish to ensure mental rest') aynı koşullu yapıyla verir. C ve D bu şartı 'önemli olma' ifadesine kaydırıp asıl vurgulanan kaçınma koşulunu ikincil hale getirir.

questions.promptText: The story of King Solomon meeting the Queen of Sheba inspired a rich literary tradition across Jewish, Christian and Islamic texts, although the geographic origins of the story still puzzle scholars to this day.
questions.turkishTranslation: Kral Süleyman'ın Saba Melikesi'yle buluşmasının hikayesi, Yahudi, Hristiyan ve İslami metinler boyunca zengin bir edebi geleneğe ilham vermiştir, ancak hikayenin coğrafi kökenleri bilim insanlarını bugüne kadar şaşırtmaya devam etmektedir.
questions.optionA: Still confusing scholars about where it took place, the story of the meeting between King Solomon and the Queen of Sheba gave rise to a rich literary tradition throughout Jewish, Christian and Islamic texts.
questions.optionB: The geographic origins of the story of King Solomon meeting the Queen of Sheba remain a mystery for scholars, although they acknowledge its impact on the rich literary tradition across Jewish, Christian and Islamic texts.
questions.optionC: The scholars studying the rich literary tradition in Jewish, Christian and Islamic texts still remain confused about the story and geographic origins of the meeting between King Solomon and the Queen of Sheba.
questions.optionD: While inspired by the story of the meeting that took place between the King Solomon and the Queen of Sheba, scholars are still confused about the geographic origins of rich tradition Jewish, Christian and Islamic texts.
questions.optionE: The story of King Solomon meeting the Queen of Sheba has prompted scholars to create a rich literary tradition in Jewish, Christian and Islamic texts, but the only thing that has still not been clarified is the exact location of this meeting.
questions.explanation: A, hikayenin edebi geleneği doğurduğu ('inspired') ile coğrafi kökeninin bilim insanlarını halen şaşırttığı ('still puzzle scholars') iki unsuru 'still confusing... gave rise to' şeklinde aynı yapıda koruyarak aktarır. D'de ise 'inspired by' ifadesi bilim insanlarının kendilerinin esinlendiğini söyleyerek öznesi yanlış yere kayar.

questions.promptText: As people age, the ability of white blood cells to deal with infections and respond to vaccinations declines, opening the door for illness or inflammation that can lead to chronic disease over time.
questions.turkishTranslation: İnsanlar yaşlandıkça, beyaz kan hücrelerinin enfeksiyonlarla baş etme ve aşılara tepki verme yeteneği azalır ve bu da zamanla kronik hastalığa yol açabilecek rahatsızlık veya iltihaba zemin hazırlar.
questions.optionA: When people age, chronic diseases caused by illness and inflammation increase because white blood cells dealing with infections and responding to vaccinations diminish in number over time.
questions.optionB: As people age, white blood cells to deal with infections and respond to vaccinations lose their strength, and this causes chronic diseases accompanied with illness and inflammation.
questions.optionC: While aging, people lose the ability to deal with infections and respond to vaccinations due to the decline in white blood cells, that is why chronic diseases due to inflammation increase over time.
questions.optionD: As people age, white blood cells lose the strength to deal with infections as well as respond to vaccinations, and this may cause illness or inflammation that leads to chronic disease as time progresses.
questions.optionE: Illness and inflammation can lead to chronic diseases as people age and this is because of the white blood cells’ incapacity to deal with infections and respond to vaccinations over time.
questions.explanation: D, zincirleme nedenselliği ('ability declines → opening the door for illness/inflammation → can lead to chronic disease') aynı sırayla ve aynı olasılık derecesiyle ('may cause... that leads to') korur. B, hastalık/iltihaplanma basamağını atlayıp beyaz kan hücrelerinin doğrudan kronik hastalığa neden olduğunu söyler.

questions.promptText: With bodies rarely above 15 cm long, tarsiers are one of the world’s smallest meat-eating primates living off largely insects, reptiles and birds.
questions.turkishTranslation: Vücutları nadiren 15 cm'den uzun olan tarsierler, ağırlıklı olarak böcek, sürüngen ve kuşlarla beslenen dünyanın en küçük et yiyen primatlarından biridir.
questions.optionA: Just as tarsiers have small bodies mainly under 15 cm in length, they feed off mainly insects, reptiles and birds as the smallest carnivore primate.
questions.optionB: Tarsiers, which have bodies barely longer than 15 cm, are among the tiniest carnivorous primates consuming mostly insects, reptiles and birds.
questions.optionC: Since tarsiers are under 15 cm in length and they have meat in their diet like insects, reptiles and birds, they are one of the world’s smallest meat-eating primates.
questions.optionD: Living among mostly insects, reptiles and birds, tarsiers are one of the few tiny carnivorous primates and have a body that is barely more than 15 cm in length.
questions.optionE: Tarsiers are one of the world’s smallest primates that prefer meat in the form of mainly insects, reptiles and birds whose bodies are rarely above 15 cm long.
questions.explanation: B, 'rarely above 15 cm' ifadesini 'barely longer than 15 cm' ile aynı anlamda korur ve tarsierlerin böcek, sürüngen ve kuşlarla beslenen en küçük etçil primatlardan biri olduğu bilgisini sadece yapısal olarak değiştirip içeriği aynen aktarır. C'de ise bu basit tanımlama yanlış bir 'since' nedensellik ilişkisine dönüştürülür.

questions.promptText: While the growth of cities may be associated with increasing prosperity, urban areas demonstrate the world’s most obvious health disparities in both low- and high-income countries.
questions.turkishTranslation: Şehirlerin büyümesi artan refahla ilişkilendirilebilse de, kentsel alanlar hem düşük hem de yüksek gelirli ülkelerde dünyanın en bariz sağlık eşitsizliklerini göstermektedir.
questions.optionA: The largest disparities in health are observed in both low- and high-income countries due to increasing prosperity that is connected to the growth of cities.
questions.optionB: As a result of the growth of cities with the purpose of creating more wealth, both low- and high-income countries have developed urban areas with health inequalities in the world.
questions.optionC: Both low- and high-income countries are experiencing the most obvious problem of health inequalities as the growth of cities has produced increasing wealth in urban areas.
questions.optionD: It is possible to link the growth of cities to more wealth; however, urban areas both in low- and high- income countries are places with the most apparent health inequalities in the world.
questions.optionE: The growth of cities is linked to an increase in prosperity as long as there is the apparent issue of urban health discrepancies in both low- and high- income countries of the world.
questions.explanation: D, 'while... may be associated with... but demonstrate the most obvious disparities' karşıtlığını 'it is possible to link... however... with the most apparent... disparities' şeklinde aynı zıtlık yapısıyla korur: şehirleşme refahla ilişkilendirilebilir ama kentsel alanlar en belirgin sağlık eşitsizliklerini gösterir. A ve C bu karşıtlığı kaldırıp refahı eşitsizliğin nedeni gibi sunar.

questions.promptText: Although it is incorrect to characterise adolescence as a time of inevitable family (conflict, early adolescence is a period of significant change in family relationships.
questions.turkishTranslation: Ergenliği kaçınılmaz bir aile çatışması dönemi olarak nitelendirmek doğru olmasa da, erken ergenlik aile ilişkilerinde önemli değişimin yaşandığı bir dönemdir.
questions.optionA: Early adolescence is a period of serious change in family relationships, so it may be wrongly considered as a time when frequent disagreements arise in the family.
questions.optionB: Early adolescence refers to a period of substantial change in family relationships; however, it would be wrong to characterise adolescence as a time when unavoidable family disputes occur.
questions.optionC: As adolescence is a time when inescapable family arguments break out, early adolescence is mistakenly believed to result in critical change in family relationships.
questions.optionD: Whereas early adolescence is regarded as a period during which family relationships undergo remarkable change, adolescence is incorrectly considered as a time when family disputes become more intense.
questions.optionE: Even though early adolescence is incorrectly characterised as a period of dramatic change in family relationships, adolescence is generally seen as a time when unavoidable family arguments occur frequently.
questions.explanation: B, hangi kavramın hangi özelliğe sahip olduğunu doğru eşleştirir: 'ergenlik' kaçınılmaz çatışma dönemi olarak yanlış karakterize edilirken, 'erken ergenlik' gerçekten önemli bir değişim dönemidir; bu ayrım 'however' ile korunur. D ve E ise bu iki kavramın (ergenlik/erken ergenlik) hangisinin yanlış, hangisinin doğru tanımlandığını birbirine karıştırır.

questions.promptText: If the benefits of zoos are negligible, animal advocates contend, then, keeping wildlife captive cannot be justified.
questions.turkishTranslation: Hayvan hakları savunucularının öne sürdüğüne göre, hayvanat bahçelerinin faydaları ihmal edilebilir düzeydeyse, vahşi hayvanları tutsak tutmak haklı gösterilemez.
questions.optionA: According to animal advocates, keeping wildlife captive is not justifiable even though zoos have several benefits.
questions.optionB: Despite the proven benefits of zoos, animal advocates believe that keeping wildlife captive is not justifiable.
questions.optionC: Animal advocates think that it is not possible to justify keeping wildlife captive unless there are significant benefits to be gained from the zoos.
questions.optionD: Animal advocates suggest that justifying the need to keep wildlife captive in zoos depends on how much benefit they offer.
questions.optionE: Regardless of the benefits of zoos, keeping wildlife captive is unacceptable for animal advocates to justify.
questions.explanation: C, orijinaldeki koşullu yapıyı ('if benefits are negligible, then cannot be justified') 'unless there are significant benefits... not possible to justify' ile mantıksal olarak eşdeğer şekilde korur. A, B ve E ise faydaların varlığını kesinleştirip koşullu/belirsiz yapıyı ortadan kaldırır.

questions.promptText: Communicative development in the first year of all infants occurs in the same way, regardless of the complexity of the language being acquired.
questions.turkishTranslation: Tüm bebeklerde ilk yılda iletişim gelişimi, öğrenilen dilin karmaşıklığından bağımsız olarak aynı şekilde gerçekleşir.
questions.optionA: While communicative development in the first year of all infants takes place in a similar way, the complexity of the language being acquired may impact this development.
questions.optionB: The complexity of an infant’s language determines whether he or she can learn to communicate more easily than others in his or her first year.
questions.optionC: Although some infants have a language that is more complex than those of others, their communicative development in their first year could occur more quickly.
questions.optionD: No matter how complicated their language is, every infant goes through the same process of communicative development in their first year.
questions.optionE: The complexity of the language being acquired has nothing to do with the communicative development in the first year of an infant, though it seems to do so.
questions.explanation: D, 'regardless of the complexity' yapısını 'no matter how complicated' ile birebir korur ve tüm bebeklerin ilk yılda aynı iletişimsel gelişim sürecinden geçtiğini değiştirmeden aktarır. A ise dilin karmaşıklığının gelişimi etkileyebileceğini söyleyerek orijinaldeki 'bağımsızlık' iddiasını tersine çevirir.

questions.promptText: Neuroscientists know a lot about how individual neurons operate but remarkably little about how large numbers of them work together to produce thoughts, feelings and behaviours.
questions.turkishTranslation: Nörobilimciler tek tek nöronların nasıl çalıştığı hakkında çok şey bilir, ancak büyük sayıda nöronun düşünceler, duygular ve davranışlar üretmek için nasıl birlikte çalıştığı hakkında şaşırtıcı derecede az şey bilirler.
questions.optionA: Neuroscientists’ comprehensive understanding of the workings of individual neurons may contribute significantly to what they know about large numbers of neurons, which are thought to work in cooperation to produce thoughts, feelings and behaviours.
questions.optionB: As they already know how neurons behave individually, what neuroscientists need to focus more on is how large neuron groups collaborate to produce thoughts, feelings and behaviours.
questions.optionC: Neuroscientists’ knowledge of how large numbers of neurons cooperate for the production of thoughts, feelings and behaviours is rather limited despite the fact that they have vast knowledge of how individual neurons work.
questions.optionD: Neuroscientists have already discovered enough about the functioning of individual neurons, and now they need to expand their knowledge of how large neuron groups produce thoughts, feelings and behaviours.
questions.optionE: Neuroscientists’ knowledge of how large numbers of neurons cooperate for the production of thoughts, feelings and behaviours is rather limited despite the fact that they have vast knowledge of how individual neurons work.
questions.explanation: D, 'know a lot about individual neurons but remarkably little about how they work together' karşıtlığını 'have already discovered enough... now need to expand their knowledge' ile aynı iki bilgi düzeyi arasındaki farkı koruyarak verir. B'deki 'need to focus more on' ise bilimsel bir eksiklik yerine öneri/talimat tonuna kayar, vurgusu farklıdır.

questions.promptText: Recent studies have suggested that underground water does not freeze despite temperatures being as low as -70°C, as it is prevented by salt present in the water.
questions.turkishTranslation: Son araştırmalar, yeraltı suyunun sıcaklık -70°C'ye kadar düşse de donmadığını, bunun suda bulunan tuz tarafından engellendiğini öne sürmüştür.
questions.optionA: It has been suggested by recent studies that because the salt in the water prevents freezing, water underground stays liquid even when the temperature is as low as -70°C.
questions.optionB: As recent studies have suggested, underground water freezes when the temperature reaches -70°C, despite the fact that salt in water generally prevents freezing.
questions.optionC: Recent studies have suggested that water remains liquid under the ground until the temperature reaches -70°C and enough salt is present.
questions.optionD: According to some recent studies, as underground water remains liquid even at temperatures as low as -70°C, the salt stops the water from freezing at higher temperature.
questions.optionE: Recent studies have maintained that as soon as the temperature reaches -70°C, the salt in underground water prevents its freezing.
questions.explanation: A, nedeni ('as it is prevented by salt') önce verip sonucu ('su -70°C'de bile donmaz') aynı mantıksal sırayla ('because... stays liquid even when') aktarır. B bu sonucu tam tersine çevirip suyun donduğunu söyler, bu da anlamı temelden bozar.

questions.promptText: Thinking about 'what-ifs' is commonly thought to be a futile exercise; however, it helps individuals make sense of their past experiences and prepare for the future.
questions.turkishTranslation: 'Ya öyle olsaydı' türünden düşünmek genellikle faydasız bir uğraş olarak düşünülür; ancak bu, bireylerin geçmiş deneyimlerini anlamlandırmasına ve geleceğe hazırlanmasına yardımcı olur.
questions.optionA: Thinking about 'what-ifs' is thought to be helpful in taking lessons from past experiences and being more cautious about the future, even though it is actually an exercise that has no meaning.
questions.optionB: Although it is widely believed to be an unnecessary exercise, making sense of past experiences lets individuals think about 'what-ifs', teaching them life lessons in the long run.
questions.optionC: People should think about their 'what-ifs' because it is not a pointless exercise; it is something that is useful and effective for both the past and future.
questions.optionD: Thinking about 'what-ifs' is not only a popular activity exercised by many, but also a sensible tool to make meanings of the past and get ready for future experiences in advance.
questions.optionE: Contrary to popular belief, thinking about 'what- ifs' is not a useless exercise; it is rather something that lets people make meaningful inferences about the past and get ready for the future.
questions.explanation: E, 'commonly thought to be futile; however, it helps' karşıtlığını 'contrary to popular belief, not useless; it is rather something that lets people...' ile aynı yönde ve aynı güçte korur: yaygın inanışın aksine bu egzersiz faydalıdır. A bu karşıtlığı tersine çevirip 'faydalı sanılıyor ama gerçekte anlamsız' diyerek doğru-yanlış yönünü değiştirir.

questions.promptText: The only time that an analysis procedure can help is when the user is fully aware not only of its strong points, but its shortcomings as well.
questions.turkishTranslation: Bir analiz prosedürünün yardımcı olabileceği tek durum, kullanıcının sadece güçlü yönlerinin değil, aynı zamanda eksikliklerinin de tam olarak farkında olmasıdır.
questions.optionA: The user is to be fully aware of both the strengths and weaknesses of an analysis procedure to be able to benefit from it.
questions.optionB: An analysis procedure should have more strong points than shortcomings in order for the user to be aware of its benefits.
questions.optionC: Both the strengths and weaknesses of an analysis procedure should be fully evaluated before the user becomes aware of its benefits.
questions.optionD: An analysis procedure can help the user only if the user acknowledges the strong points rather than its shortcomings.
questions.optionE: The shortcomings of an analysis procedure can reduce its benefits only when the user is not fully aware of its strong points.
questions.explanation: A, 'the only time it can help is when the user is fully aware of both strong points and shortcomings' koşulunu 'is to be fully aware of both... to be able to benefit' ile aynı tek koşul olarak korur. D ise 'rather than shortcomings' ifadesiyle zayıf noktaların farkında olma gerekliliğini tamamen çıkararak anlamı değiştirir.

questions.promptText: Although the household technological products are interesting to users from all age groups, they are particularly significant to older people with sensory or motor limitations, due to the high degree of operational comfort and safety they offer.
questions.turkishTranslation: Ev teknolojisi ürünleri tüm yaş gruplarından kullanıcıların ilgisini çekse de, sundukları yüksek derecede işlevsel konfor ve güvenlik nedeniyle duyusal veya motor kısıtlamaları olan yaşlı insanlar için özellikle önemlidir.
questions.optionA: Household technological products offer a high level of operational comfort and safety to people of all ages; nevertheless, it is the elderly who find them the most useful, especially if they have sensory and motor limitations.
questions.optionB: Household technological products attract the attention of consumers of all ages, but they are especially important to the elderly who have sensory and motor limitations as these devices provide a great degree of operational comfort and safety.
questions.optionC: Despite the fact that people from various age groups are interested in household technology, the biggest group who needs them is the elderly since they seek a high degree of operational comfort and safety because of their sensory and motor limitations.
questions.optionD: Household technological devices are significant for people of all ages, but they are especially important to those with sensory and motor limitations, such as old people, because these devices are comfortable and safe to operate.
questions.optionE: Though many people find household technological devices important owing to their high level of operational comfort and safety, these devices are particularly aimed at people with sensory and motor limitations, regardless of their age.
questions.explanation: B, 'interesting to all age groups but particularly significant to older people with limitations, due to operational comfort and safety' yapısını 'attract all ages, but especially important to the elderly... as these devices provide comfort and safety' ile aynı karşıtlık ve neden ilişkisiyle korur. A, ürünlerin konforu tüm yaşlara verdiğini söyleyip nedeni yaşlılara özgü olmaktan çıkarır.

questions.promptText: Some aspects of juvenile animal behaviour are precursors to adult animal behaviour, while others are vital for the survival of the young animal.
questions.turkishTranslation: Genç hayvan davranışının bazı yönleri yetişkin hayvan davranışının öncüleri olurken, diğerleri genç hayvanın hayatta kalması için hayati önem taşır.
questions.optionA: Because certain features of juvenile animal behaviour are essential to the survival of the young animal, adult animal behaviour is presupposed by others.
questions.optionB: Though some sides of juvenile animal behaviour are crucial to the survival of a young animal, other aspects predetermine adult animal behaviour.
questions.optionC: Even though some characteristics of juvenile animal behaviour give an example of adult animal behaviour, others are vital to the young animals that survive.
questions.optionD: While a few aspects of juvenile animal behaviour give us a preview of adult animal behaviour, others show us which young animals will survive.
questions.optionE: Although certain features of juvenile animal behaviour predict adult animal behaviour, others determine the likelihood of a young animal surviving.
questions.explanation: B, 'some aspects... precursors to adult behaviour, while others vital for survival' yapısındaki iki ayrı kategoriyi (yetişkin davranışının öncüsü / hayatta kalma için gerekli) sırası değişse de 'though... crucial to survival... other aspects predetermine adult behaviour' ile aynı içerikte korur. A ise bu ilişkiyi yanlış bir nedensellik ('because') haline getirir.

questions.promptText: Genuine laughter triggers the release of mood- boosting endorphins, which leads to a higher tolerance for pain.
questions.turkishTranslation: Gerçek kahkaha, ruh halini iyileştiren endorfinlerin salınımını tetikler ve bu da acıya karşı daha yüksek bir toleransa yol açar.
questions.optionA: Mood-enhancing endorphins are released only when people laugh heartily and thus they can tolerate pain better.
questions.optionB: People can tolerate more pain if their mood is enhanced by endorphins, which cause hearty laughter.
questions.optionC: If people want to enhance their mood, they should laugh heartily and tolerate pain better, which helps them release endorphins.
questions.optionD: To be able to laugh heartily by releasing endorphins that enhance their mood, people have to tolerate pain better.
questions.optionE: When people laugh heartily, their bodies release endorphins that enhance their mood, and they can tolerate pain better.
questions.explanation: E, zincirleme nedenselliği ('genuine laughter → triggers endorphin release → leads to higher pain tolerance') aynı sırayla 'when people laugh heartily, their bodies release endorphins... and they can tolerate pain better' şeklinde korur. B ise sırayı tersine çevirip endorfinlerin gülmeye neden olduğunu söyler.

questions.promptText: According to a study, 74% of photos we snap on our mobile phones are never looked at again, with selfies being the most easily forgotten shots.
questions.turkishTranslation: Bir araştırmaya göre, cep telefonlarımızla çektiğimiz fotoğrafların %74'üne bir daha hiç bakılmaz; en kolay unutulan çekimler ise özçekimlerdir.
questions.optionA: Research suggests that it is easy to forget that we have taken a selfie and 74% of such photos are taken with our mobile phones.
questions.optionB: A study suggests that 74% of photos we take using our mobile phones consist of selfies that are not viewed again, which makes us forget them easily.
questions.optionC: It was revealed by a research study that we easily forget to take a look again at 74% of photos we take with our mobile phones and selfies are some of them.
questions.optionD: A study finding pointed out that selfies are among 74% of photos we take which we easily forget to look at again on our mobile phones.
questions.optionE: A study revealed that 74% of photos taken with our mobile phones are not viewed again, including selfies, which are the shots that we forget the most easily.
questions.explanation: E, iki ayrı bilgiyi (fotoğrafların %74'ü tekrar bakılmıyor + selfie'ler en çabuk unutulan çekimlerdir) orijinaldeki gibi ayrı ayrı ve doğru ilişkiyle ('including... which are the shots that we forget the most easily') korur. B ve D, %74'ün sadece selfie'lerden oluştuğunu söyleyerek genel/özel ayrımını bozar.

questions.promptText: Although there are no known side effects associated with recommended dosages of saffron preparations in healthy individuals, people with chronic medical conditions should consult with their healthcare professional before taking the herb.
questions.turkishTranslation: Sağlıklı bireylerde önerilen dozlarda safran müstahzarlarıyla ilişkili bilinen bir yan etki olmasa da, kronik sağlık sorunları olan kişilerin bu bitkiyi almadan önce sağlık uzmanlarına danışmaları gerekir.
questions.optionA: If saffron preparations are consumed in sufficient amounts by healthy individuals and provide only benefits, then, it goes without saying that patients with chronic medical conditions can safely take them after consulting their healthcare specialist.
questions.optionB: It is advisable for individuals with chronic medical conditions to see their healthcare specialist prior to taking saffron treatments despite there being no side effects in healthy people when taken in suggested amounts.
questions.optionC: While little is known about the dangers for healthy individuals taking saffron preparations, it is certain that people with chronic medical conditions should approach their healthcare professional before consuming the herb.
questions.optionD: Since healthy individuals can freely take saffron preparations, patients with chronic medical illnesses can, after seeing their healthcare professional, take the herb in recommended dosages.
questions.optionE: Regardless of how much saffron an individual with a chronic medical condition can take after consulting their healthcare professional, it amounts only to the recommended amounts of the herb to avoid any side effects.
questions.explanation: B, 'although there are no known side effects in healthy individuals... people with chronic conditions should consult' karşıtlığını 'despite there being no side effects in healthy people... advisable for individuals with chronic conditions to see their specialist' ile aynı yönde korur. C ise sağlıklı bireyler için bilgi eksikliği olduğunu söyleyip 'no known side effects' kesinliğini belirsizliğe çevirir.

questions.promptText: The invention of television not a single event, but rather it depended on a chain of developments in electricity, telegraphy, and photography.
questions.turkishTranslation: Televizyonun icadı tek bir olay değildi; aksine elektrik, telgraf ve fotoğrafçılık alanındaki bir dizi gelişmeye bağlıydı.
questions.optionA: Though seeming as a distinct event, the invention of television had to wait for several developments in electricity, telegraphy, and photography.
questions.optionB: A variety of developments in electricity, telegraphy, and photography gave rise to the invention of television, which was seen as a remarkable event.
questions.optionC: Television did not come about all by itself, as a series of innovations in electricity, telegraphy, and photography led to its invention.
questions.optionD: But for the innovations in electricity, telegraphy, and photography, the invention of television could not have occurred as a spectacular event.
questions.optionE: Television developed as a specific invention; however, a set of developments in electricity, telegraphy, and photography became more important than its invention.
questions.explanation: C, 'not a single event, but rather depended on a chain of developments' ifadesini 'did not come about all by itself, as a series of innovations... led to its invention' ile aynı anlamda korur: televizyonun tek bir olay olmadığı, bir dizi gelişime bağlı olduğu net biçimde aktarılır. A ve D 'tek bir olay gibi görünme/olmama' vurgusunu farklı (bekleme, koşullu olmama) bir çerçeveye kaydırır.

questions.promptText: The system of logic, formulated by Aristotle and considered to include the laws that govern thought, remained unaltered until the 19th century.
questions.turkishTranslation: Aristoteles tarafından formüle edilen ve düşünceyi yöneten yasaları içerdiği düşünülen mantık sistemi, 19. yüzyıla kadar değişmeden kaldı.
questions.optionA: The 19th century witnessed a change in the system of logic, which was created by Aristotle after he defined the laws that govern thought.
questions.optionB: Throughout the 19th century, the system of logic developed by Aristotle was believed to involve the laws that govern thought.
questions.optionC: It was only in the 19th century that the system of logic, established by Aristotle and believed to include the laws that govern thought, began to change.
questions.optionD: In the 19th century, the system of logic, which was drawn up by Aristotle, went through a change because the laws that govern thought started to change as well.
questions.optionE: Aristotle is considered to have developed the system of logic, which embraces the laws that govern thought and has not been changed since the 19th century.
questions.explanation: C, 'remained unaltered until the 19th century' ifadesini 'it was only in the 19th century that... began to change' ile aynı zaman sınırını (19. yüzyıla kadar değişmedi, ancak o zaman değişti) koruyarak verir. E ise '19. yüzyıldan beri değişmedi' diyerek zaman ilişkisini tam tersine çevirir.

questions.promptText: Because eating disorders are neither purely physical nor purely psychological management and psychotherapy should be combined for effective treatment.
questions.turkishTranslation: Yeme bozuklukları tamamen fiziksel ya da tamamen psikolojik olmadığından, etkili tedavi için tıbbi tedavi ile psikoterapi birleştirilmelidir.
questions.optionA: While eating disorders can be separated into physical and psychological ones, successful treatment requires a combination of medical intervention and psychotherapy.
questions.optionB: Eating disorders can be treated effectively with medical intervention or psychotherapy, based on whether they are mostly physical or psychological.
questions.optionC: To treat eating disorders effectively, regardless of their classification as physical or psychological, medical management should be accompanied by psychotherapy.
questions.optionD: Given that eating disorders cannot be classified as only physical or psychological, effective treatment should include both medical intervention and psychotherapy.
questions.optionE: Since eating disorders are not only physical but psychological as well, psychotherapy should be administered more often than medical management to treat them successfully.
questions.explanation: D, 'neither purely physical nor purely psychological, so management and psychotherapy should be combined' nedensellik yapısını 'cannot be classified as only physical or psychological, effective treatment should include both' ile aynı yönde ve aynı kesinlikte korur. A bu durumu 'can be separated into physical and psychological' diyerek tam tersine çevirir.

questions.promptText: In the 1950s, popular demand for more powerful cars was met by manufacturers increasing the size of the engine and the rotation speed, although these changes were at the expense of fuel economy.
questions.turkishTranslation: 1950'lerde, daha güçlü otomobillere yönelik yaygın talep, üreticilerin motor boyutunu ve dönüş hızını artırmasıyla karşılandı, ancak bu değişiklikler yakıt ekonomisinden feragat edilerek gerçekleştirildi.
questions.optionA: In the 1950s, powerful cars with larger engines and faster rotation speed had a negative impact on fuel economy, so people wanted manufacturers to produce cars that would be fuel-efficient.
questions.optionB: Had there been no attempt by manufacturers in the 1950s to increase the size of the engine and the rotation speed, people might not have demanded more powerful cars, and thus fuel economy would have remained stable.
