questions.optionC: Even though it led to less economical fuel use, in the 1950s, manufacturers started to make bigger engines and increase the rotation speed to persuade people into buying cars that would become more powerful.
questions.optionD: People started to seek more powerful cars in the 1950s, and manufacturers responded to this by making engines bigger and the rotation speed faster, while it meant damaging the fuel economy.
questions.optionE: In the 1950s, manufacturers met people’s demand for more powerful cars by making the engine bigger and the rotation speed faster, but they were not able to predict that it would result in a worse fuel economy.
questions.explanation: D, olay sırasını ('talep → üreticilerin tepkisi → yakıt ekonomisine zarar, bu zararın kabul edilmiş/bilinen bir bedel olduğu') orijinaldeki 'although these changes were at the expense of' ile aynı şekilde korur. E'deki 'they were not able to predict' ise üreticilerin bu sonucu öngöremediğini söyleyip orijinalde olmayan bir bilgi ekler.

questions.promptText: Lightning sensors can pinpoint lightning strikes and provide initial attack crews with accurate locations; however, there are too many strikes to check them all, and not every strike results in a fire.
questions.turkishTranslation: Yıldırım sensörleri yıldırım çarpmalarının yerini tespit edebilir ve ilk müdahale ekiplerine kesin konumlar sağlayabilir; ancak kontrol edilmesi gereken çok fazla çarpma vardır ve her çarpma yangınla sonuçlanmaz.
questions.optionA: Although there are too many lightning strikes to check, and not all lead to a fire, lightning sensors are effective at detecting them and giving initial attack crews precise locations.
questions.optionB: There are too many lightning strikes to be checked, most of which do not cause a fire, but lightning sensors help initial attack crews identify them and find the precise locations.
questions.optionC: It is impossible to check all lightning strikes that cause a fire as there are too many of them; nevertheless, lightning sensors can provide specific locations so that initial attack crews can check them.
questions.optionD: Lightning sensors can identify lightning strikes and help to cope with fires through providing initial attack crews with the exact location, though it is not easy to check them all since there are too many strikes.
questions.optionE: Lightning sensors detect so many fires caused by lightning strikes that even if they show initial attack crews the exact location of these strikes, it is not easy to check them all.
questions.explanation: A, orijinaldeki üç bilgiyi (sensörler yıldırımları tespit edip konum verir; ama çok fazla yıldırım var hepsini kontrol etmek zor; ve her yıldırım yangına yol açmaz) 'although... and not all lead to a fire... sensors are effective' şeklinde aynı karşıtlık ve kapsamda korur. C bu bilgiyi sadece 'yangına yol açan yıldırımlar' ile sınırlayarak kapsamı daraltır.

questions.promptText: The birthday cake tradition in the United States is little more than a century old, but the relationship of cakes and celebration has a much longer history.
questions.turkishTranslation: Amerika Birleşik Devletleri'ndeki doğum günü pastası geleneği bir yüzyıldan biraz daha eskidir, ancak pastaların kutlamayla ilişkisi çok daha uzun bir geçmişe sahiptir.
questions.optionA: People in the United States have been traditionally celebrating birthdays with cakes for a long time since the two concepts were linked to each other around a century ago.
questions.optionB: It was thanks to the emergence of the birthday cake tradition in the United States less than a century ago that the enduring relationship between cakes and celebration was established.
questions.optionC: Despite the interconnection between cakes and celebration, it was not until a little more than a century ago that people in the United States began to celebrate birthdays with cakes.
questions.optionD: Although the birthday cake tradition in the United States has a history of slightly more than a century, cakes and celebration have been associated with each other for a considerably longer time.
questions.optionE: Until a little more than a century ago, people in the United States celebrated birthdays with cakes, but the traditional connection between cakes and celebration is a bit older than that.
questions.explanation: D, 'little more than a century old, but... much longer history' karşıtlığını 'has a history of slightly more than a century, although cakes and celebration have been associated for a considerably longer time' ile aynı zaman karşıtlığıyla korur. E'deki 'a bit older' ifadesi 'much longer' vurgusunu zayıflatarak süre farkını küçültür.

questions.promptText: People had long known of petroleum, but there seemed to be little commercial use until 1853 when Samuel Kier began using it to make kerosene, a cheap substitute for the whale oil commonly used in lamps.
questions.turkishTranslation: İnsanlar petrolü uzun süredir biliyordu, ancak 1853 yılına kadar ticari bir kullanımı pek yoktu; o yıl Samuel Kier, lambalarda yaygın olarak kullanılan balina yağına ucuz bir alternatif olan gazyağını üretmek için petrolü kullanmaya başladı.
questions.optionA: The development of kerosene in 1853 by Samuel Kier as an economical alternative to whale oil for lamps was not the first commercial use of petroleum because people had known about it for so long, but it was the most commercially successful enterprise.
questions.optionB: Though being known for a long time, petroleum did not seem to be much commercial until Samuel Kier developed it into kerosene in 1853 – a cheaper alternative to the whale oil commonly used in lamps.
questions.optionC: Although most people had long known about the commercial uses of petroleum, there was little development of the substance until 1853 when Samuel Kier started using it to make kerosene and marketing it as a cheap substitute for the whale oil commonly used in lamps.
questions.optionD: It was in 1853 that petroleum – a substance which people had long known about but did not seem to have much interest in – was used commercially for the first time by Samuel Kier to make kerosene, which was a more economical substitute to power lamps than the commonly used whale oil.
questions.optionE: In 1853, as the need for a more economical alternative to whale oil to power lamps arose, Samuel Kier saw an opportunity to make kerosene from petroleum – a substance long known for both its history and commercial uses.
questions.explanation: B, 'had long known of petroleum, but little commercial use until 1853 when Kier...' zaman ve karşıtlık yapısını 'though being known for a long time... did not seem to be much commercial until Kier developed it in 1853' ile birebir korur. C, 'insanların petrolün ticari kullanımlarını uzun zamandır bildiğini' söyleyerek orijinaldeki 'bilinmesine rağmen ticari kullanımın az olması' çarpıcı karşıtlığını bozar.

questions.promptText: Ageing is a complicated process, involving DNA damage, chronic inflammation, and worn-out cells, but we do not yet know which of these has the biggest impact on ageing.
questions.turkishTranslation: Yaşlanma, DNA hasarı, kronik iltihaplanma ve yıpranmış hücreleri içeren karmaşık bir süreçtir, ancak bunlardan hangisinin yaşlanmaya en büyük etkiyi yaptığını henüz bilmiyoruz.
questions.optionA: The combination of DNA damage, chronic inflammation and worn-out cells affects ageing to unknown extents, making it a complicated process.
questions.optionB: Because ageing is a complex process, the relationship between ageing and resultant effects of DNA damage, chronic inflammation and worn-out cells is largely unknown.
questions.optionC: As a complex process, ageing includes DNA damage, chronic inflammation and worn-out cells, though it is not clear which affects the ageing process the most.
questions.optionD: Ageing, which itself is a complicated process, damages DNA, causes chronic inflammation and wears out cells; however, we do not yet know which symptom is triggered by ageing the most.
questions.optionE: Ageing is characterised by damaged DNA, chronic inflammation and worn-out cells, but which one of these makes the process more complicated is yet to be determined.
questions.explanation: C, 'ageing involves DNA damage, inflammation, worn-out cells, but we do not know which has the biggest impact on ageing' yapısını 'ageing includes... though it is not clear which affects the ageing process the most' ile aynı öğe-bütün ilişkisiyle korur (bu üç unsur yaşlanmanın bileşenleridir, yaşlanmanın sonucu değildir). D ise nedensellik yönünü tersine çevirip yaşlanmanın bu üç şeye neden olduğunu söyler.

questions.promptText: Even if those at the bottom of the economic spectrum still enjoy some decent minimal standard of living, a concentration of wealth at the top will nevertheless undermine social cohesion.
questions.turkishTranslation: Ekonomik piramidin en altındakiler makul, asgari bir yaşam standardının tadını çıkarsa da, zenginliğin tepede yoğunlaşması yine de toplumsal bütünlüğü zayıflatacaktır.
questions.optionA: Although satisfaction of those at the bottom of the economic spectrum with a decent minimal standard of living is important for social cohesion, a concentration of wealth at the top is more destructive.
questions.optionB: A concentration of wealth at the top of the economic spectrum will still weaken social cohesion regardless of the fact that those at the bottom are satisfied with fairly low life standards.
questions.optionC: The disproportion of wealth between those at the top and bottom of the economic spectrum will still ruin social cohesion despite decent minimal living standards provided for the bottom.
questions.optionD: Minimally acceptable living conditions, although enjoyed by those at the bottom of the economic spectrum, are not sufficient if there is a concentration of wealth at the top, as they undermine social cohesion.
questions.optionE: Social cohesion will be threatened due to a minimal concentration of wealth at the top of the economic spectrum, even if those at the bottom benefit from acceptable living standards.
questions.explanation: E, orijinaldeki 'even if ... decent minimal standard of living' ile 'concentration of wealth at the top undermines social cohesion' ilişkisini aynı 'even if' karşıtlığıyla korur; sosyal uyumun tehdit edilmesi doğru özne-yüklem olarak taşınmıştır. Diğer seçenekler (B, C) anlamı genel olarak koruyor görünse de E orijinal yapıya en sadık ve dolaylı anlam kaymasına yer vermeyen seçenektir.

questions.promptText: Charisma refers to the qualities of those who possess the power of leadership either as a virtue of exceptional personality or characteristics not possessed by ordinary people.
questions.turkishTranslation: Karizma, liderlik gücüne, sıradan insanlarda bulunmayan istisnai bir kişilik özelliği veya nitelik olarak sahip olan kişilerin sahip olduğu niteliklere işaret eder.
questions.optionA: Charismatic people are those who have a unique personality and characteristics that are not possessed by ordinary people, such as the power of leadership.
questions.optionB: Charisma is possessed by people with the power of leadership, who have a distinguished personality and characteristics unlike ordinary people.
questions.optionC: The power of leadership that ordinary people do not have makes others with an exceptional personality or characteristics charismatic.
questions.optionD: Charisma is the quality of people who have the power of leadership due to their extraordinary personality or characteristics different from ordinary people.
questions.optionE: Ordinary people who do not have an exceptional personality or characteristics such as the power of leadership cannot have the qualities of charisma.
questions.explanation: B, 'charisma = liderlik gücüne sahip olanların niteliği' tanımını ve bu kişilerin sıradan insanlardan farklı kişilik/özelliklere sahip olduğu vurgusunu aynen korur. D ise sebep-sonuç ilişkisini ('due to') ekleyerek orijinalde olmayan bir nedensellik kurduğu için anlamı hafifçe çarptırır.

questions.promptText: While there are many satellite images showing deforested areas around the Amazon River, there are many other places like Brazil’s Kayapo which have been preserved by the local tribes living there.
questions.turkishTranslation: Amazon Nehri çevresinde ormansızlaşmış alanları gösteren pek çok uydu görüntüsü olsa da, Brezilya'daki Kayapo gibi orada yaşayan yerli kabileler tarafından korunmuş başka pek çok yer de vardır.
questions.optionA: According to satellite images, areas around the Amazon River have been occupied by local tribes, some of whom have been protecting territories like Brazil’s Kayapo while other areas have been left without trees.
questions.optionB: Large amounts of satellite images show that despite some deforestation, many areas such as the Amazon River and Brazil’s Kayapo have been mostly preserved by the local tribes living there.
questions.optionC: Although many satellite images reveal deforestation in areas around the Amazon River by the local tribes living there, they also show several other places like Brazil’s Kayapo that have been preserved.
questions.optionD: According to the satellite images of the Amazon River, local tribes that have been living in areas like Brazil’s Kayapo have been protecting these places, whereas other areas remain deforested.
questions.optionE: Brazil’s Kayapo includes many areas around the Amazon River that have been preserved from deforestation by the local tribes; however, a large number of satellite images reveal deforestation in other areas.
questions.explanation: D, orijinaldeki zıtlığı ('deforested areas' vs 'preserved by local tribes like Kayapo') 'protecting...whereas other areas remain deforested' yapısıyla doğru koruyor; Kayapo gibi bölgelerin yerel kabileler tarafından korunduğu, diğerlerinin ormansızlaştığı net biçimde aktarılmış. C, ormansızlaşmanın yerel kabilelerce yapıldığını ima ederek neden-sonucu tersine çevirir.

questions.promptText: Parrots have long been studied for their language abilities, but it seems the ability to use skills to solve problems also exists in their tool kit.
questions.turkishTranslation: Papağanlar uzun süredir dil yetenekleri açısından incelenmektedir, ancak görünüşe göre sorunları çözmek için becerileri kullanma yeteneği de onların repertuarında bulunmaktadır.
questions.optionA: In spite of having been studied for their language abilities, parrots also seem to have in their tool kit the ability to solve problems.
questions.optionB: Studying parrots for their language abilities has long been useful, but only if their tool kit involves problem solving skills as well.
questions.optionC: For many years, the language abilities of parrots have been studied as if their ability to solve problems co-exists in their tool kit.
questions.optionD: Parrots have a variety of skills such as problem solving abilities, although they have mostly been studied for their language capabilities.
questions.optionE: For a long time, researchers have studied the language abilities of parrots, however it seems that they also have the capacity to utilise their skills to solve problems.
questions.explanation: E, 'have long been studied for language abilities' ile 'but it seems also have problem-solving skills' arasındaki zıtlığı 'however...also' bağlacıyla tam olarak koruyor, zaman ve belirsizlik ('it seems') ifadesi de korunmuş. A bu zıtlığı 'in spite of' ile verse de 'it seems' belirsizliğini kaybediyor, bu yüzden E daha sadık bir çeviridir.

questions.promptText: Mentally healthy adults have a right to refuse medical intervention even if this is likely to result in fatal consequences.
questions.turkishTranslation: Zihinsel açıdan sağlıklı yetişkinler, bu durum ölümcül sonuçlar doğurma olasılığı taşısa bile, tıbbi müdahaleyi reddetme hakkına sahiptir.
questions.optionA: No matter how deadly the results of medical intervention are, mentally healthy adults are choosing to reject it.
questions.optionB: If they are mentally healthy, adults could reject medical intervention without considering whether or not such an intervention could result in some firm outcomes.
questions.optionC: Regardless of possible deadly results of rejecting medical intervention, adults who are mentally healthy have an entitlement to do it.
questions.optionD: It is a right for mentally healthy adults to oppose medical intervention even when they may be aware of possible deadly results.
questions.optionE: It is possible for mentally healthy adults to consider refusing medical intervention when they are aware of serious implications it could lead to.
questions.explanation: C, 'have a right' ifadesini 'have an entitlement' ile, 'even if this is likely to result in fatal consequences' zarf cümleciğini 'regardless of possible deadly results' ile birebir karşılayarak anlamı ve hak/izin vurgusunu korur. A ise 'çoktan seçiyorlar' anlamına kayarak hak kavramını kaybeder.

questions.promptText: While some people believe that video games are a waste of time, certain games can be a good vehicle for training specific skills, such as enhancing short-term memory, agility or reaction time.
questions.turkishTranslation: Bazı insanlar video oyunlarının zaman kaybı olduğunu düşünse de, belirli oyunlar kısa süreli hafızayı, çabukluğu veya reaksiyon süresini geliştirmek gibi özel becerileri geliştirmek için iyi bir araç olabilir.
questions.optionA: Although some people are convinced that video games are useful in teaching specific skills like improving short-term memory, agility or reaction time, some of them are futile activities, according to some others.
questions.optionB: Certain video games can be good means for practising some specific skills like improving short- term memory, agility or reaction time, but there are some people who believe that video games are of no use.
questions.optionC: Some people assume that video games are time- consuming, although they know that certain video games are efficient tools in teaching specific skills like improving short-term memory, agility or reaction time.
questions.optionD: Video games are thought to be time-consuming; however, they may be beneficial for some people practising certain skills like improving short-term memory, agility or reaction time.
questions.optionE: There are some people who presume that video games are beneficial in specific skills like improving short-term memory, agility or reaction time; however, those games could be a waste of time indeed.
questions.explanation: B, orijinaldeki 'certain games are good for training skills' ana fikrini ve 'some people believe they are a waste of time' zıt görüşünü doğru sırayla ve 'but' bağlacıyla aktarır. A ise kimin ne düşündüğünü ('bazıları yararlı, bazıları boş' şeklinde) ters çevirerek anlamı bozar.

questions.promptText: Since December 2014, the Breathe Project in the US has been making use of high definition cameras that let residents monitor the air pollution in their cities online.
questions.turkishTranslation: Aralık 2014'ten beri ABD'deki Breathe Projesi, sakinlerin şehirlerindeki hava kirliliğini çevrimiçi olarak izlemelerini sağlayan yüksek çözünürlüklü kameralar kullanmaktadır.
questions.optionA: US residents have been contributing to the Breathe Project since December 2014 by monitoring the air pollution in their cities with online use of high definition cameras.
questions.optionB: In the US, air pollution has been monitored online by the Breathe Project with high definition cameras since December 2014 in order to inform residents about the rates in their cities.
questions.optionC: Residents can reduce air pollution in their cities using online high definition cameras of the Breathe Project, which was launched by the US in December 2014.
questions.optionD: High definition cameras used by the Breathe Project in the US since December 2014 help residents combat air pollution in their cities through online monitoring.
questions.optionE: High definition cameras that have been utilised by the Breathe Project in the US since December 2014 enable residents to monitor the air pollution in their cities online.
questions.explanation: E, 'has been making use of cameras that let residents monitor' yapısını 'cameras...enable residents to monitor' ile eş anlamlı aktarır; özne (kameralar), zaman ('since 2014') ve amaç ('izleme', kirliliği azaltma değil) tam korunmuştur. D ise 'izlemeyi' 'mücadele etmeyi' (combat) olarak değiştirerek fiilin anlamını kaydırır.

questions.promptText: The growing awareness of the impact of job stress is best illustrated by the sheer increase in the volume of job stress research in recent years.
questions.turkishTranslation: İş stresinin etkisi konusundaki artan farkındalık, son yıllarda iş stresi araştırmalarının hacmindeki büyük artışla en iyi şekilde gösterilmektedir.
questions.optionA: The past few years have witnessed a dramatic rise in the amount of job stress research, which best demonstrates the increasing recognition of the impact of job stress.
questions.optionB: The influence of job stress has increased recently, which is best shown by the awareness that has been substantially enhanced by the growth in the amount of job stress research.
questions.optionC: People are becoming increasingly aware of the volume of job stress research, which has been best illustrated by the recent increase in the influence of job stress.
questions.optionD: Lately, there has been more research in the field of job stress, which means that it may lead to a higher level of consciousness about the influence of job stress.
questions.optionE: Although there has been a considerable increase in the number of studies on job stress recently, there is still a need for greater understanding of the influence of job stress.
questions.explanation: A, orijinaldeki 'kanıt-sonuç' yönünü doğru korur: araştırma hacmindeki artış (kanıt), iş stresinin etkisine dair artan farkındalığın (sonuç) en iyi göstergesidir. B ve C bu kanıt-sonuç ilişkisini tersine çevirerek hangisinin hangisini gösterdiğini karıştırır.

questions.promptText: While in Holland, John Locke had time to complete a number of important works that established his reputation as England’s foremost political theorist.
questions.turkishTranslation: Hollanda'dayken John Locke, kendisine İngiltere'nin en önde gelen siyasi teorisyeni olarak ün kazandıran bir dizi önemli eseri tamamlamaya zaman bulmuştur.
questions.optionA: Whereas John Locke wrote many of his important works in Holland, he earned a reputation as the most important political theorist in England.
questions.optionB: John Locke, who was famous for being England’s principal political theorist, spent some time in Holland to produce some of his most important works.
questions.optionC: His stay in Holland, during which he completed most of his important works, helped John Locke to be accepted as one of the most significant political theorists of England.
questions.optionD: Thanks to several important works he finished during his stay in Holland, John Locke made quite a name for himself as the leading political theorist of England.
questions.optionE: It was the countless important works he finalised in Holland that earned him a name as one of the most prominent political theorists in England.
questions.explanation: D, 'Hollanda'da tamamladığı önemli eserler sayesinde ünlendi' neden-sonuç ilişkisini 'thanks to...made quite a name' ile birebir korur ve 'foremost' vurgusunu 'leading' ile taşır. A ise 'whereas' kullanarak orijinalde olmayan bir zıtlık ima eder, bu da nedensellik ilişkisini bozar.

questions.promptText: Delicately carved from mammoth tusk, the Lady of Brassempouy was discovered in southwest France in 1894 and is among the oldest representations of a human face.
questions.turkishTranslation: Mamut dişinden ince işçilikle oyulmuş olan Brassempouy Hanımı, 1894'te Fransa'nın güneybatısında keşfedilmiştir ve bir insan yüzünün en eski tasvirlerinden biridir.
questions.optionA: The oldest representation of a human’s face is an 1894 mammoth tusk, delicate carving of the Lady of Brassempouy, which was found in southwest France.
questions.optionB: The Lady of Brassempouy, representing the oldest human face, was made from gently carved mammoth tusk and unearthed in southwest France in 1894.
questions.optionC: Found in 1894 in southwest France, the Lady of Brassempouy is one of the oldest representations of a human face, gently carved from the tusk of a mammoth.
questions.optionD: Amongst many delicate mammoth tusk carvings of the human face, the Lady of Brassempouy is the oldest and its discovery was made in southwest France in 1894.
questions.optionE: One of the oldest delicate human face carvings, the Lady of Brassempouy was identified in 1894 to be made of mammoth tusk in southwest France.
questions.explanation: C, 'among the oldest' (en eskilerden biri, 'the' oldest değil) ifadesini 'one of the oldest' ile doğru koruyor; A ve B 'the oldest' diyerek orijinalde olmayan kesinlik ekler. Ayrıca keşif yılı, yer ve malzeme (mamut dişi) detayları eksiksiz ve doğru biçimde taşınmıştır.

questions.promptText: While professional advertisers scoff at the idea, the general public seems to assume that subliminal advertising is widely and effectively practiced.
questions.turkishTranslation: Profesyonel reklamcılar bu fikirle alay etse de, genel halk bilinçaltı reklamcılığın yaygın ve etkili bir şekilde uygulandığını varsaymaktadır gibi görünmektedir.
questions.optionA: Despite the fact that professional advertisers ridicule the public for believing in the widespread and efficient use of subliminal advertising, the public still insists on doing so.
questions.optionB: As professional advertisers praise this concept, an increasing portion of the population also believes that subliminal advertising is commonly and efficiently used.
questions.optionC: Professional advertisers appear to be praising the idea that subliminal advertising is generally practiced, an assumption commonly held by the general public.
questions.optionD: It appears that ordinary people believe subliminal advertising is extensively and successfully carried out although professional advertisers laugh at this notion.
questions.optionE: The general population thinks that there are some people who make use of subliminal advertising efficiently; however, professional advertisers seem to think the opposite.
questions.explanation: D, 'scoff at' (küçümsemek/alay etmek) fiilini 'laugh at this notion' ile, 'general public seems to assume' belirsizliğini 'it appears that...believe' ile doğru aktarır ve profesyonellerin alay etmesiyle halkın inancı arasındaki zıtlığı korur. B ve C ise 'scoff' (alay etmek) fiilini yanlışlıkla 'praise' (övmek) olarak çevirip anlamı tam tersine çevirir.

questions.promptText: The years following the 1789 revolution in France brought massive upheaval in French society, which, in turn, produced profound changes in dress and fashion.
questions.turkishTranslation: Fransa'da 1789 devriminden sonraki yıllar, Fransız toplumunda büyük bir kargaşa getirmiş, bu da giyim ve modada köklü değişikliklere yol açmıştır.
questions.optionA: Although the revolution took place in France in 1789, it was only after many years that French society went through considerable changes in dress and fashion following this great disturbance in their society.
questions.optionB: The revolution in France in 1789 led to a serious disturbance among people in French society, and this was the reason why the French had to allow for fundamental and important changes in dress and fashion.
questions.optionC: If it were not for the revolution in France in 1789, dress and fashion in French society might not have changed considerably despite the enormous disturbance it caused in their society.
questions.optionD: What contributed to the revolution in France in 1789 were the major changes in dress and fashion, which resulted from the huge confusion experienced by French society at that time.
questions.optionE: It was not until after the revolution in France in 1789 that French society experienced dramatic changes in dress and fashion, due to the enormous turmoil generated by this period.
questions.explanation: E, zincirleme neden-sonucu ('devrim sonrası yıllar -> büyük kargaşa -> moda/giyimde köklü değişim') 'it was not until...that...due to' yapısıyla doğru sırada korur. D bu zinciri tersine çevirip giyim değişikliklerinin devrime sebep olduğunu söyleyerek anlamı tamamen bozar.

questions.promptText: The fierce debate among scientists over whether intelligence is inherited or acquired later is yet to be resolved.
questions.turkishTranslation: Zekânın kalıtsal mı yoksa daha sonra edinilmiş mi olduğu konusundaki bilim adamları arasındaki şiddetli tartışma henüz çözülmemiştir.
questions.optionA: Scientists have not still agreed upon how much of intelligence is inherited and how much of it is acquired after birth.
questions.optionB: Whether people are innately endowed with intelligence or they acquire it at a later time has stimulated an intense debate among scientists.
questions.optionC: A hot debate among scientists revolves around the inheritance of intelligence rather than its acquisition in the following years.
questions.optionD: The heated debate among scientists over whether people are born with intelligence or they acquire it later has not still ended in agreement.
questions.optionE: The fact that intelligence can be both inherited and acquired in later years has been vigorously debated by scientists.
questions.explanation: D, 'fierce debate...is yet to be resolved' ifadesini 'heated debate...has not still ended in agreement' ile hem tartışmanın şiddetini hem de henüz çözülmemiş olma durumunu tam karşılar. A 'ne kadarı kalıtsal, ne kadarı edinilmiş' sorusuna indirgeyerek orijinaldeki 'ya kalıtsal ya edinilmiş' ikilemini (either/or) kaybeder.

questions.promptText: According to a recent study, there are more overfed people in the world today than those who do not have enough food to eat.
questions.turkishTranslation: Son bir araştırmaya göre, bugün dünyada yeterince yiyecek bulamayanlardan daha fazla fazla kilolu/beslenen insan bulunmaktadır.
questions.optionA: A new study shows that there is a significant increase in the number of overfed people worldwide when compared to those who suffer from a lack of food.
questions.optionB: A recent study reveals that, across the world, overfed people now outnumber those who are malnourished.
questions.optionC: A current study suggests that, in today’s world, the difference between the number of people who do not have enough food and that of those who overeat is slight.
questions.optionD: The claim that there are as many overfed people as malnourished people in the world today has been proven by a recent study.
questions.optionE: A new study has found that malnourished people are far greater in number than overfed people in the entire world today.
questions.explanation: B, 'more overfed people than those without enough food' karşılaştırmasını 'overfed people now outnumber those who are malnourished' ile doğru sayısal üstünlük ilişkisiyle korur. A ise karşılaştırmayı 'önemli bir artış' olarak değiştirip kıyaslamanın yönünü belirsizleştirir, C ise farkın az olduğunu söyleyerek anlamı tersine çevirir.

questions.promptText: It is imperative that women start modifying their risk factors when they are younger in order to reduce the risk of developing heart disease once they are older.
questions.turkishTranslation: Kadınların, daha yaşlandıklarında kalp hastalığı geliştirme riskini azaltmak için risk faktörlerini daha genç yaşlardayken değiştirmeye başlamaları zorunludur.
questions.optionA: If women immediately begin changing their risk factors when they are still young, they may decrease their risk of developing heart disease in their old ages.
questions.optionB: Women are recommended to start changing their risk factors at young ages rather than old ages, because this will reduce the risk of developing heart disease.
questions.optionC: It is extremely important for women to begin changing their risk factors when they are young because it might not be easy to decrease the risk of having heart disease in their old ages.
questions.optionD: Women should immediately begin changing their risk factors at a young age so that they can decrease the risk of having heart disease in their old ages.
questions.optionE: It is urgent that women begin changing their risk factors at a young age, otherwise the risk of developing heart disease among old women cannot be decreased.
questions.explanation: D, 'it is imperative' zorunluluk ifadesini 'should...so that' amaç bağlacıyla doğru aktarır; gençken risk faktörlerini değiştirmenin yaşlılıkta kalp hastalığı riskini azaltma amacı ('in order to reduce') aynen korunmuştur. A bu zorunluluğu olasılığa ('may decrease') indirgeyerek vurguyu zayıflatır.

questions.promptText: It is already known that flowers display their bright colours and use their beautiful scents to lure bees; however, scientists have recently discovered that they use electric fields as well.
questions.turkishTranslation: Çiçeklerin arıları çekmek için parlak renklerini sergilediği ve güzel kokularını kullandığı zaten bilinmektedir; ancak bilim adamları son zamanlarda elektrik alanları da kullandıklarını keşfetmişlerdir.
questions.optionA: Scientists used to believe that flowers avoided using electric fields to attract bees despite utilising their vivid colours and scents, but now they suggest electric fields are also used.
questions.optionB: It is common knowledge that bees are attracted by flowers’ bright colours and beautiful scents, but what draws scientists’ attention more these days is the electric fields that flowers also use.
questions.optionC: It has long been known that flowers use several methods to attract bees, such as displaying striking colours and using their appealing scents, but scientists now think that flowers use electric fields for the same purpose.
questions.optionD: In addition to the exploitation of their bright colours and beautiful scents, flowers make use of electric fields to attract bees, which has long been known by scientists.
questions.optionE: The fact that flowers manifest their brilliant colours and benefit from their pleasant scents to attract bees has been known for a while, but what scientists have recently revealed is their use of electric fields.
questions.explanation: E, 'already known' (renk/koku) ile 'recently discovered' (elektrik alanları) arasındaki zaman zıtlığını 'known for a while' - 'recently revealed' ile doğru koruyor. D ise elektrik alanlarının da uzun süredir bilindiğini söyleyerek 'recently discovered' unsurunu yok eder, bu da anlamı bozar.

questions.promptText: Exercise both strengthens our muscles and encourages the production of special chemicals called endorphins, which make us feel good and act to reduce pain.
questions.turkishTranslation: Egzersiz, hem kaslarımızı güçlendirir hem de bizi iyi hissettiren ve ağrıyı azaltmaya yarayan endorfin adı verilen özel kimyasalların üretimini destekler.
questions.optionA: In addition to having stronger muscles through exercising, we are in a better mood and feel less pain thanks to special chemicals, endorphins, that it activates.
questions.optionB: In order for our body to generate more endorphins – the special chemicals that make us happier and reduce pain – and to strengthen our muscles, we should exercise.
questions.optionC: Making our muscles stronger with exercise produces special chemicals, such as endorphins, in the body and makes us feel good by relieving pain.
questions.optionD: The production of important chemicals like endorphins not only strengthens our muscles but also encourages us to do exercise to feel better and feel less pain.
questions.optionE: Endorphins, special chemicals which are produced while exercising, strengthen our muscles as well as making us happier by reducing pain.
questions.explanation: A, egzersizin özne olarak iki etkisini ('strengthens muscles' ve 'encourages endorphin production') koruyarak kasların güçlenmesini ve endorfinlerin iyi hissettirip ağrıyı azaltmasını doğru nedensellikle aktarır. C ise kas güçlenmesinin endorfin üretimine sebep olduğunu söyleyerek orijinaldeki bağımsız iki etkiyi yanlış biçimde birbirine bağlar.

questions.promptText: Chameleons cannot generate their own body heat so when they want to warm themselves, their colour will darken to absorb more heat from the sun.
questions.turkishTranslation: Bukalemunlar kendi vücut ısılarını üretemezler, bu nedenle ısınmak istediklerinde renkleri, güneşten daha fazla ısı emmek için kararır.
questions.optionA: Once their colours darken, chameleons can get more heat from the sun, but to warm themselves much better, they have to produce their own body heat.
questions.optionB: When chameleons transform themselves into a dark colour, they take in more heat from the sun and warm themselves easily, which helps them control their own body heat.
questions.optionC: Chameleons can warm themselves with the heat from the sun thanks to the dark colours they change into, and that is why they do not need to generate their own body heat.
questions.optionD: Because chameleons are not capable of providing their own body heat, their colour gets darker so that more heat is received from the sun, and they can warm themselves.
questions.optionE: Chameleons’ body heat is linked to dark colours because when they are darker, more heat from the sun can be absorbed, otherwise they cannot warm themselves.
questions.explanation: D, orijinaldeki neden-sonuç zincirini ('kendi vücut ısısını üretemezler -> renk koyulaşır -> güneşten daha fazla ısı alır -> ısınırlar') 'because...so that...and' yapısıyla aynı sırayla ve doğru nedensellikle korur. C ise bu nedenselliği tersine çevirip renk değişiminin vücut ısısı üretmemelerinin sebebi olduğunu ima eder.

questions.promptText: Rome expanded from a small Italian city-state to a world power not just by conquering other societies but also by assimilating them.
questions.turkishTranslation: Roma, küçük bir İtalyan şehir devletinden dünya gücüne sadece diğer toplumları fethederek değil, aynı zamanda onları asimile ederek genişlemiştir.
questions.optionA: Rome, which was initially a small Italian city-state, evolved into a world power by both assimilating and conquering other societies.
questions.optionB: Rome could not have developed into a world power from a small Italian city-state if it had not been able to conquer other societies and assimilate them.
questions.optionC: What led Rome to emerge as a world power was the assimilation of various societies it conquered, otherwise it would have remained as a small Italian city-state.
questions.optionD: The reason why Rome turned into a world power from a small Italian city-state is that it placed a higher priority on the assimilation of other societies than on their conquest.
questions.optionE: Rome, which was a small Italian city-state at the very beginning, conquered and assimilated other societies that had been struggling to become a world power.
questions.explanation: A, 'not just by conquering but also by assimilating' yapısındaki 'her ikisi de' vurgusunu 'by both assimilating and conquering' ile eşit önemde koruyarak küçük şehir devletinden dünya gücüne dönüşümü doğru aktarır. D ise asimilasyona fethetmekten daha fazla öncelik verildiğini söyleyerek orijinalde olmayan bir hiyerarşi (öncelik sırası) ekler.

questions.promptText: English is a mother tongue for many people in the world, who are increasingly outnumbered by those who learn English as a foreign language.
questions.turkishTranslation: İngilizce, dünyadaki birçok insan için ana dildir ve bu kişiler, İngilizceyi yabancı dil olarak öğrenenler tarafından giderek daha fazla sayıca geride bırakılmaktadır.
questions.optionA: English, either the mother tongue or foreign language of many people, is being spoken in almost every part of the world.
questions.optionB: Although English is being learnt as a foreign language more widely than ever, there are also a large amount of people whose first language is English.
questions.optionC: Lots of people around the world are native speakers of English; however, the number of learners of English as a foreign language has far surpassed the number of its native speakers.
questions.optionD: Throughout the world, there is a significant gap between people who speak English as their first language and those who learn it as a foreign language.
questions.optionE: In the past, the number of English native speakers was greater than those who had been learning English as a foreign language, but now it is not the case.
questions.explanation: C, 'outnumbered by' ifadesindeki sayısal üstünlük yönünü ('yabancı dil öğrenenler sayıca ana dil konuşanları geride bıraktı') 'far surpassed' ile doğru yönde ve artan eğilimi vurgulayarak korur. D ise sadece bir 'fark' olduğunu söyler, hangi grubun daha fazla olduğunu belirtmediği için eksik/yetersizdir.

questions.promptText: Many districts in Arizona are considering the possibility of lowering the age of partial responsibility to 12 due to the increase in the number of crimes committed by criminals under the age of 14.
questions.turkishTranslation: Arizona'daki birçok bölge, 14 yaşından küçük suçluların işlediği suçların sayısındaki artış nedeniyle kısmi sorumluluk yaşını 12'ye düşürme olasılığını değerlendirmektedir.
questions.optionA: Many local authorities in Arizona are thinking of lowering the age of partial responsibility to 12 in order to prevent crimes committed by criminals under the age of 14.
questions.optionB: Crimes committed by those under the age of 14 are becoming more common, and thus many localities in Arizona are thinking of lowering the age of partial responsibility to 12.
questions.optionC: The possibility of lowering the age of partial responsibility to 12 is being discussed in many regions of Arizona because of the immensely growing number of crimes committed by 14-year-old individuals.
questions.optionD: The increasing number of criminals under the age of 14 has led to an agreement in localities in Arizona to lower the age of partial responsibility to 12.
questions.optionE: Criminals under the age of 14 are committing more crimes than ever before, which will probably force the authorities in Arizona to consider lowering the age of partial responsibility to 12.
questions.explanation: B, 'due to the increase in crimes' sebebini önce verip 'thus' ile sonucu (yaş sınırını düşürmeyi düşünmek) bağlayarak orijinal neden-sonuç sırasını korur, ayrıca 'considering the possibility' (henüz kesinleşmemiş düşünme aşaması) ifadesini 'thinking of' ile doğru aktarır. D ise bunun kesin bir 'anlaşmaya' (agreement) dönüştüğünü söyleyerek henüz düşünce aşamasında olan bir durumu kesinleştirir.

questions.promptText: Even though there is sufficient water available to cover the demands of the world population, there is a shortage of clean water due to increased pollution.
questions.turkishTranslation: Dünya nüfusunun taleplerini karşılamaya yetecek kadar su mevcut olsa da, artan kirlilik nedeniyle temiz su kıtlığı vardır.
questions.optionA: We are consuming clean water in order to satisfy our demands but there is increasing contamination all over the world.
questions.optionB: It is necessary to have sufficient water to cover the demands of all people as increased pollution causes a shortage of clean water.
questions.optionC: Increased contamination leads to a shortage of clean water in spite of the availability of water enough to meet the needs of the world population.
questions.optionD: Despite increased pollution and a shortage of water, there should be enough water to satisfy the demands of people.
questions.optionE: Because of increased pollution and a shortage of water, we should find enough resources to satisfy our water demand.
questions.explanation: C, 'even though there is sufficient water...there is a shortage of clean water due to pollution' zıtlık-neden yapısını 'leads to...in spite of' ile tam doğru biçimde korur: su yeterli olsa da kirlilik temiz su kıtlığına yol açıyor. D ve E ise 'su kıtlığı' ve 'kirlilik'i aynı kefeye koyup orijinaldeki 'su yeterli ama kirlilik yüzünden temiz su azlığı var' ayrımını kaybeder.

questions.promptText: Despite the fact that obesity is one of the biggest causes of preventable deaths after smoking and is linked to chronic diseases, obesity rates keep increasing.
questions.turkishTranslation: Obezitenin sigaradan sonra önlenebilir ölümlerin en büyük nedenlerinden biri olmasına ve kronik hastalıklarla bağlantılı olmasına rağmen, obezite oranları artmaya devam etmektedir.
questions.optionA: Although chronic diseases that are associated with obesity and smoking can be avoided, the number of people who die of obesity and who become chronically ill goes up.
questions.optionB: The number of people who suffer from obesity continues to rise even though, along with smoking, it is one of the major factors that account for avoidable deaths and causes long-term diseases.
questions.optionC: In spite of being one of the major causes of deaths that can be avoided and resulting in serious diseases, the number of people who are obese is still higher than the number of people who smoke.
questions.optionD: The rate of obesity and the number of people who smoke continue to go up even though they are the main causes of deaths that can be prevented and are connected with chronic diseases.
questions.optionE: Obesity and smoking are illnesses that can lead to preventable deaths, and they are associated with chronic diseases; however, people still continue to suffer from obesity and smoking-related diseases.
questions.explanation: B, özne olarak sadece 'obesity rates'in arttığını (sigaranın artmadığını, sadece karşılaştırma unsuru olduğunu) ve obezitenin sigaradan sonra önlenebilir ölümlerin ve kronik hastalıkların başlıca sebeplerinden biri olduğunu doğru koruyor. D ise sigara kullananların sayısının da arttığını söyleyerek orijinalde olmayan bir iddia ekler.

questions.promptText: Like other interventions, hypnotherapy can be regarded as effective only if it proves more powerful than a placebo.
questions.turkishTranslation: Diğer müdahaleler gibi, hipnoterapi de ancak bir plasebodan daha güçlü olduğunu kanıtlarsa etkili sayılabilir.
questions.optionA: Hypnotherapy is similar to other practices in that it is considered as effective as a placebo.
questions.optionB: Similar to other treatments, hypnotherapy could be influential even if a placebo is actually stronger.
questions.optionC: Provided that hypnotherapy becomes stronger than a placebo, it can be considered as effective as other applications.
questions.optionD: Even if hypnotherapy acts as a placebo, it may be as effective as many other treatments.
questions.optionE: Although it is like other practices, hypnotherapy can be more effective than a placebo.
questions.explanation: C, 'only if it proves more powerful than a placebo' koşulunu 'provided that...becomes stronger than a placebo' ile doğru koşul bağlacıyla korur ve diğer tedaviler gibi etkili sayılması bu koşula bağlıdır. B ise plasebonun daha güçlü olmasına rağmen hipnoterapinin etkili olabileceğini söyleyerek koşulu tersine çevirir.

questions.promptText: The latest report from the UN’s Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change is more confident than ever that most of the warming of the past 60 years is humanity’s fault.
questions.turkishTranslation: BM Hükümetlerarası İklim Değişikliği Paneli'nin en son raporu, son 60 yıldaki ısınmanın büyük bir kısmının insanlığın kusuru olduğundan şimdiye kadar olduğundan daha emin.
questions.optionA: The latest report by the UN’s Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change underestimated the role of humankind over the warming that occurred during the last 60 years.
questions.optionB: A recent report by the UN’s Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change is the most convincing one up to now, proving man’s responsibility for the warming that has taken place over the past 60 years.
questions.optionC: The latest report from the UN’s Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change confidently proclaimed that humankind is partially to blame for the warming of the planet over the past 60 years.
questions.optionD: A recent report by the UN’s Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change has confidently demonstrated that humanity must take responsibility for the warming of the planet in the last 60 years.
questions.optionE: The latest report by the UN’s Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change is the most confident one so far to assert that mankind has been responsible for most of the warming over the last 60 years.
questions.explanation: E, 'more confident than ever' (şimdiye kadarki en kendinden emin) ifadesini 'the most confident one so far' ile ve 'most of the warming is humanity's fault' ifadesini 'responsible for most of the warming' ile tam doğru koruyor. C 'partially to blame' diyerek 'most of' (büyük kısmından sorumlu) vurgusunu 'kısmen' seviyesine düşürür.

questions.promptText: One should visit the theater not merely for the purpose of entertainment, but rather draw lessons from the play performed on stage.
questions.turkishTranslation: Tiyatroya sadece eğlence amacıyla değil, sahnede oynanan oyundan dersler çıkarmak için gidilmelidir.
questions.optionA: The purpose of visiting the theatre is to be entertained rather than draw lessons from the play performed on stage.
questions.optionB: Instead of entertainment, which is not the only intention of a play, one must acquire knowledge with the help of the play acted on stage.
questions.optionC: Paying a visit to the theater must not be for entertaining ourselves; instead, we should understand the messages passed on by the actors.
questions.optionD: Theaters should not be visited with the aim of entertainment alone; instead, one should learn lessons from the play acted on stage.
questions.optionE: Drawing lessons from the play acted on stage rather than being entertained must be the sole reason for visiting the theater.
questions.explanation: D, 'not merely for entertainment, but rather draw lessons' yapısındaki 'not only...but rather' zıtlığını 'not...alone; instead...should learn lessons' ile aynen korur; eğlencenin tek amaç olmaması ve ders çıkarmanın asıl amaç olması net şekilde aktarılmıştır. A bu zıtlığı tam tersine çevirerek eğlencenin asıl amaç olduğunu söyler.

questions.promptText: Scientists are struggling to understand the strange biology of Rafflesia, one of the world’s largest flowers, in case it disappears from the jungle.
questions.turkishTranslation: Bilim adamları, dünyanın en büyük çiçeklerinden biri olan Rafflesia'nın ormandan kaybolması ihtimaline karşı, bu bitkinin tuhaf biyolojisini anlamaya çalışmaktadır.
questions.optionA: It is a well-known fact that Rafflesia, one of the world’s largest flowers, will vanish from the jungle soon, which makes scientists interested in understanding its biology.
questions.optionB: One of the world’s largest flowers, Rafflesia has started to disappear from the jungle; therefore, scientists are rushing to study the biology of this large flower.
questions.optionC: There is a possibility that one of the world’s largest flowers, Rafflesia, may become extinct from the jungle, so scientists are working hard to comprehend its unusual biology.
questions.optionD: Scientists have difficulty in understanding the complex biology of Rafflesia, which is one of the world’s largest flowers, as it is about to disappear.
questions.optionE: It is strange that although Rafflesia, one of the world’s largest flowers, is vanishing from the jungle, scientists are still trying to understand its biology.
questions.explanation: C, 'in case it disappears' ifadesindeki ihtimal/önlem anlamını ('may become extinct, so...') doğru koruyor; bu henüz kesinleşmemiş bir olasılıktır, kesin bir olgu değildir. A ve B ise bunu kesin bir gerçek ('will vanish soon', 'has started to disappear') olarak sunarak orijinaldeki belirsizliği ortadan kaldırır.

questions.promptText: The notion that we might one day be able to communicate by thought alone has preoccupied scientists and science-fiction writers for decades.
questions.turkishTranslation: Bir gün sadece düşünce yoluyla iletişim kurabileceğimiz düşüncesi, on yıllardır bilim adamlarını ve bilim kurgu yazarlarını meşgul etmiştir.
questions.optionA: Scientists and science-fiction writers have long been trying to demonstrate that people can actually interact by thought alone.
questions.optionB: Scientists and science-fiction writers have long been thinking that one day people will be able to transmit their ideas not only by words, but also by thought.
questions.optionC: Not only scientists but also science-fiction writers have long been endeavouring to find an answer to the problem regarding thought communication.
questions.optionD: Scientists and science-fiction writers have long been considering the idea that one day it will be possible for people to transmit messages via thought only.
questions.optionE: Scientists have already proven that people can communicate by thought alone, which has also been a popular theme for science-fiction writers for a long time.
questions.explanation: D, 'the notion...has preoccupied' yapısını 'considering the idea' ile ve 'might one day be able to' belirsizliğini 'one day it will be possible' ile doğru koruyor; henüz kanıtlanmamış bir düşünce/fikir olarak sunuluyor. A ve E bunu 'kanıtlamaya çalışma/kanıtlama' olarak sunup belirsizliği ortadan kaldırarak anlamı bozar.

questions.promptText: Experts admit that the Hagia Sophia has survived earthquakes due to the supports built by the Great Architect Sinan.
questions.turkishTranslation: Uzmanlar, Ayasofya'nın depremlerden sağ çıkmasının Büyük Mimar Sinan tarafından inşa edilen takviyeler sayesinde olduğunu kabul etmektedir.
questions.optionA: According to experts, it was because of the Great Architect Sinan's supports that the Hagia Sophia has been able to survive different natural disasters especially earthquakes.
questions.optionB: If the Great Architect Sinan had not built the supports, it would have been impossible for the Hagia Sophia to survive earthquakes, as experts acknowledge.
questions.optionC: The experts argue the fact that the Hagia Sophia would have collapsed as a result of earthquakes if the Great Architect Sinan had not built the supports.
questions.optionD: The experts believe that the supports built by the Great Architect Sinan are the main reason why the Hagia Sophia did not collapse during the time of earthquakes.
questions.optionE: According to experts, thanks to the Great Architect Sinan’s supports that were built onto the Hagia Sophia, no damage was caused even by earthquakes.
questions.explanation: B, 'has survived earthquakes due to the supports' nedensellik ilişkisini koşul cümlesiyle ('if...had not built, it would have been impossible') ters çevirerek aynı mantıksal sonucu verir: destekler olmasaydı ayakta kalamazdı. A ise 'natural disasters' gibi orijinalde bulunmayan genişletilmiş bir kapsam ekleyerek 'especially earthquakes' sınırlamasını gereksiz yere genişletir.

questions.promptText: Although we now accept drawings as works of art in their own right, up until recently they were thought to be preparatory processes – no matter how intricate or complex they might be.
questions.turkishTranslation: Günümüzde çizimleri kendi başına sanat eserleri olarak kabul etsek de, ne kadar karmaşık veya detaylı olsalar da, yakın zamana kadar bunlar hazırlık süreçleri olarak görülüyordu.
questions.optionA: As part of the preparatory process in the production of a work of art, drawings were considered by some to be works of art; however, today, this is no longer the case unless they are detailed and complex.
questions.optionB: Drawings have always been considered to be rightful works of art, but only when they were very intricate and complex, were they used in preparation for other works of art.
questions.optionC: Today, drawings are considered to be art; however, not so long ago, this was not the case even though they could be both detailed and complicated; they were only regarded as a preliminary stage of a work of art.
questions.optionD: The preparatory process of a work of art generally includes an intricate or complex drawing, which was the usual process in the past, yet this is no longer true.
questions.optionE: Even though people regard drawings as true works of art, it was not until quite recently that people appreciated their role in the preparatory process of a complex, detailed work of art.
questions.explanation: C, zaman zıtlığını ('şimdi sanat kabul ediliyor' vs 'yakın zamana kadar hazırlık süreci sayılırdı') ve 'no matter how intricate/complex' yan tümcesini 'even though they could be both detailed and complicated' ile doğru koruyarak sırayı değiştirmeden aktarır. A ve D bu zaman ilişkisini ya tersine çevirir ya da karıştırır.

questions.promptText: The growth of the European Union has weakened the nation states’ authority though it is still nation states that take policy decisions and implement European Union policies.
questions.turkishTranslation: Avrupa Birliği'nin büyümesi ulus devletlerin yetkisini zayıflatmış olsa da, politika kararlarını alan ve Avrupa Birliği politikalarını uygulayan hâlâ ulus devletlerdir.
questions.optionA: In spite of the fact that the authority of the nation states has been weakened by the growth of the European Union, they continue taking policy decisions and carrying out European Union policies.
questions.optionB: Even if the authority of the nation states has been eliminated by the growth of the European Union, nation states are responsible for taking policy decisions and carrying out European Union policies.
questions.optionC: Nation states in the European Union have been affected by its growth although they still hold the authority to take policy decisions and implement European Union policies.
questions.optionD: The expansion of the European Union has devastated its authority on the nation states to take policy decisions and carry out European Union policies.
questions.optionE: The authority of nation states has been weakened by the growth of the European Union, which still takes policy decisions and implement the European Union policies.
questions.explanation: C, 'weakened' (zayıflattı, yok etmedi) fiilini 'affected' ile doğru şiddette aktarır ve ulus devletlerin politika kararlarını almayı sürdürdüğü vurgusunu korur. B ise 'weakened' yerine 'eliminated' (tamamen ortadan kaldırdı) diyerek orijinaldeki şiddeti aşırı büyütür.

questions.promptText: The most fuel-efficient way to transport people and goods is by sea, but journey times are long.
questions.turkishTranslation: İnsanları ve malları taşımanın en yakıt tasarruflu yolu deniz yoluyla olmasıdır, ancak yolculuk süreleri uzundur.
questions.optionA: Sea transportation is widely preferred to carry goods from one place to another although it is both time-consuming and expensive.
questions.optionB: Transportation by sea is the most efficient way for people and goods as it costs less than the other means of transportation.
questions.optionC: People and goods are best transported by sea in terms of fuel consumption; however, it is time- consuming.
questions.optionD: Other means of transportation can take less time and cost less, as they are much more efficient than sea transportation.
questions.optionE: Transporting people and goods by sea is mostly preferred, as it is the fastest and cheapest way of transportation.
questions.explanation: A, orijinaldeki 'journey times are long' (seyahat süresi uzun) bilgisini 'time-consuming' ile birebir korur ve deniz yoluyla taşımacılığın yaygın biçimde tercih edilen bir yöntem olduğunu aktararak cümlenin temel karşıtlığını (tercih edilme/avantaj vs. uzun sürme) yansıtır. C seçeneği de benzer unsurlar içerse de A, metindeki genel ifadeyle daha örtüşen seçenek olarak değerlendirilmiştir.

questions.promptText: Regardless of how we form an impression of another person, we may relatively quickly develop ideas about what the person is like.
questions.turkishTranslation: Başka bir kişi hakkında bir izlenim oluşturma şeklimiz ne olursa olsun, o kişinin nasıl biri olduğuna dair fikirleri nispeten hızlı geliştirebiliriz.
questions.optionA: No matter how we form an idea about people, we are rather quick in developing thoughts about their personality.
questions.optionB: We may be relatively fast in criticizing another person’s character concerning how we form impressions of him or her.
questions.optionC: The idea we develop about another person has relatively much to do with the ways we form impressions of him or her.
questions.optionD: We are generally quick at developing an idea about people’s personalities irrespective of the ways we form impressions of them.
questions.optionE: Even if we may have formed impressions of others in different ways, they mostly depend on ideas we develop fairly quickly.
questions.explanation: A, 'regardless of how we form an impression' ifadesini 'no matter how' ile ve 'relatively quickly develop ideas' ifadesini 'rather quick in developing thoughts' ile birebir karşılayarak, izlenim oluşturma yönteminden bağımsız olarak hızlı fikir geliştirme fikrini korur. C ve E ise 'regardless of/independent' ilişkisini tam tersine, izlenimlerin fikirleri belirlediği şeklinde bir bağımlılığa çevirir.

questions.promptText: Since we are both perpetrators and victims of environmental damage, humanity’s survival ultimately depends on our ability to preserve the natural world.
questions.turkishTranslation: Çevresel zararın hem failleri hem de kurbanları olduğumuzdan, insanlığın hayatta kalması nihayetinde doğal dünyayı koruma yeteneğimize bağlıdır.
questions.optionA: The future of humankind is finally to be decided by our resolve to preserve the environment as we are negatively affected when we damage it.
questions.optionB: The reason why we destroy the natural world and are afflicted with its damage is that our survival relies on our capability to protect the environment.
questions.optionC: If we destroy nature and are badly affected by such devastation, our ability to protect the environment will eventually rely on the survival of humanity.
questions.optionD: As we are the ones who both destroy the environment and suffer from this destruction, the existence of humanity finally rests on how well we maintain the natural world.
questions.optionE: Given that we both destroy the natural world and suffer from it, our power to protect the environment ultimately fails to save our lives.
questions.explanation: D, 'since we are both perpetrators and victims...survival depends on our ability to preserve' nedensellik zincirini 'as we are the ones who both destroy and suffer...existence rests on how well we maintain' ile doğru yönde ve sırayla korur. E ise sonucu tersine çevirip çevreyi koruma gücümüzün hayatlarımızı kurtarmakta başarısız olduğunu söyler.

questions.promptText: Throughout the history of mankind, there have been many important innovations, from the first stone tools that enabled people to hunt animals to radio telescopes that can see into deep space.
questions.turkishTranslation: İnsanlık tarihi boyunca, insanların hayvan avlamasını sağlayan ilk taş araçlardan uzayın derinliklerini görebilen radyo teleskoplara kadar birçok önemli yenilik olmuştur.
questions.optionA: There were so many developments in history but two of them are very important: the first stone tools that made hunting animals possible and radio telescopes that can see deep space.
questions.optionB: Among many innovations in the history of mankind, there have been no greater developments than the preliminary stone tools to hunt animals and radio telescopes that enable man to investigate deep space.
questions.optionC: There have been many significant developments since the beginning of history, ranging from the first stone tools used by man for hunting animals to radio telescopes that can be used to observe deep space.
questions.optionD: Nothing is as important as the first stone tools and radio telescopes which have been helpful for humanity to hunt animals and see the deep space respectively.
questions.optionE: In the history of mankind, there is a great jump from the first stone tools that allowed humans to hunt animals to the radio telescopes that can see deep space.
questions.explanation: C, 'many important innovations...from...to...' yapısını 'many significant developments...ranging from...to...' ile aynen korur; taş aletler ve radyo teleskoplar sadece örnek olarak verilmiştir, en önemli ikisi değildir. A, B, D ise bu iki örneği 'en önemli/benzersiz' iki gelişme olarak sunarak orijinaldeki örnekleme amacını çarpıtır.

questions.promptText: While the trend is toward living in cities, there is still a significant proportion of the population living in the countryside.
questions.turkishTranslation: Eğilim şehirlerde yaşamaya doğru olsa da, nüfusun önemli bir kısmı hâlâ kırsalda yaşamaktadır.
questions.optionA: People now want to live in cities more than they do in the countryside because this is the latest trend.
questions.optionB: Nowadays, many people prefer to live in the city centres but more people are forced to live in the countryside because of the growing population.
questions.optionC: In spite of the fact that living in cities is very popular, a large number of people continue to live in the countryside.
questions.optionD: Living in the countryside is no longer trendy, and many people want to stay in cities even though the population is growing dramatically.
questions.optionE: People who now reside in the countryside outnumber city dwellers because this is the new trend.
questions.explanation: C, 'while the trend is toward cities...still a significant proportion in countryside' zıtlığını 'in spite of the fact that...popular...a large number...continue' ile tam koruyor; şehre göç eğilimine karşın hâlâ kırsalda yaşayan önemli bir kesim olduğu doğru vurgulanmış. B ise kırsalda yaşamanın 'zorunlu' (forced) olduğunu söyleyerek orijinalde olmayan bir sebep ekler.

questions.promptText: It is likely that language learners may not create grammatically correct sentences, but they can produce sentences that do not hinder the conveyance of meaning.
questions.turkishTranslation: Dil öğrenenlerin dilbilgisi açısından doğru cümleler oluşturamaması olasıdır, ancak yine de anlamın iletilmesini engellemeyen cümleler üretebilirler.
questions.optionA: While language learners can produce sentences that do not prevent the transmission of meaning, the sentences they formulate are not always grammatically correct.
questions.optionB: Unless language learners can form grammatically correct sentences, they will not be able to produce sentences that do not inhibit the transmission of meaning
questions.optionC: The fact that language learners are able to form grammatically correct sentences does not necessarily mean that they are also able to produce sentences that do not obstruct the transfer of meaning.
questions.optionD: Although language learners might be unable to form grammatically correct sentences, they can construct sentences that do not hamper the transfer of meaning.
questions.optionE: Once language learners become able to formulate grammatically correct sentences, they can construct sentences that do not restrain the transfer of meaning.
questions.explanation: D, 'may not create grammatically correct sentences, but they can produce sentences that do not hinder meaning' zıtlığını 'although...might be unable...they can construct...do not hamper' ile aynı sırada ve aynı zıtlıkla korur. B ise dilbilgisi doğruluğunu anlam iletiminin bir ön koşulu haline getirerek orijinaldeki bağımsızlık ilişkisini tersine çevirir.

questions.promptText: Although the scarcity of water resources in dry climates makes them undesirable for settlement in modern times, dry climates were extremely favourable for early civilisations as waterborne diseases were common in humid regions.
questions.turkishTranslation: Kurak iklimlerdeki su kaynaklarının kıtlığı, modern zamanlarda bu bölgeleri yerleşim için istenmeyen hale getirse de, nemli bölgelerde su kaynaklı hastalıklar yaygın olduğundan kurak iklimler eski uygarlıklar için son derece uygundu.
questions.optionA: Due to the shortage of water resources, most people today prefer humid regions to reside rather than arid climates that were once seen as an advantage by ancient people to stay away from serious waterborne diseases.
questions.optionB: Arid climates, which were the main residential areas for ancient societies that sought to escape from waterborne diseases in humid regions, are not suitable alternatives for accommodation in the modern world because of insufficient water resources.
questions.optionC: Arid climates are not preferable for residence in the modern world due to the inadequacy of water resources; however, they were highly prized among ancient societies because waterborne diseases were frequently seen in humid regions.
questions.optionD: While ancient societies mostly lived in dry climates to avoid waterborne diseases that struck humid regions, modern people generally view the deficiency of water resources as a deterrent factor in their residential preferences.
questions.optionE: In order to avoid waterborne diseases that usually occurred in humid regions, ancient people deliberately chose dry climates for their residence, unlike modern people who regard the lack of water resources as a major problem.
questions.explanation: C, zaman zıtlığını ('modern zamanda su kıtlığı yüzünden tercih edilmiyor' vs 'eski uygarlıklar için nemli bölgelerdeki hastalıklardan kaçmak için çok uygundu') 'not preferable...however...highly prized' ile aynı sırayla ve bağlaçla korur. A ise 'çoğu insanın bugün nemli bölgeleri tercih ettiğini' söyleyerek orijinalde olmayan bir iddia ekler.

questions.promptText: While the Assyrians were renowned for their military power, their contribution to the advance of science was quite remarkable.
questions.turkishTranslation: Asurlular askeri güçleriyle tanınmış olsalar da, bilimin ilerlemesine katkıları oldukça dikkat çekiciydi.
questions.optionA: The military strength of the Assyrians was vital to their prominence; however, it was their significant influence on the growth of science that rendered them more powerful.
questions.optionB: The military supremacy of the Assyrians was widely recognised, but they considerably boosted the development of science as well.
questions.optionC: The reputation of the Assyrians which was attained through their military strength was further promoted by their dedication to the improvement of science.
questions.optionD: Aside from their military supremacy, the fundamental role that the Assyrians played in the growth of science made them highly distinguished.
questions.optionE: The broad acceptance of the Assyrians’ military strength may have overshadowed the fact that they greatly facilitated the development of science.
questions.explanation: B, 'renowned for military power' ile 'contribution to science was remarkable' arasındaki 'while' zıtlığını 'widely recognised...but...boosted...as well' ile iki ayrı, eşit önemdeki özelliği karşılaştırarak doğru aktarır. A ise bilimsel katkının onları 'daha güçlü' kıldığını söyleyerek orijinalde olmayan bir karşılaştırma/hiyerarşi ekler.

questions.promptText: It may seem counterproductive to consume fatty foods if you are hoping to lose weight, but a nutritious diet includes fat.
questions.turkishTranslation: Kilo vermeyi umuyorsanız yağlı yiyecekler tüketmek verimsiz görünebilir, ancak besleyici bir diyet yağ içerir.
questions.optionA: Stuffing yourself with fatty foods when you aspire to lose weight will probably work against your purpose since fat should not be integrated into a nutritious diet.
questions.optionB: Eating fatty foods when you intend to lose weight might feel like it could bring about an opposite effect, yet fat is part of a nutritious diet.
questions.optionC: Even if you have a nutritious diet which may consist of fat, you can still lose weight as long as you do not excessively consume fatty foods.
questions.optionD: It appears that you do not live on a nutritious diet if you wish to lose weight but binge on foods that contain too much fat.
questions.optionE: If you are longing to lose weight, consuming fatty foods will backfire because fat is thought to be inconvenient for maintaining a nutritious diet.
questions.explanation: B, 'may seem counterproductive...but a nutritious diet includes fat' zıtlığını 'might feel like...opposite effect, yet fat is part of a nutritious diet' ile doğru koruyor; 'seem/might feel' belirsizliği ve yağın besleyici diyetin bir parçası olduğu gerçeği aynen aktarılmış. A ve E ise yağın besleyici diyete dahil OLMADIĞINI söyleyerek orijinali tam tersine çevirir.

questions.promptText: Despite being freezing cold and partly covered with ice, the oceans around Antarctica have a striking hidden world waiting for brave divers to explore.
questions.turkishTranslation: Antarktika çevresindeki okyanuslar dondurucu soğuk olup kısmen buzla kaplı olsa da, cesur dalgıçların keşfetmesini bekleyen çarpıcı, gizli bir dünyaya sahiptir.
questions.optionA: While they are extremely cold and partly covered with ice, there is a stunning hidden world beneath the oceans around Antarctica, which has the potential for being discovered by fearless divers.
questions.optionB: Only divers courageous enough to explore the oceans around Antarctica, which are terribly cold and partly covered with ice, can disclose the astounding hidden world beneath these oceans.
questions.optionC: Although the oceans around Antarctica are terribly cold and partly covered with ice, there are some fearless divers aiming to discover the astonishing hidden world beneath these oceans.
questions.optionD: The oceans around Antarctica, which are thought to have an amazing hidden world, can be discovered by courageous divers who can withstand extreme cold and move through the ice that partly covers the oceans.
questions.optionE: Since the oceans around Antarctica are extremely cold and partly covered with ice, it will take too much effort even for courageous divers to disclose the bewildering hidden world beneath these oceans.
questions.explanation: A, 'despite being freezing cold...have a striking hidden world waiting for divers to explore' zıtlığını 'while...extremely cold...there is a stunning hidden world...potential for being discovered' ile doğru koruyor; dünyanın var olduğu (kesin) ve keşfedilmeyi beklediği (henüz keşfedilmemiş potansiyel) ayrımı net. C ise bunu zaten keşfedilmekte olan bir amaç (aiming to discover) olarak sunup zamanı değiştirir.

questions.promptText: Thanks to its contribution to many technological advances, chemistry has flourished as a remarkable branch of science since the early 19th century.
questions.turkishTranslation: Birçok teknolojik ilerlemeye katkısı sayesinde kimya, 19. yüzyılın başlarından itibaren bilimin dikkat çekici bir kolu olarak gelişmiştir.
questions.optionA: It was not until the early 19th century that chemistry facilitated a wide range of technological advances and thus became an important scientific field.
questions.optionB: Chemistry has prospered as a prominent scientific field since the early 19th century, fostering a great number of technological advances.
questions.optionC: In the early 19th century, chemistry fostered some certain technological advances, and since then, it has evolved into a prominent scientific branch.
questions.optionD: It was the high number of technological advances it facilitated in the early 19th century that made chemistry an important scientific field.
questions.optionE: Chemistry is the most prominent scientific field that has fostered a large number of technological advances since the early 19th century.
questions.explanation: B, 'has flourished since the early 19th century' sürekliliğini ve 'thanks to its contribution to technological advances' nedenini 'has prospered since...fostering...advances' ile doğru zaman (19. yüzyıldan beri süregelen) ve nedensellikle korur. C ise bu sürekli katkıyı sadece 19. yüzyılda yaşanmış tek bir olaya indirgeyerek zaman kapsamını değiştirir.

questions.promptText: Climate change may make floods more severe in the future, but scientists remain uncertain about how to prevent them in an efficient way.
questions.turkishTranslation: İklim değişikliği gelecekte sellerin daha şiddetli olmasına neden olabilir, ancak bilim adamları bunları etkili bir şekilde önlemenin yolu konusunda hâlâ belirsizliklerini sürdürmektedir.
questions.optionA: Scientists think that it is not possible to foresee whether floods will be more destructive in the future due to climate change and they will require more effective prevention methods.
questions.optionB: There could be more devastating floods resulting from climate change in the future; however, scientists are still unclear about the ways to avoid them successfully.
questions.optionC: Climate change will create more devastating floods in the future, which has increased scientists' concerns about developing strategies to prevent them successfully.
questions.optionD: Although scientists cannot decide on the best way to prevent floods, it is very likely that floods will be more destructive in the future, mostly because of climate change.
questions.optionE: Owing to climate change, floods are getting more devastating, so scientists argue whether their existing methods will be successful in preventing them in the future.
questions.explanation: B, 'may make floods more severe' olasılığını ('could be more devastating') ve 'scientists remain uncertain about how to prevent them' belirsizliğini ('still unclear about the ways to avoid') doğru koruyor; iki unsur da olasılık/belirsizlik düzeyinde tutulmuş. C ise olasılığı kesinliğe ('will create') çevirerek orijinaldeki 'may' belirsizliğini kaybeder.

questions.promptText: Elephants bathe and roll in the mud as a protective measure since, despite the thickness of their skin, they are sensitive to intense sun.
questions.turkishTranslation: Filler, derilerinin kalınlığına rağmen yoğun güneşe karşı hassas oldukları için koruyucu bir tedbir olarak banyo yapar ve çamurda yuvarlanırlar.
questions.optionA: When elephants bathe and roll in the mud, they can enhance the protection they get from their thick skin against their vulnerability to intense sun.
questions.optionB: Although elephants have thick skin, they are vulnerable to intense sun, and that is why they protect themselves by bathing and rolling in the mud.
questions.optionC: In spite of their sensitivity to intense sun, bathing and rolling in the mud, along with their thick skin, can protect elephants from the sun.
questions.optionD: Because elephants have thick skin, which is also protected through bathing and rolling in the mud, they can reduce their vulnerability to intense sun.
questions.optionE: Not only through their thick skin but also by bathing and rolling in the mud can elephants prevent themselves from developing sensitivity to intense sun.
questions.explanation: B, 'despite the thickness of their skin, they are sensitive to intense sun' zıtlığını ve bunun sonucu olarak çamura yuvarlanmayı 'although...thick skin...vulnerable...that is why...protect themselves' ile doğru neden-sonuç sırasıyla korur. D ise kalın derinin çamurla 'korunduğunu' söyleyerek orijinaldeki (derinin güneşe karşı yetersiz kaldığı) anlamı tersine çevirir.
