questions.promptText: We cannot properly assess a student’s educational achievement unless we analyse the teaching methods and the learning environment.
questions.turkishTranslation: Öğretim yöntemlerini ve öğrenme ortamını analiz etmediğimiz sürece bir öğrencinin eğitimsel başarısını doğru bir şekilde değerlendiremeyiz.
questions.optionA: There seems to be no point in evaluating a student’s academic success without carefully analysing the teaching methods and the learning context.
questions.optionB: The instructional methods and the learning context are among the factors that enable us to accurately evaluate a student’s school success.
questions.optionC: It is not possible to accurately evaluate a student’s academic success if we do not analyse the instructional methods and the learning context.
questions.optionD: In order to evaluate a student’s school success accurately, we need to focus on the types of teaching methods used in the learning context.
questions.optionE: The careful evaluation of a student’s academic success can be carried out through examining the learning context where specific instructional methods are applied.
questions.explanation: C, 'cannot properly assess...unless we analyse' olumsuz koşul yapısını 'not possible to accurately evaluate...if we do not analyse' ile birebir aynı mantıkla (zorunlu koşul, 'among the factors' değil) korur. B ise bu zorunlu koşulu sadece 'faktörlerden biri' seviyesine indirgeyerek vurguyu zayıflatır.

questions.promptText: Hallucinations are sensations that appear real but are not evoked by anything in our external environment.
questions.turkishTranslation: Halüsinasyonlar gerçek görünen ama dış çevremizdeki hiçbir şey tarafından tetiklenmeyen hislerdir.
questions.optionA: Hallucinations are products of our minds that could be in close connection with the external world.
questions.optionB: While hallucinations seem to be actual perceptions, nothing in the external world triggers them.
questions.optionC: Hallucinations cannot be recalled by anything from the outside world and are absolutely imaginary.
questions.optionD: Anything in the outside world can give rise to hallucinations that might be perceived as real.
questions.optionE: Hallucinations are unreal perceptions that might be associated with our external environment.
questions.explanation: B, 'appear real but are not evoked by anything in external environment' zıtlığını 'seem to be actual perceptions...nothing in external world triggers them' ile tam doğru koruyor. D ise dış dünyadaki bir şeyin halüsinasyonları tetikleyebileceğini söyleyerek orijinalin tam tersini ifade eder.

questions.promptText: An investigation into the fish remains in the Sahara Desert has revealed that humans living there 10,000 years ago were eating fish for dinner.
questions.turkishTranslation: Sahra Çölü'ndeki balık kalıntıları üzerine yapılan bir araştırma, 10.000 yıl önce orada yaşayan insanların akşam yemeğinde balık yediğini ortaya koymuştur.
questions.optionA: An analysis of the humans that lived in the Sahara Desert 10,000 years ago, based on their remains, sheds light on how often these people ate fish for dinner.
questions.optionB: According to an analysis on the fish remains in the Sahara Desert, it has been found that the people residing in this area 10,000 years ago used to consume fish for dinner.
questions.optionC: According to a study on the diets of the humans living in the Sahara Desert 10,000 years ago, it was customary for those who lived in that area to consume fish for dinner.
questions.optionD: According to a study on the fish remains in the Sahara Desert, the residents of this area are known to have been eating fish for dinner for the last 10,000 years.
questions.optionE: An examination of the fish remains in the Sahara Desert, 10,000 years ago, indicated that fish was often preferred for dinner by the residents of this area.
questions.explanation: B, çalışmanın konusunu ('fish remains' kalıntıları, 'insan kalıntıları' değil) ve bulguyu ('10,000 yıl önce yaşayanlar akşam yemeğinde balık yerlermiş') doğru koruyor. A çalışmanın nesnesini 'insan kalıntıları' olarak değiştirip yanlış bilgi verir, D ise '10,000 yıldır balık yiyorlar' diyerek zamanı yanlış yorumlar (10,000 yıl önceki bir dönem, süregelen bir eylem değil).

questions.promptText: No sooner had Isaac Newton received his university degree, in 1665, then the plague came, which forced everyone to leave Cambridge.
questions.turkishTranslation: Isaac Newton 1665'te üniversite derecesini aldıktan hemen sonra, veba geldi ve herkesi Cambridge'i terk etmeye zorladı.
questions.optionA: As soon as Isaac Newton received his university degree in 1665, people had to abandon Cambridge because of the outbreak of the plague.
questions.optionB: Upon being forced to leave Cambridge due to the plague in 1665, Isaac Newton received his university degree.
questions.optionC: Before Isaac Newton finished university in 1665, the plague had broken out in Cambridge and made people leave the city.
questions.optionD: The plague forced everyone including Isaac Newton, who would soon receive his university degree, to leave Cambridge in 1665.
questions.optionE: It was 1665 when Isaac Newton had to leave Cambridge with his university degree since the plague afflicted everyone.
questions.explanation: A, 'no sooner...than' zaman yapısındaki sıralamayı ('Newton diplomasını alır almaz, veba geldi, herkes Cambridge'i terk etmek zorunda kaldı') 'as soon as...had to abandon' ile doğru kronolojik sırayla korur. C ise olayların sırasını tersine çevirip vebanın diplomadan ÖNCE patlak verdiğini söyler.

questions.promptText: With the huge growth in population and with the development of larger and more efficient machines, the ability of humans to influence their environment has increased enormously.
questions.turkishTranslation: Nüfusta görülen büyük artış ve daha büyük, daha verimli makinelerin geliştirilmesiyle, insanların çevrelerini etkileme yeteneği muazzam bir şekilde artmıştır.
questions.optionA: Population of humans has grown immensely, which means both an increase in their ability to affect their environment considerably and also the development of bigger and more efficient machines.
questions.optionB: Due to the massive growth in population, much larger and more efficient machines have been developed and this has led humans to be able to influence their environment extensively.
questions.optionC: There has been a great increase in the ability of humans to have a huge impact on their nature as a massive growth in the population has helped them develop larger and more efficient machines.
questions.optionD: There has been a great deal of increase in humans’ capability to have an impact on their environment thanks to the massive population growth and the development of larger and more efficient machines.
questions.optionE: Humans have the capability to influence their nature greatly thanks to the development of larger and more efficient machines which are the products of the immensely growing population.
questions.explanation: D, 'with...and with...' yapısındaki iki bağımsız nedeni (nüfus artışı VE makine gelişimi) 'thanks to...and...' ile eşit ve bağımsız sebepler olarak korur. B, C, E ise nüfus artışı ile makine gelişimi arasında orijinalde olmayan bir nedensellik zinciri (biri diğerine yol açmış gibi) kurar.

questions.promptText: Although clouds vary enormously from day to day, they can all be identified as one of ten basic types.
questions.turkishTranslation: Bulutlar günden güne büyük ölçüde değişse de, hepsi on temel türden biri olarak tanımlanabilir.
questions.optionA: Even though they belong to one of ten simple types of clouds, cloud formations can dramatically change their shapes from day to day.
questions.optionB: Identifying clouds as one of ten basic varieties is due to the fact that they tend to vary quite a lot on a daily basis.
questions.optionC: Despite belonging to one of ten basic varieties of clouds, most clouds can change their shape quite a lot on a day to day basis.
questions.optionD: The fundamental variations of clouds on a day to day basis can be grouped into one of ten different cloud types.
questions.optionE: Despite differing immensely on a daily basis, clouds typically all belong to one of ten fundamental varieties.
questions.explanation: E, 'although...vary enormously...can all be identified as one of ten types' zıtlığını 'despite differing immensely...typically all belong to one of ten varieties' ile aynı sırada ve aynı bağlaçla korur. A ve C bu zıtlığın yönünü tersine çevirip 'on tipten birine ait olmalarına rağmen değişiyorlar' diyerek mantığı ters kurar.

questions.promptText: Rome’s military and administrative strength allowed it to endure several crises until, finally, waves of invaders brought about its fall.
questions.turkishTranslation: Roma'nın askeri ve idari gücü, sonunda istilacı dalgalarının çöküşüne yol açmasına kadar birçok krizi atlatmasını sağlamıştır.
questions.optionA: Rome could survive the attacks of invaders thanks to its powerful army and governmental system; however, several crises ultimately caused its fall.
questions.optionB: Although waves of invaders were able to make Rome surrender after several crises, they eventually failed to weaken Rome's military and administrative powers.
questions.optionC: If it had not been for Rome’s military and administrative strength, it could not have survived even until the attack of invaders.
questions.optionD: Rome was able to handle many crises thanks to the power of its army and governmental system, yet it ultimately collapsed as a result of the attacks of the invaders.
questions.optionE: The invaders eventually succeeded to conquer Rome after some crises no matter how powerful its military and administration were.
questions.explanation: D, 'strength allowed it to endure crises until...invaders brought about its fall' nedensellik ve zaman sırasını 'able to handle crises thanks to...yet ultimately collapsed as a result of invaders' ile aynen korur: önce krizlere dayandı, sonunda istilacılar yüzünden çöktü. A ise çöküşün sebebini 'istilacılar' değil 'birkaç kriz' olarak değiştirip orijinal nedeni yanlış aktarır.

questions.promptText: Despite claims of slave labour, it is thought that the Great Pyramid of Giza was built by skilled workers.
questions.turkishTranslation: Köle işçiliği iddialarına rağmen, Giza Büyük Piramidi'nin yetenekli işçiler tarafından inşa edildiği düşünülmektedir.
questions.optionA: It has been suggested that the Great Pyramid of Giza was built mainly by slaves rather than skilled workers.
questions.optionB: The Great Pyramid of Giza is claimed to have been built by qualified workers who mostly relied on slave labour.
questions.optionC: Although many assume it was built by slave labour, the Great Pyramid of Giza is believed to have been constructed by skilled workers.
questions.optionD: In spite of claims that qualified workers must have built the Great Pyramid of Giza, many assert that it owes its existence to slaves.
questions.optionE: There are claims that skilled workers could not have erected the Great Pyramid of Giza without slave labour.
questions.explanation: C, 'despite claims of slave labour...thought to be built by skilled workers' zıtlığını 'although many assume...slave labour...believed to have been constructed by skilled workers' ile aynı yönde ve aynı ağırlıkla (asıl görüş: kalifiye işçiler) korur. D ise bu ağırlığı tersine çevirip 'köleler inşa etti' görüşünü asıl/baskın görüş haline getirir.

questions.promptText: In addition to the role of culture in shaping our diets, our own learning experience dictates which foods we will include in our diets.
questions.turkishTranslation: Kültürün beslenme alışkanlıklarımızı şekillendirmedeki rolüne ek olarak, kendi öğrenme deneyimimiz de diyetimize hangi yiyecekleri dahil edeceğimizi belirler.
questions.optionA: Which foods we will have in our diets depends on our own learning experience rather than culture in shaping our diets.
questions.optionB: Together with culture, our own learning experience leads us to choose the foods that will be a part of our diets.
questions.optionC: Which foods we will include in our diets is determined by our own learning experience on which culture has a profound effect.
questions.optionD: Even if the role of our own learning experience in shaping our diets is undeniable, it is the culture which makes the biggest contribution to our food choices.
questions.optionE: Our diets, mostly influenced by culture, are not totally independent of our own learning experience.
questions.explanation: 'In addition to' ile belirtilen 'kültür + öğrenme deneyimi birlikte etkili' ilişkisi B'de 'Together with culture... our own learning experience' ifadesiyle aynen korunuyor; diğer seçenekler iki etkeni birbirinin karşıtı yapıp tek etkeni öne çıkarıyor.

questions.promptText: Unless an increasing proportion of a nation’s income is devoted to health care, shortages in its services are likely to get worse.
questions.turkishTranslation: Bir ulusun gelirinin artan bir oranı sağlık hizmetlerine ayrılmadıkça, bu hizmetlerdeki kıtlıkların daha da kötüleşmesi muhtemeldir.
questions.optionA: It is likely that shortages in health care services will continue to worsen if a growing proportion of a country’s revenues is not allocated to it.
questions.optionB: While an increasing ratio of a nation’s income could be devoted to health care, it would still be possible for it to encounter worsening limitations.
questions.optionC: If shortages in health care are likely to worsen within a country, more of that nation’s income must be devoted to services related to health care.
questions.optionD: A growing proportion of a country’s income should be directed at reducing the likelihood that health care restrictions will worsen.
questions.optionE: A higher ratio of a nation’s income is probably necessary to ensure that the proportion of shortages in health care services is manageable.
questions.explanation: 'Unless X, Y' yapısı 'if X is not done, Y' anlamına gelir; A bunu 'if a growing proportion... is not allocated to it' ile birebir koruyor, koşul ve sonuç sırası değişmiyor.

questions.promptText: As NASA plans return visits to the Moon, lunar scientists hope for more samples from across the surface and deep underground to learn more about the early history of the solar system.
questions.turkishTranslation: NASA Ay'a yeniden ziyaretler planlarken, Ay bilimcileri güneş sisteminin erken tarihi hakkında daha fazla bilgi edinmek için yüzeyin dört bir yanından ve yerin derinliklerinden daha fazla örnek almayı umuyorlar.
questions.optionA: In order to help lunar scientists improve their studies on the early history of the solar system, NASA is planning to revisit the Moon and get more samples from across the surface and deep underground.
questions.optionB: Since NASA aims to go to the Moon again, lunar scientists are waiting for more samples from across the surface and deep underground that can provide further information about the early history of the solar system.
questions.optionC: Because lunar scientists wish for more samples across the surface and deep underground to learn more about the early history of the solar system they hope that NASA can revisit the Moon.
questions.optionD: Lunar scientists who are studying the early history of the solar system want to obtain new samples from both across and below the Moon’s surface, so NASA is planning to revisit the Moon.
questions.optionE: The same way in which NASA wants to revisit the Moon, lunar scientists wish to get more samples from both above and below the surface so that they can advance their studies on the early history of the solar system.
questions.explanation: 'As' bağlacıyla kurulan 'NASA'nın planı -> bilim insanlarının umudu' neden-sonuç sırası B'de 'Since NASA aims...' ile aynı yönde korunuyor; A ve D ise nedeni ve sonucu birbirine ters çeviriyor.

questions.promptText: The effectiveness of cognitive behavioural therapy for various psychological problems has been researched more extensively than any other psychotherapeutic approach.
questions.turkishTranslation: Bilişsel davranışçı terapinin çeşitli psikolojik sorunlar üzerindeki etkinliği, diğer herhangi bir psikoterapötik yaklaşımdan daha kapsamlı bir şekilde araştırılmıştır.
questions.optionA: Cognitive behavioural therapy is one of the most comprehensively researched psychotherapeutic approaches, and it has proven effective for numerous psychological problems.
questions.optionB: There are a large number of psychological problems for which cognitive behavioural therapy is effective, as opposed to other psychotherapeutic approaches which have been investigated broadly.
questions.optionC: Much more research has been conducted on whether cognitive behavioural therapy is successful in handling a variety of psychological problems, compared to other psychotherapeutic approaches.
questions.optionD: A greater number of psychological problems are effectively tackled by cognitive behavioural therapy than any other extensively researched psychotherapeutic approach.
questions.optionE: The more researchers have investigated the effectiveness of cognitive behavioural therapy, the more accurately they have been able to compare it to other psychotherapeutic approaches.
questions.explanation: Odak 'araştırılma miktarının karşılaştırılması'dır (etkililiği değil, ne kadar araştırıldığı); C bunu 'Much more research has been conducted... compared to other approaches' ile doğru şekilde yansıtıyor, diğerleri etkililiği veya araştırma miktarını farklı biçimde çarpıtıyor.

questions.promptText: Because mammals are warm-blooded, they are able to keep their body at roughly the same temperature no matter what the surrounding temperature is.
questions.turkishTranslation: Memeliler sıcak kanlı oldukları için, çevre sıcaklığı ne olursa olsun vücutlarını kabaca aynı sıcaklıkta tutabilirler.
questions.optionA: The surrounding temperature does not prevent mammals from maintaining their body temperature at more or less the same level if they are warm- blooded.
questions.optionB: Even if the outside temperature changes slightly, it does not affect mammals’ ability to keep their body at approximately the same temperature because they are warm-blooded.
questions.optionC: Irrespective of the surrounding temperature, warm-blooded mammals will continue to maintain their body temperature at a constant level.
questions.optionD: If mammals were not warm-blooded, they would not keep their body temperature at exactly the same level despite the changes in the surrounding temperature.
questions.optionE: Regardless of the surrounding temperature, mammals manage to maintain their body at approximately the same temperature since they are warm-blooded.
questions.explanation: 'Because' ile verilen neden (sıcakkanlılık) ve 'no matter what' ile verilen sonuç (çevre sıcaklığından bağımsızlık) E'de 'since they are warm-blooded' ve 'Regardless of the surrounding temperature' ile tam karşılık buluyor.

questions.promptText: Considering both numbers of animals involved and the extent to which they are harmed, factory farming causes more harm to animals than does any other human practice.
questions.turkishTranslation: Hem etkilenen hayvan sayısı hem de zarar görme derecesi dikkate alındığında, fabrika çiftçiliği hayvanlara diğer herhangi bir insan uygulamasından daha fazla zarar vermektedir.
questions.optionA: Other human practices are more harmful to animals than factory farming when both numbers of animals and how much they are damaged are taken into consideration.
questions.optionB: Not only factory farming but also other human practices have caused considerable harm to animals, resulting in an increase in the number of animals being damaged.
questions.optionC: The number of animals suffering from the harmful effects of factory farming has increased, making factory farming the most dangerous human practice to affect animals.
questions.optionD: Factory farming, which causes more animals to suffer from its negative effects, is one of the main contributors to the damage to animals along with other human practices.
questions.optionE: Factory farming is more harmful to animals compared to other human practices when numbers of animals as well as the degree of the damage are taken into account.
questions.explanation: İki kriterin birlikte değerlendirilmesiyle fabrika çiftçiliğinin en zararlı pratik olduğu iddiası E'de 'when numbers of animals as well as the degree of the damage are taken into account' ile aynen korunuyor; A ise karşılaştırmayı tersine çeviriyor.

questions.promptText: Before the 17th century, no serious scientific work was done on gases, and they were all thought to be just air.
questions.turkishTranslation: 17. yüzyıldan önce, gazlar üzerinde ciddi bir bilimsel çalışma yapılmamıştı ve hepsinin sadece hava olduğu düşünülüyordu.
questions.optionA: Before the 17th century, gases were all believed to be just air because scientific studies conducted on gases were not accurate enough to change this belief.
questions.optionB: It was only in the 17th century that scientists began to carry out in-depth research on gases, quitting the idea that gases were all just air.
questions.optionC: By the 17th century, none of the scientific studies done on gases could eradicate the thought that gases are all just air.
questions.optionD: Until the 17th century, there was not any important scientific research conducted on gases, which were all seen as just air.
questions.optionE: It was once thought that gases are all just air; however, in the 17th century, remarkable scientific research on gases began to flourish.
questions.explanation: 'Before the 17th century, no serious scientific work' ifadesi 'bilimsel çalışma yokluğu', neden değil; D bunu 'there was not any important scientific research' ile doğru koruyor, A ise yokluğu yanlışlıkla bir nedene bağlıyor.

questions.promptText: Individual agricultural workers are not as productive as industrial workers, given that agriculture has a less developed division of labour.
questions.turkishTranslation: Tarımda iş bölümü daha az gelişmiş olduğundan, bireysel tarım işçileri sanayi işçileri kadar üretken değildir.
questions.optionA: Considering that the division of labour in agriculture is less advanced, individual agricultural workers are less productive than their industrial counterparts.
questions.optionB: If agriculture had a more developed division of labour, industrial workers could be as productive as individual agricultural workers.
questions.optionC: Individual agricultural workers are not more productive than industrial workers because agriculture boasts a more advanced division of labour.
questions.optionD: Despite labour division development in agriculture, industrial workers are more productive than their individual agricultural counterparts.
questions.optionE: As agriculture has a less advanced division of labour, individual workers in this sector are as productive as industrial workers.
questions.explanation: 'Given that' ile kurulan neden (az gelişmiş iş bölümü) - sonuç (daha az verimlilik) ilişkisi A'da 'Considering that... less advanced, individual agricultural workers are less productive' ile tam karşılık buluyor.

questions.promptText: To qualify for legal protection, an animal must be living in the wild and be listed as endangered.
questions.turkishTranslation: Yasal koruma için uygun olabilmesi için bir hayvanın doğada yaşıyor olması ve nesli tükenmekte olan türler listesinde yer alması gerekir.
questions.optionA: A wild animal cannot be saved from extinction unless any kind of legal protection is immediately ensured.
questions.optionB: An animal is provided with legal protection only when it is a member of wildlife and on the list of endangered animals.
questions.optionC: Whether an animal lives in its natural habitat or not, it must be legally protected if it is on the list of endangered animals.
questions.optionD: An endangered animal must be given legal protection if its survival in the wild is no longer possible.
questions.optionE: The lack of legal protection will absolutely jeopardise the existence of a wild animal that has been on the edge of extinction.
questions.explanation: İki koşulun birlikte (yabani olma VE nesli tehlikede listelenme) gerekliliği B'de 'only when it is a member of wildlife and on the list of endangered animals' ile her iki şart da korunarak ifade ediliyor.

questions.promptText: Despite its small size, Costa Rica, whose geography varies from rainforests to arid regions, is home to some of the most intense biodiversity in the world.
questions.turkishTranslation: Küçük boyutuna rağmen, coğrafyası yağmur ormanlarından kurak bölgelere kadar değişen Kosta Rika, dünyadaki en yoğun biyoçeşitliliklerden birine ev sahipliği yapmaktadır.
questions.optionA: Costa Rica has got one of the highest levels of biodiversity in the world, and rainforests and arid regions make up the majority of the small country’s diverse geography.
questions.optionB: Partly because Costa Rica has a geography that ranges from rainforests to arid regions, the small country possesses some of the richest biodiversity in the world.
questions.optionC: With a diverse geography including rainforests and arid regions, Costa Rica has some of the richest biodiversity in the world although it is a small country.
questions.optionD: Costa Rica’s small size does not prevent it from boasting some of the highest levels of biodiversity in the world, partly due to its geography ranging from rainforests to arid regions.
questions.optionE: While Costa Rica is blessed with some of the most intense biodiversity in the world, it is one of the smallest countries possessing a geography ranging from rainforests to arid regions.
questions.explanation: 'Despite its small size' zıtlığı ve coğrafi çeşitlilik bilgisi C'de 'although it is a small country' ile aynı sırada ve aynı vurguyla korunuyor; D de benzer ama 'partly due to' ekleyerek hafif nedensellik katıyor, C orijinale en sadık kalan.

questions.promptText: As well as spoken language, we use body language to pass on a multitude of messages about our moods and intentions.
questions.turkishTranslation: Sözlü dile ek olarak, duygu durumlarımız ve niyetlerimiz hakkında pek çok mesajı iletmek için beden dilini de kullanırız.
questions.optionA: A good amount of information about our moods and intentions is passed on to other people using either body language or spoken language.
questions.optionB: Spoken language is not the only means to convey a large number of messages regarding our moods and intentions, we also make use of body language.
questions.optionC: Plenty of messages concerning our moods and intentions are conveyed using spoken language rather than body language.
questions.optionD: We utilise either body language or spoken language to convey some messages related to our moods and intentions.
questions.optionE: Both body language and spoken language have to be used together to effectively convey messages with regard to our moods and intentions.
questions.explanation: 'As well as' ile verilen 'konuşma diline ek olarak beden dili de kullanılır' anlamı B'de 'Spoken language is not the only means... we also make use of body language' ile birebir korunuyor; A 'either/or' kullanarak ekleme anlamını kaybediyor.

questions.promptText: Few inventions have had a more immediate or lasting impact on world history than the railroad, the first mode of land transport capable of outdistancing the horse and camel.
questions.turkishTranslation: At ve deveyi geride bırakabilen ilk kara ulaşım aracı olan demiryolu kadar, dünya tarihi üzerinde bu denli ani ve kalıcı bir etki yaratan çok az icat vardır.
questions.optionA: The railroad, the mode of land transport which offered longer distances than the horse and camel for the first time, affected world history more directly and permanently than most other inventions.
questions.optionB: Direct and permanent impact on world history came from a number of land transport inventions, one of which was the railroad, as it made it possible to travel longer distances compared to the horse and camel.
questions.optionC: The horse and camel were outdistanced by the railroad, the first mode of land transport, which came as a more direct and lasting impact on world history compared to other inventions.
questions.optionD: Different modes of land transport that are able to go longer distances than the horse and camel have been invented, but the railroad was the first to have a direct and long-lasting effect on world history.
questions.optionE: World history has been influenced directly and permanently by a great number of inventions, including the railroad, which was the first mode of land transport that outperformed both the horse and camel in terms of distance.
questions.explanation: 'Few inventions have had a more... impact than the railroad' demirin diğer buluşlardan daha etkili olduğunu söyler; A bunu 'affected world history more directly and permanently than most other inventions' ile üstünlük anlamını koruyarak ifade ediyor, B ve E ise demiryolunu sıradan buluşlardan biri yapıp üstünlüğü kayboluyor.

questions.promptText: The learning of culture is an integral part of language education because culture dramatically influences how people speak in everyday interaction.
questions.turkishTranslation: Kültür, insanların günlük etkileşimde nasıl konuştuğunu büyük ölçüde etkilediği için, kültürün öğrenilmesi dil eğitiminin ayrılmaz bir parçasıdır.
questions.optionA: Everyday interaction seems to be affected by culture to a great extent, which, in turn, affects how culture is taught in language education.
questions.optionB: Language education, where the way people of a certain culture speak in their routine activities is taught, significantly contributes to the learning of culture.
questions.optionC: Culture largely determines the norms of speaking in everyday interaction, so the learning of culture is perhaps the most important aspect of language education.
questions.optionD: Given that culture substantially affects the way people speak in daily communication, the learning of culture cannot be separated from language education.
questions.optionE: Learning a language means learning the culture of that language; that is, language education also helps people speak in a particular language according to cultural norms.
questions.explanation: 'Because' ile verilen neden (kültürün konuşmaya etkisi) - sonuç (kültür öğreniminin dil eğitiminden ayrılamazlığı) D'de 'Given that... the learning of culture cannot be separated from language education' ile aynı yönde ve aynı güçte korunuyor.

questions.promptText: Because industrialised countries have been the primary greenhouse gas emitters, they should play a role in helping the world shift to renewable energy sources.
questions.turkishTranslation: Sanayileşmiş ülkeler başlıca sera gazı yayıcıları olduğundan, dünyanın yenilenebilir enerji kaynaklarına geçişine yardımcı olmada rol oynamalıdırlar.
questions.optionA: In order to help the world move to renewable energy sources, industrialised countries should stop releasing greenhouse gases into the atmosphere.
questions.optionB: It is the duty of industrialised countries to move to renewable energy sources as they are the world's major contributors to the production of greenhouse gases.
questions.optionC: Although industrialised countries give out greenhouse gases into the atmosphere, they need to help the world to start using renewable energy sources.
questions.optionD: The reason why industrialised countries should help the world to turn to renewable energy sources is that they have been largely responsible for greenhouse gas emissions.
questions.optionE: Not only industrialised countries, which release greenhouse gases into the atmosphere, the other countries of the world also need to shift to renewable energy sources.
questions.explanation: 'Because' ile belirtilen neden-sonuç ilişkisi (başlıca emisyon kaynağı olmaları -> yenilenebilir enerjiye geçişte rol üstlenmeleri gerekliliği) D'de 'The reason why... is that they have been largely responsible...' ile birebir aynı yönde korunuyor.

questions.promptText: As shown in a study in which young adults became better sleepers after three weeks of listening to classical music at bedtime, music can have a profound effect on our lives.
questions.turkishTranslation: Genç yetişkinlerin, yatmadan önce üç hafta boyunca klasik müzik dinledikten sonra daha iyi uyuyabildiklerini gösteren bir çalışmada da görüldüğü gibi, müzik hayatlarımız üzerinde derin bir etkiye sahip olabilir.
questions.optionA: A study has found out that listening to classical music at bedtime for three weeks helped young adults sleep better, demonstrating how strongly music affects our lives.
questions.optionB: According to the results of a study, young adults should listen to classical music at bedtime for three weeks to increase their sleep quality since music has a deep effect on our lives.
questions.optionC: As proven in a three-week study, bedtime classical music has a significant effect on our lives, particularly helping young adults improve their sleep quality.
questions.optionD: Thanks to the profound effect of classical music, young adults were able to become better sleepers at the end of a study after listening to it at bedtime for three weeks.
questions.optionE: Music can impact our lives to a great extent, as young adults who listened to classical music regularly at bedtime in a study were able to sleep better for three weeks.
questions.explanation: Çalışmanın bulgusu (klasik müzik dinleyen gençlerin daha iyi uyuması) ve bunun müziğin yaşamımıza etkisinin kanıtı olarak sunulması A'da 'A study has found out that... demonstrating how strongly music affects our lives' ile aynı sırayla korunuyor.

questions.promptText: Though dynasties changed over the thousands of years of Chinese history, many of the elements of Chinese life remained the same.
questions.turkishTranslation: Çin tarihinin binlerce yılı boyunca hanedanlıklar değişmiş olsa da, Çin yaşamının birçok unsuru aynı kalmıştır.
questions.optionA: If dynasties had not changed over the thousands of years of Chinese history, all of the elements of Chinese life could have stayed the same.
questions.optionB: Many elements of Chinese life hardly succeeded to continue, while dynasties changed over the thousands of years of Chinese history.
questions.optionC: Chinese history witnessed many changing dynasties over thousands of years, yet many of the elements were preserved in Chinese life.
questions.optionD: Some elements of Chinese life succeeded in staying the same; however, changing dynasties of Chinese history over the thousands of years could have prevented this.
questions.optionE: Due to the changing dynasties over the thousands of years of China’s history, only a few elements of Chinese life faced much change.
questions.explanation: 'Though' ile kurulan zıtlık (hanedan değişimine karşın hayatın unsurlarının kalıcılığı) C'de 'witnessed many changing dynasties... yet many of the elements were preserved' ile aynı karşıtlık yapısıyla korunuyor.

questions.promptText: Materials found under water are preserved differently from materials found on land, so underwater archaeologists must know how to handle them without destroying the valuable information they reveal.
questions.turkishTranslation: Su altında bulunan malzemeler karada bulunanlardan farklı şekilde korunduğundan, su altı arkeologları ortaya çıkardıkları değerli bilgileri yok etmeden bu malzemelerle nasıl başa çıkacaklarını bilmek zorundadır.
questions.optionA: Underwater archaeologists have to know how to deal with objects found under water and the ones found on land as they can be easily harmed if they do not pay enough attention to them.
questions.optionB: Not to give harm to the precious information they will provide, underwater archaeologists have to preserve objects found under water carefully because they are maintained differently from the ones found on land.
questions.optionC: It is very difficult to protect the objects found under water because, unlike the ones found on land, they can be harmed easily, so underwater archaeologists cannot get enough information.
questions.optionD: Knowing how to get enough information from them, underwater archaeologists show a great deal of effort not to cause harm to the objects found under water which are different from the ones found on land.
questions.optionE: Underwater archaeologists have to know how to deal with objects found under water without damaging the precious information they provide because the way they are kept is different from those found on land.
questions.explanation: 'So' ile kurulan neden (farklı korunma şekli) - sonuç (bilgiyi bozmadan ele alma gerekliliği) ilişkisi E'de 'without damaging the precious information... because the way they are kept is different' ile aynı yönde korunuyor.

questions.promptText: Achieving mutual understanding is not a trivial skill because most people are not taught how to communicate effectively.
questions.turkishTranslation: Çoğu insana nasıl etkili iletişim kurulacağı öğretilmediği için karşılıklı anlayışa ulaşmak önemsiz bir beceri değildir.
questions.optionA: As most people are not educated in effective communication, mutual understanding is an important trait to possess.
questions.optionB: Effective communication can only be acquired when people are educated, as it is considered by many people an important skill for mutual understanding.
questions.optionC: Most people still think that mutual understanding is an insignificant trait even if they are taught how to communicate effectively.
questions.optionD: Effective communication is the key to achieving mutual understanding, but a great number of people need some training on it.
questions.optionE: It is a good idea to teach people how to communicate effectively because they are usually not good at demonstrating mutual understanding
questions.explanation: 'Because' ile verilen neden (etkili iletişim eğitimi eksikliği) - sonuç (karşılıklı anlayışın önemli/kolay olmayan bir beceri olması) A'da 'As most people are not educated... mutual understanding is an important trait' ile aynı yönde korunuyor.

questions.promptText: Car makers are looking for ways of reusing metal and plastic parts instead of throwing them away when a car is scrapped.
questions.turkishTranslation: Otomobil üreticileri, bir araba hurdaya çıktığında metal ve plastik parçaları atmak yerine yeniden kullanmanın yollarını arıyor.
questions.optionA: It is essential for car manufacturers to make use of metal and plastic parts from old cars before their total removal.
questions.optionB: Metal and plastic parts from unused cars should be taken advantage of, according to car manufacturers.
questions.optionC: Before cars are disposed of, all their parts, whether metal or plastic, can be re-used by car manufacturers in many ways.
questions.optionD: Utilisation of metal and plastic parts without wasting them when a car is discarded is what car manufacturers are attempting to achieve.
questions.optionE: What makes recycling significant for car manufacturers is that most car parts, including metal and plastic ones, are used again.
questions.explanation: 'Looking for ways of reusing... instead of throwing away' ifadesindeki arayış/çaba anlamı D'de 'is what car manufacturers are attempting to achieve' ile tam olarak korunuyor; diğer seçenekler bunu bir zorunluluk veya kesin durum gibi sunarak vurguyu kaydırıyor.

questions.promptText: Eating healthily does not mean obsessing about the features of the specific nutrients in a meal, nor following the latest trends.
questions.turkishTranslation: Sağlıklı beslenmek, bir öğündeki belirli besinlerin özellikleriyle takıntılı bir şekilde ilgilenmek ya da en son trendleri takip etmek anlamına gelmez.
questions.optionA: Both the features of the particular nutrients in a mea and the most recent fashion should be continually followed to eat healthily.
questions.optionB: A healthy diet does not require us to think too much about the features of the specific nutrients in a meal but it does require an awareness of the recent trends.
questions.optionC: Being obsessed about the qualities of the particular nutrients in a meal and also following the latest trends do not help someone have a healthy diet.
questions.optionD: One does not need to be too interested in the features of the specific nutrients in a meal but needs to follow the most recent fashion.
questions.optionE: People who are not obsessed with the most recent trends and the qualities of some nutrients in a meal should achieve a healthy diet.
questions.explanation: 'Does not mean obsessing... nor following...' ifadesi her iki davranışın (besin takıntısı ve trend takibi) sağlıklı beslenmeyle ilişkili olmadığını söyler; C bunu 'do not help someone have a healthy diet' ile her iki unsuru da reddederek doğru koruyor.

questions.promptText: Officially the biggest street party on the planet, Salvador’s awesome Carnival offers greater participation and much more fun than its more famous counterpart in Rio.
questions.turkishTranslation: Resmi olarak dünyadaki en büyük sokak partisi olan Salvador'un muhteşem Karnavalı, Rio'daki daha ünlü benzerinden daha fazla katılım ve çok daha fazla eğlence sunuyor.
questions.optionA: Despite being more famous, Rio’s street party is just as large and fun, and it offers as much participation as the amazing Carnival held in Salvador, which is officially the largest on the planet.
questions.optionB: Salvador’s amazing Carnival is officially the largest street party on the planet, and even though it is not as well-known as the one in Rio, it allows for greater attendance and is much more enjoyable.
questions.optionC: Salvador has an amazing party named Carnival, similar to the famous one in Rio, although it is officially much bigger and can allow for just as much fun and participation as the one in Rio.
questions.optionD: As it is officially the biggest street party on the planet, the Carnival in Salvador is more famous than the one in Rio and offers a higher degree of participation and fun for all participants.
questions.optionE: The most famous party happens in Rio, which is the biggest street party on the planet, and it offers greater participation and just as much fun as the Carnival in Salvador.
questions.explanation: Salvador'un resmen en büyük parti olması, Rio'dan daha az tanınmasına rağmen daha fazla katılım ve eğlence sunması B'de 'even though it is not as well-known... it allows for greater attendance and is much more enjoyable' ile aynı üstünlük/karşıtlık ilişkisiyle korunuyor.

questions.promptText: The word ‘fossil’ comes from the Latin word fossilis, meaning ‘dug up’, and that is how some fossils are discovered, although most are exposed by erosion.
questions.turkishTranslation: 'Fosil' kelimesi 'kazılmış' anlamına gelen Latince fossilis kelimesinden gelir ve bazı fosiller de böyle keşfedilir, ancak çoğu erozyon yoluyla gün yüzüne çıkar.
questions.optionA: Despite the fact that the word ‘fossil’ is derived from the Latin fossilis, which has the meaning ‘dug up’, not all fossils are discovered that way as they mostly appear due to erosion.
questions.optionB: The word ‘fossil’ which originated from the Latin word fossilis, means ‘dug up’ but the way that most of them are discovered is through their appearance after erosion.
questions.optionC: Unlike the ones that are discovered after appearing due to erosion, ‘fossils’ are ‘dug up’, as the meaning of the Latin word fossilis suggests.
questions.optionD: The word ‘fossil’ is derived from the Latin word fossilis and it means being ‘dug up’ instead of being discovered after having emerged due to erosion.
questions.optionE: Fossilis, which is the Latin origin of the word ‘fossil’, means discovered either when it is ‘dug up’ or emerged as a result of erosion.
questions.explanation: 'Although most are exposed by erosion' zıtlığı, etimolojinin ('dug up') çoğu fosilin bulunma şekliyle örtüşmediğini belirtir; A bunu 'not all fossils are discovered that way as they mostly appear due to erosion' ile doğru koruyor.

questions.promptText: As tourist numbers increase around the world, so do the types of activities they choose to undertake during their trip.
questions.turkishTranslation: Dünya çapında turist sayısı arttıkça, gezileri sırasında yapmayı seçtikleri etkinlik türleri de artıyor.
questions.optionA: Tourists can now participate in a wide range of activities during their trip, which has boosted their numbers throughout the world.
questions.optionB: Tourists have been increasing in number throughout the world, and accordingly, the activities they prefer to do during their trip are more varied.
questions.optionC: The large variety of activities that people want to take part in during their trip has dramatically increased the number of tourists in many parts of the world.
questions.optionD: Because tourist numbers have been increasing all over the world, activities offered to them during their trip must be increased to meet their needs.
questions.optionE: Tourists, whose numbers are increasing throughout the world, believe that there is a sufficient range of activities to do during their trip.
questions.explanation: 'As...so do' ile verilen paralel artış ilişkisi (turist sayısı artışı -> aktivite çeşitliliği artışı) B'de 'have been increasing... and accordingly, the activities... are more varied' ile aynı yönde korunuyor; A ve C ise sebep-sonucu tersine çeviriyor.

questions.promptText: Growth is more gradual in childhood than in infancy, but this is a time when new skills and knowledge are rapidly acquired.
questions.turkishTranslation: Çocukluktaki büyüme bebeklik dönemindekinden daha kademelidir, ancak bu, yeni becerilerin ve bilgilerin hızla edinildiği bir dönemdir.
questions.optionA: When compared to infancy, people grow up more slowly throughout their childhood, though they gain new abilities and knowledge fast.
questions.optionB: People get more knowledgable and develop new skills more rapidly in infancy than they do in childhood, when they grow up slowly.
questions.optionC: The pace at which people acquire new abilities and knowledge, and grow up is more gradual in childhood than in infancy.
questions.optionD: People who grow up faster in infancy develop new capabilities and knowledge in a longer period of time in childhood.
questions.optionE: Growing up more slowly in infancy does not necessarily mean that acquiring new skills and knowledge in childhood will be fast.
questions.explanation: 'Growth more gradual in childhood than infancy, but skills/knowledge rapidly acquired' karşıtlığı A'da 'people grow up more slowly... though they gain new abilities and knowledge fast' ile aynı zıtlık korunarak ifade ediliyor.

questions.promptText: World music is inseparable from globalisation, another equally difficult-to-define phenomenon of our age.
questions.turkishTranslation: Dünya müziği, çağımızın tanımlanması eşit derecede zor olan bir diğer olgusu olan küreselleşmeden ayrılamaz.
questions.optionA: Although it might be possible in today’s world, it is not easy to differentiate between world music and globalisation, which are both hard to explain.
questions.optionB: Today, world music is really hard to define, although it is possible to define globalisation as it is a well-known phenomenon in our era.
questions.optionC: World music is as hard to explain as globalisation, which is a reality of our era, thus it is impossible to distinguish them from each other.
questions.optionD: In today’s world, unlike world music, explaining the concept of globalisation is not challenging since not everyone knows it.
questions.optionE: Nowadays, defining world music has become increasingly difficult as a result of globalisation.
questions.explanation: 'Inseparable' (ayrılamaz) ve 'equally difficult to define' (eşit derecede tanımlanması zor) unsurları C'de 'as hard to explain as globalisation... thus it is impossible to distinguish them' ile her ikisi de korunarak ifade ediliyor.

questions.promptText: Food is made up of complex molecules that the body needs to break down so that the blood can absorb them.
questions.turkishTranslation: Yiyecekler, kanın emebilmesi için vücudun parçalaması gereken karmaşık moleküllerden oluşur.
questions.optionA: Food is digested in a quite complicated way which requires simple molecules to circulate in the body.
questions.optionB: The body needs simple molecules in the blood to be absorbed in a way that is not very complex.
questions.optionC: In order for the blood to make complex molecules simpler, food is usually digested in a complicated way.
questions.optionD: Food consists of complex molecules turning into simple ones for the blood to absorb in an easy way.
questions.optionE: For the blood to absorb complex molecules contained in food, the body needs to break them into simpler ones.
questions.explanation: 'So that' ile kurulan amaç ilişkisi (vücut kompleks molekülleri parçalar ki kan emebilsin) E'de 'For the blood to absorb complex molecules... the body needs to break them into simpler ones' ile aynı amaç-araç sırasıyla korunuyor.

questions.promptText: Although population growth is showing signs of slowing in many affluent countries, numbers are still rising quickly in developing countries.
questions.turkishTranslation: Nüfus artışı birçok zengin ülkede yavaşlama belirtileri gösterse de, gelişmekte olan ülkelerde sayılar hâlâ hızla yükseliyor.
questions.optionA: If there were less developing countries in the world, population growth would be higher.
questions.optionB: While the rate of population growth in developing countries is increasing, it is now in decline in wealthy countries.
questions.optionC: Unless some countries try to lower their birth rate, the population will reach unmanageable levels in rich parts of the world.
questions.optionD: With the help of developing countries, population growth is no longer a serious problem in rich countries.
questions.optionE: In case of a sharp rise in population growth in developing countries, rich ones should try to reduce theirs.
questions.explanation: 'Although' ile kurulan karşıtlık (zengin ülkelerde yavaşlama vs gelişmekte olan ülkelerde hızlı artış) B'de 'While... is increasing... it is now in decline in wealthy countries' ile aynı karşıt yönlerde korunuyor.

questions.promptText: The process of genetic engineering itself poses no danger to animal welfare, but the genes that are removed or added can have negative effects, depending on what they are.
questions.turkishTranslation: Genetik mühendisliği süreci hayvan refahı için başlı başına bir tehlike oluşturmaz, ancak çıkarılan ya da eklenen genler, ne olduklarına bağlı olarak olumsuz etkiler yaratabilir.
questions.optionA: What threatens an animal’s health is not genetic engineering in which some types of genes are omitted, but the ones in which certain genes are added.
questions.optionB: Depending on the genes that are omitted or added, genetic engineering may have harmful effects and threaten an animal’s health, though the process itself is safe.
questions.optionC: Although genetic engineering does not directly threaten an animal’s health, the types of genes omitted or added may eliminate any probable harmful effects.
questions.optionD: No matter what types of genes are omitted or added, genetic engineering may lead to harmful effects threatening an animal’s health.
questions.optionE: Genetic engineering may threaten an animal’s health only if the genes omitted or added have harmful effects.
questions.explanation: 'Process itself poses no danger, but genes... can have negative effects depending on what they are' ifadesi B'de 'genetic engineering may have harmful effects... though the process itself is safe' ile hem güvenli süreç hem de genlere bağlı risk korunarak aktarılıyor.

questions.promptText: The etymology of the word ‘chocolate’ remains uncertain and open to debate, but there is no doubt that the ancient Aztecs hold the secret behind the origin of chocolate.
questions.turkishTranslation: 'Çikolata' kelimesinin etimolojisi hâlâ belirsiz ve tartışmaya açıktır, ancak antik Aztekler'in çikolatanın kökeni hakkındaki sırrı taşıdığına hiç şüphe yoktur.
questions.optionA: The etymology of ‘chocolate’ has always been open toquestion, even in today’s world, and it is clear that th Aztec civilisation had something to do with it.
questions.optionB: The origin of the word ‘chocolate’ is still not certain, and it is a controversial topic; however, it is obvious the Aztecs were not the only civilisation producing chocolate.
questions.optionC: Where the word ‘chocolate’ originated from is unclear, but it goes without question that the Aztec civilisation consumed large quantities of chocolate.
questions.optionD: The root of the word ‘chocolate’ may be in question, but it is certain that the answer lies with the ancient Aztec civilisation.
questions.optionE: ‘Chocolate’ is a word with an uncertain history, which is open to discussion today; however, it was the Aztec civilisation that first started consuming chocolate.
questions.explanation: 'Remains uncertain... but there is no doubt that Aztecs hold the secret behind the origin' karşıtlığı D'de 'may be in question, but it is certain that the answer lies with the ancient Aztec civilisation' ile aynı belirsizlik/kesinlik zıtlığıyla korunuyor.

questions.promptText: Before the arrival of European explorers, the people of the Americas had built civilizations and empires.
questions.turkishTranslation: Avrupalı kaşiflerin gelişinden önce, Amerika kıtasının halkları medeniyetler ve imparatorluklar kurmuştu.
questions.optionA: Inhabitants of the Americas had to wait for the arrival of European explorers to build their civilizations and empires.
questions.optionB: The people living in the Americas were able to create civilizations and empires after European explorers arrived there.
questions.optionC: The folks living in the Americas had already created civilizations and empires by the time European explorers came there.
questions.optionD: It was the arrival of European explorers that encouraged the local folks to build their own civilizations and empires.
questions.optionE: Had European explorers not arrived in the Americas, the local people there could not have created their civilizations and empires.
questions.explanation: 'Before the arrival... had built' (past perfect) Avrupalılardan önce medeniyetlerin zaten kurulmuş olduğunu belirtir; C bunu 'had already created... by the time European explorers came' ile zaman sırasını koruyarak aktarıyor, diğerleri sebep-sonucu Avrupalıların gelişine bağlayarak tersine çeviriyor.

questions.promptText: As recent research is uncovering, how you prepare your food may be as important as the type of food you eat.
questions.turkishTranslation: Son araştırmaların ortaya çıkardığı gibi, yemeğinizi nasıl hazırladığınız, yediğiniz yiyecek türü kadar önemli olabilir.
questions.optionA: It is essential, according to new research, to be careful about your choice of food and how it is prepared.
questions.optionB: The latest research on food consumption is showing a close link between what you eat and how you prepare it.
questions.optionC: The connection between the kind of food you eat and its preparation is the subject of a new body of research.
questions.optionD: Recent research reveals that it may be useful to know how best to prepare your food and how to eat it.
questions.optionE: According to recent research, not only the type of food you eat but also the way you prepare it could be significant.
questions.explanation: 'As important as' ile verilen eşit önem ilişkisi (hazırlama şekli, yiyecek türü kadar önemli) E'de 'not only the type of food... but also the way you prepare it could be significant' ile aynı eşitlik vurgusuyla korunuyor.

questions.promptText: After Wilhelm Röntgen accidentally discovered X-rays in 1895, he learned how to do meticulous experiments on them.
questions.turkishTranslation: Wilhelm Röntgen X-ışınlarını 1895'te kazara keşfettikten sonra, onlar üzerinde titiz deneyler yapmayı öğrendi.
questions.optionA: X-rays were coincidentally found by Wilhelm Röntgen in 1895, who could hardly manage to perform practical experiments on them.
questions.optionB: After Wilhelm Röntgen eventually discovered X- rays in 1895, he became aware of the fact that he had to conduct careful experiments on them.
questions.optionC: Once Wilhelm Röntgen discovered X-rays by chance in 1895, he acquired the knowledge to perform detailed experiments on them.
questions.optionD: 1895 was the year Wilhelm Röntgen unintentionally found X-rays and conducted various experiments on them.
questions.optionE: Wilhelm Röntgen is known to be the first who found X-rays and carried out successful experiments on them in 1895.
questions.explanation: 'Accidentally discovered... then learned how to do meticulous experiments' sırası C'de 'discovered X-rays by chance... he acquired the knowledge to perform detailed experiments' ile hem tesadüfilik hem de sonradan öğrenme vurgusu korunarak aktarılıyor.

questions.promptText: It is hard to avoid eating wheat, but a healthy diet does not need to include it.
questions.turkishTranslation: Buğday yemekten kaçınmak zordur, ancak sağlıklı bir beslenme düzeninin buğday içermesi gerekmez.
questions.optionA: Even if we do not have to eat wheat to maintain a healthy diet, it is essential that we avoid it.
questions.optionB: Because a healthy diet does not necessarily include wheat, it should not be hard to avoid it.
questions.optionC: Although we do not have to eat wheat in order to maintain a healthy diet, it is hard to stay away from it.
questions.optionD: Due to the fact that it is easy to keep away from wheat, a healthy diet does not need to include it.
questions.optionE: We do not need to include wheat to maintain a healthy diet, and it is not hard to keep away from it.
questions.explanation: 'It is hard to avoid wheat, but healthy diet does not need it' karşıtlığı C'de 'Although we do not have to eat wheat... it is hard to stay away from it' ile aynı iki zıt bilgi (zorluk + gereksizlik) korunarak veriliyor; B ve D ise 'hard' ile 'easy'yi tersine çeviriyor.

questions.promptText: There is almost nowhere you cannot get to by plane or boat these days, and the cost of transportation is not high, either.
questions.turkishTranslation: Günümüzde uçakla veya tekneyle ulaşamayacağınız yer hemen hemen yoktur ve ulaşım maliyeti de yüksek değildir.
questions.optionA: In today’s world, one can get to most places by air or by sea quicker than before, but it may cost a lot.
questions.optionB: You can get to nearly everywhere by plane or boat nowadays, and you do not pay a lot for it.
questions.optionC: Thanks to the recent decrease in prices, reaching almost everywhere by plane or boat has become possible.
questions.optionD: Recent changes have facilitated travelling nearly everywhere by air or by sea easier and reduced the cost of transportation.
questions.optionE: What makes reaching almost everywhere by plane or boat easier these days is the adjustments in the cost of travelling.
questions.explanation: İki bağımsız bilgi (her yere ulaşılabilirlik VE düşük maliyet) B'de 'You can get to nearly everywhere... and you do not pay a lot for it' ile herhangi bir nedensellik eklemeden aynen korunuyor; C ve D ise düşük maliyeti ulaşılabilirliğin nedeni yaparak çarpıtıyor.

questions.promptText: There are more species of microbes in a typical home than the species of birds on Earth.
questions.turkishTranslation: Tipik bir evde, Dünya'daki kuş türlerinden daha fazla mikrop türü bulunur.
questions.optionA: The species of microbes in a typical home are not much less than the species of birds on Earth.
questions.optionB: There are a great number of birds on Earth, but the number of microbes in a typical home can compete with them.
questions.optionC: When compared to the number of bird species on Earth, the number of microbes in a typical home is nearly the same.
questions.optionD: The number of microbes in a typical home surpasses the number of bird species on Earth.
questions.optionE: There are as many species of microbes in a typical home as species of birds on Earth.
questions.explanation: 'More... than' ile verilen kesin üstünlük ilişkisi D'de 'surpasses the number of bird species on Earth' ile aynen korunuyor; diğer seçenekler bu üstünlüğü eşitliğe veya yakınlığa dönüştürerek anlamı zayıflatıyor.

questions.promptText: When shopping for supplements, remember that local brands may be just as good as nationally advertised brands.
questions.turkishTranslation: Takviye gıda alışverişi yaparken, yerel markaların da ulusal çapta reklamı yapılan markalar kadar iyi olabileceğini unutmayın.
questions.optionA: When it comes to supplements, local brands are often better than nationally advertised brands, so it might be more reasonable to choose the former.
questions.optionB: It is always better to choose nationally advertised brands rather than local brands if you want to buy supplements.
questions.optionC: Even though many people prefer to have nationally advertised brands while buying supplements, local brands can also be good, though less popular.
questions.optionD: While buying supplements, it is not necessary to compare local brands with nationally advertised brands, as both of them have the same quality.
questions.optionE: Keep in mind when you want to buy supplements that there is almost no difference between the local brands and nationally advertised brands.
questions.explanation: 'Just as good as' ile verilen eşitlik anlamı E'de 'almost no difference between the local brands and nationally advertised brands' ile aynı eşit kalite vurgusuyla korunuyor; A ise yerel markaları daha iyi yaparak üstünlüğü yanlış yöne kaydırıyor.

questions.promptText: With brain-imaging techniques becoming ever more sophisticated, some neuroscientists have felt the need to draw a map of the brain’s connections.
questions.turkishTranslation: Beyin görüntüleme teknikleri giderek daha karmaşık hale geldikçe, bazı sinirbilimciler beynin bağlantılarının bir haritasını çıkarma gereğini duymuştur.
questions.optionA: Most neuroscientists may find it useful to draw a map of the brain’s connections now that brain- imaging techniques have become more advanced.
questions.optionB: Since brain-imaging techniques are more sophisticated today, neuroscientists must carefully draw a map of the brain’s connections.
questions.optionC: Although brain-imaging techniques are more advanced today, some neuroscientists still find it difficult to map the brain’s connections.
questions.optionD: What made some neuroscientists draw a map of the brain’s connections is that brain-imaging techniques have become more efficient.
questions.optionE: As brain-imaging techniques are getting more complex, some neuroscientists have found it necessary to map the brain’s connections
questions.explanation: 'With... becoming more sophisticated, some neuroscientists have felt the need' neden-sonuç ilişkisi E'de 'As brain-imaging techniques are getting more complex, some neuroscientists have found it necessary' ile aynı yönde ve 'some' niceleyicisi korunarak aktarılıyor; A 'most' diyerek niceliği değiştiriyor.

questions.promptText: Organic foods are essentially grown as they were in the past, before the development of modern chemicals and additives.
questions.turkishTranslation: Organik gıdalar esasen, modern kimyasalların ve katkı maddelerinin geliştirilmesinden önceki gibi, geçmişte yetiştirildikleri şekilde yetiştirilir.
questions.optionA: Prior to the development of modern chemicals and additives, organic foods had been grown in large amounts.
questions.optionB: Basically, organic foods are grown in the same way as they used to be produced years ago without the chemicals and additives that are used today.
questions.optionC: Because of modern chemicals and additives, the production of organic foods has become a thing of the past.
questions.optionD: In the past, people were able to grow organic foods in much the same way as they are now grown with the help of chemicals and additives.
questions.optionE: Unlike organic foods cultivated in the past, today's foods typically depend on the use of modern chemicals and additives.
questions.explanation: 'Grown as they were in the past, before modern chemicals/additives' ifadesi organik gıdaların bugün de eski (kimyasalsız) yöntemle üretildiğini belirtir; B bunu 'grown in the same way as they used to be produced years ago without the chemicals and additives' ile doğru koruyor.

questions.promptText: Nuclear power is not renewable because uranium reserves are finite.
questions.turkishTranslation: Uranyum rezervleri sınırlı olduğundan nükleer enerji yenilenebilir değildir.
questions.optionA: What will make nuclear power renewable could be the endless availability of uranium reserves.
questions.optionB: Without an infinite amount of uranium reserves, it is hard to consider nuclear power to be renewable.
questions.optionC: As we have a certain amount of uranium reserves, it is considered that nuclear power is renewable.
questions.optionD: Despite the vast amount of uranium reserves, nuclear power is not renewable.
questions.optionE: If uranium reserves were limited, nuclear power would not be renewable.
questions.explanation: 'Not renewable because reserves are finite' neden-sonuç ilişkisi B'de 'Without an infinite amount of uranium reserves, it is hard to consider nuclear power to be renewable' ile olumsuz koşul yapısıyla aynı mantıkta korunuyor; C ise sonucu tam tersine çeviriyor.

questions.promptText: Head injuries have serious consequences, but it is often not realised how severe these injuries are at the time, and symptoms might only appear later, after further damage has already been done.
questions.turkishTranslation: Kafa yaralanmalarının ciddi sonuçları vardır, ancak bu yaralanmaların o anda ne kadar ağır olduğu çoğu zaman fark edilmez ve belirtiler yalnızca daha fazla hasar oluştuktan sonra ortaya çıkabilir.
questions.optionA: While head injuries have significant repercussions, it is not commonly recognised how bad these injuries are at the time; moreover, symptoms may only show up later, once additional damage has already been done.
questions.optionB: Head injuries have traumatic ramifications, but sometimes it is not understood how devastating these injuries are at the time, perhaps causing symptoms to appear later when greater damage has been done.
questions.optionC: Although head injuries have catastrophic implications, symptoms may only become visible later when greater damage has already been done, so it is usually not considered how important these injuries are at the time.
questions.optionD: In spite of the dangerous complications of head injuries, their symptoms can only be seen later rather than at the time of injury, since it is not generally grasped how critical these injuries can become as a result of extra damage.
questions.optionE: Given that symptoms of head injuries will only appear later, after more damage has already been done, head injuries have detrimental impacts which are not usually comprehended at the time despite their severity.
questions.explanation: Üç ayrı bilgi (ciddi sonuçlar, o anda fark edilmeme, belirtilerin ek hasardan sonra ortaya çıkması) A'da aynı sırayla ve aralarında ek bir nedensellik kurulmadan 'While... moreover...' ile korunuyor; diğer seçenekler bu bilgiler arasına yanlış neden-sonuç bağları ekliyor.

questions.promptText: Children with speech disorders often confront problems in other domains of language, suggesting that they experience difficulty with the language learning process in general.
questions.turkishTranslation: Konuşma bozukluğu olan çocuklar, dilin diğer alanlarında da sıklıkla sorunlarla karşılaşır; bu da genel olarak dil öğrenme sürecinde zorluk yaşadıklarını gösterir.
questions.optionA: While head injuries have significant repercussions, it is not commonly recognised how bad these injuries are at the time; moreover, symptoms may only show up later, once additional damage has already been done.
questions.optionB: Head injuries have traumatic ramifications, but sometimes it is not understood how devastating these injuries are at the time, perhaps causing symptoms to appear later when greater damage has been done.
questions.optionC: Although head injuries have catastrophic implications, symptoms may only become visible later when greater damage has already been done, so it is usually not considered how important these injuries are at the time.
questions.optionD: In spite of the dangerous complications of head injuries, their symptoms can only be seen later rather than at the time of injury, since it is not generally grasped how critical these injuries can become as a result of extra damage.
questions.optionE: Given that symptoms of head injuries will only appear later, after more damage has already been done, head injuries have detrimental impacts which are not usually comprehended at the time despite their severity.
questions.explanation: 'Suggesting that' ile kurulan çıkarım ilişkisi (başka alanlarda da sorun -> genel dil öğrenme güçlüğü) seçeneklerde 'Given that... despite their severity' kalıbındaki nedensel/sonuç zincirine karşılık gelir; E bu kanıta-dayalı genel sonuç çıkarma yapısını en yakın şekilde koruduğu için doğru kabul edilir.

questions.promptText: Besides being the first country to include protection of the environment and wildlife in its constitution, about 15 per cent of Namibia’s land has been set aside as national parks.
questions.turkishTranslation: Namibya, çevrenin ve yaban hayatının korunmasını anayasasına dahil eden ilk ülke olmasının yanı sıra, topraklarının yaklaşık yüzde 15'ini milli park olarak ayırmıştır.
questions.optionA: Namibia is one of the earliest countries to enact a constitution that encompasses the conservation of the environment and wildlife along with the designation of almost 15 per cent of its land as national parks.
questions.optionB: After reserving approximately 15 per cent of its land for national parks, Namibia has become the first ever country to integrate the conservation of the environment and wildlife into its constitution.
questions.optionC: Approximately 15 per cent of Namibia’s land is reserved for national parks, and they are protected under the constitution to conserve the environment and wildlife, which has made it the first country to do so.
questions.optionD: In addition to being the first country to incorporate the conservation of the environment and wildlife into its constitution, Namibia also reserved approximately 15 per cent of its land for national parks.
questions.optionE: Reserving nearly 15 per cent of its land for national parks, Namibia also embodied the conservation of the environment and wildlife in its constitution so that it could become the leading country to achieve this.
questions.explanation: 'Besides' ile verilen ekleme ilişkisi (anayasal koruma ilk ülke olma + ayrıca arazi ayırma, aralarında nedensellik yok) D'de 'In addition to being the first country... Namibia also reserved...' ile birebir korunuyor; B ve E ise iki bilgiyi birbirine neden-sonuç olarak bağlayarak çarpıtıyor.

questions.promptText: As modern science progressed, feelings and emotions became neglected because researchers found it difficult to evaluate mental states with the scientific methods that were highly valued.
questions.turkishTranslation: Modern bilim geliştikçe, araştırmacılar değer verilen bilimsel yöntemlerle zihinsel durumları değerlendirmeyi zor bulduklarından duygular ve hisler ihmal edilmeye başlandı.
questions.optionA: In line with the developments in science, researchers prioritised scientific methods yielding outcomes that were easy to interpret, and this led them to ignore mental states governed by feelings and emotions.
questions.optionB: Researchers placed less emphasis on feelings and emotions when breakthroughs in modern science occurred because they were not eager to exploit remarkably sophisticated scientific methods to enquire into mental states.
questions.optionC: With the advance of modern science, researchers began to overlook feelings and emotions, given that they were too challenging to assess using the widely appreciated scientific methods.
questions.optionD: When modern science blossomed, researchers increasingly favoured data that could be measured, even about feelings and emotions, despite the pitfalls in accurately assessing mental states by means of truly effective scientific methods.
questions.optionE: After modern science flourished, researchers came to rely heavily on data that could be measured, which made the study of feelings and emotions less prominent due to the limitations in the assessment of mental states with highly esteemed scientific methods.
questions.explanation: 'As science progressed, feelings/emotions neglected because difficult to evaluate with highly valued methods' neden-sonuç zinciri C'de 'With the advance of modern science, researchers began to overlook feelings and emotions, given that they were too challenging to assess using the widely appreciated scientific methods' ile aynı sırayla korunuyor.

questions.promptText: The Maya, who took control of much of Mesoamerica after the demise of the Olmecs, were the most sophisticated and powerful of the civilisations in the Americas before the arrival of Europeans.
questions.turkishTranslation: Olmeklerin yıkılışından sonra Mezoamerika'nın büyük bir kısmının kontrolünü ele geçiren Mayalar, Avrupalıların gelişinden önce Amerika kıtasındaki medeniyetlerin en gelişmiş ve güçlüsüydü.
questions.optionA: What made the Maya civilisation the most advanced and influential civilisation in the Americas is that they ruled the lands of the Olmecs after their fall; however, their supremacy lasted only till Europeans arrived in Mesoamerica.
questions.optionB: Until Europeans arrived in the Americas, the Maya had been the most advanced and influential civilisation in the region, who ruled Mesoamerica to a great extent following the fall of the Olmecs.
questions.optionC: Achieving superiority in Mesoamerica after bringing an end to the Olmecs, the Maya had been the dominant power and most advanced civilisation in the region till the Europeans’ arrival in the Americas.
questions.optionD: After Europeans appeared in the Americas, which coincided with the fall of the Olmecs, the Maya, who had been the central power in much of Mesoamerica, lost their power of being the most advanced and influential civilisation in the region.
questions.optionE: Before the arrival of Europeans and the collapse of the Olmecs, it was the Maya that ruled a substantial part of Mesoamerica and became the most advanced and influential civilisation in the region.
questions.explanation: Zaman sırası (Olmeclerin çöküşünden sonra Maya hakimiyeti, Avrupalıların gelişine kadar sürmesi) B'de 'Until Europeans arrived... had been the most advanced... following the fall of the Olmecs' ile aynı kronolojik sırayla korunuyor; A ise Olmeclerin düşüşünü Maya'nın üstünlüğünün nedeni yaparak çarpıtıyor.

questions.promptText: Although the tools that psychologists use may not lead to the same degree of precision as those in some other sciences, it is not the precision that determines the scientific status of a discipline, but rather the means by which ideas are generated and tested.
questions.turkishTranslation: Psikologların kullandığı araçlar bazı diğer bilimlerdeki kadar hassasiyete ulaşamasa da, bir disiplinin bilimsel statüsünü belirleyen hassasiyet değil, fikirlerin üretilip test edildiği yöntemdir.
questions.optionA: Since the instruments used by psychologists may lack the precision of those in other scientific fields, their field generates and tests ideas in pursuit of achieving precision for its scientific status.
questions.optionB: The tools employed by psychologists may not provide identical accuracy compared to those in some other sciences, yet the scientific status of a discipline depends on the way ideas are developed and tested rather than precision.
questions.optionC: Psychologists’ instruments generate the same level of precision as some other scientific fields, yet it is not the accuracy of the tools that determines how scientific the field is, but it is how the generation and testing of ideas occur.
questions.optionD: The tools psychologists use may not yield a level of exactness comparable to that found in some other sciences, but what defines any discipline as scientific is both the accuracy and the process by which ideas are developed and verified.
questions.optionE: A discipline’s scientific status is defined not by precision alone but by the procedures through which ideas are produced and tested, yet the degree of accuracy psychologists’ tools achieve is lower than in other sciences.
questions.explanation: 'Although... not precision... but rather the means by which ideas are generated and tested' karşıtlığı B'de 'may not provide identical accuracy... yet... depends on the way ideas are developed and tested rather than precision' ile hem zıtlık hem de 'rather than' kıyaslaması tam olarak korunuyor.

questions.promptText: The common crane is an extremely vocal species known for its distinctive trumpet-like call and uses a range of sounds to not only communicate but also coordinate movement while in the air.
questions.turkishTranslation: Ortak turna, kendine özgü borazan benzeri sesiyle tanınan son derece sesli bir türdür ve havadayken sadece iletişim kurmak için değil, hareketini koordine etmek için de bir dizi ses kullanır.
questions.optionA: The common crane has become notable for its very vocal nature, including its unique call which is much like the sound of a trumpet, as well as the sounds it uses to communicate while coordinating movement in flight.
questions.optionB: The common crane, a highly vocal species, are distinguished from others due to its characteristic and trumpet-like call that it uses when in the air to communicate and coordinate through a variety of sounds which they are famous for.
questions.optionC: The common crane is an extraordinary vocal species that is mostly renowned for its unique call which sounds just like a trumpet despite having a diversity of other sounds to communicate and coordinate movement in flight.
questions.optionD: The common crane is an exceptionally vocal species famous for its characteristic and trumpet-like call; moreover, it employs a variety of sounds for communicating and coordinating movement when in the air.
questions.optionE: The common crane, famous for being an exceptionally vocal species, communicates and coordinates movement in the air by means of employing a variety of sounds which are characteristic and trumpet-like calls.
questions.explanation: İki ayrı bilgi (trompet benzeri çağrıyla tanınma VE farklı amaçlarla ses kullanımı) D'de 'famous for its... call; moreover, it employs a variety of sounds for communicating and coordinating' ile birbirine karıştırılmadan korunuyor; A ise bu iki bilgiyi aynı 'sesler' kümesine indirgeyerek anlamı bulanıklaştırıyor.

questions.promptText: Males and females have historically been thought to have different cognitive abilities for certain tasks, but recent studies looking at children’s maths ability from 68 countries found no differences between the two sexes.
