questions.turkishTranslation: Erkeklerin ve kadınların belirli görevler için tarihsel olarak farklı bilişsel yeteneklere sahip olduğu düşünülmüştür, ancak 68 ülkeden çocukların matematik becerisini inceleyen son araştırmalar iki cinsiyet arasında hiçbir fark bulmamıştır.
questions.optionA: Although it has been proved by the recent studies conducted on children from 68 countries that men and women have similar talents in maths, there is still a widespread belief that they have dissimilar cognitive abilities.
questions.optionB: Although men and women have always been regarded to be dissimilar in their cognitive abilities for particular tasks, recent research findings from 68 countries suggest that children from different sexes have the same level of talent in maths.
questions.optionC: Following the studies conducted on children’s maths ability in 68 countries that revealed the talents of two sexes are comparable, the misconception about men and women having dissimilar cognitive abilities for particular tasks has weakened.
questions.optionD: The issue of men and women having different talents in particular tasks has always been linked to their cognitive abilities, yet there are some fields, such as maths, that both sexes are found equally talented by studies on children from 68 countries.
questions.optionE: While children from different sexes have been proved by studies from 68 countries to be equally talented in maths, there still exists a misconception that men and women are dissimilar in terms of their cognitive functions in certain tasks.
questions.explanation: 'Historically thought to be different, but recent studies found no differences' zıtlığı B'de 'have always been regarded to be dissimilar..., recent research findings... suggest... same level of talent' ile geçmiş inanç/yeni bulgu karşıtlığı değiştirilmeden korunuyor; A ve E ise bulguları 'kanıtlanmış gerçek' yapıp zıtlığı yanlış yöne çeviriyor.

questions.promptText: Recent satellite data has revealed that many countries have been massively underreporting their methane emissions, while the quantities of the gas being poured into the atmosphere have been increasing more sharply than ever.
questions.turkishTranslation: Son uydu verileri, atmosfere salınan metan miktarı her zamankinden daha hızlı artarken, birçok ülkenin metan emisyonlarını büyük ölçüde düşük bildirdiğini ortaya çıkarmıştır.
questions.optionA: According to the latest satellite data, some nations have been completely failing to report their methane release levels, which is understood from the fact that the quantities of gas entering the atmosphere are escalating faster than ever.
questions.optionB: New satellite data indicates that numerous nations have been reporting their methane release significantly lower, though the volume released into the air has risen at an unprecedented rate.
questions.optionC: Satellite data has just shown that nations have been deliberately reporting their methane levels lower, which explains the unparalleled pace in the amount of gas that has been released into the air.
questions.optionD: Because the level of methane in the atmosphere is rising with greater intensity than ever recorded, it is revealed by the new satellite data that numerous nations have been misinforming the public about their methane release.
questions.optionE: Thanks to the latest satellite data about the actual volume of methane levels entering the air, it has been acknowledged that some nations have not reported their real methane emissions which is climbing more aggressively.
questions.explanation: 'While' bağlacıyla verilen iki paralel (nedensiz) bilgi (düşük raporlama + emisyon artışı) B'de 'reporting their methane release significantly lower, though the volume... has risen at an unprecedented rate' ile birbirine neden-sonuç bağlanmadan aynen korunuyor; A, C, D ise bu iki olguyu birbirinin kanıtı/nedeni yaparak ilişkiyi değiştiriyor.

questions.promptText: Dinosaurs would not have become extinct had it not been for a massive asteroid strike, researchers have said, challenging the prevalent idea that their population was already in decline.
questions.turkishTranslation: Araştırmacılar, dinozorların popülasyonunun zaten azalmakta olduğu yönündeki yaygın görüşe karşı çıkarak, büyük bir asteroit çarpması olmasaydı dinozorların yok olmayacağını söyledi.
questions.optionA: Contrary to popular belief that dinosaur population was already declining, researchers have proved that their extinction was due to a huge asteroid strike.
questions.optionB: Researchers have disputed the widespread belief that dinosaur numbers were already shrinking by stating that without a massive asteroid strike, they would not have gone extinct.
questions.optionC: To oppose the long-standing idea that the number of dinosaurs was already shrinking, researchers have proposed the idea of an enormous asteroid strike that wiped out dinosaurs.
questions.optionD: Even before researchers indicated that if there had not been a huge asteroid strike, dinosaurs would have survived, the common opinion that they were already at the brink of extinction was already controversial.
questions.optionE: It is a popular belief that dinosaurs became extinct because of a massive asteroid strike; however, some researchers believe their numbers were actually already declining.
questions.explanation: 'Would not have become extinct had it not been for... challenging the prevalent idea' yapısı B'de 'disputed the widespread belief... by stating that without a massive asteroid strike, they would not have gone extinct' ile hem koşul cümlesi (üçüncü tip) hem de itiraz ilişkisi korunarak aktarılıyor.

questions.promptText: The consequences of insufficient sleep for adolescents are difficult to characterise due to the limited number of scientific studies with this age range.
questions.turkishTranslation: Yetersiz uykunun ergenler üzerindeki sonuçlarını belirlemek, bu yaş grubuyla yapılan bilimsel çalışmaların sınırlı sayıda olması nedeniyle zordur.
questions.optionA: While there is some research on puberty, the effects of inadequate sleep on the lives of adolescents are still vaguely described in scientific terms.
questions.optionB: The impact of inadequate sleep on adolescents cannot be described easily as the amount of scientific research on this age group is so small.
questions.optionC: Possible outcomes of inadequate sleep during adolescence is a formidable topic for today's researchers given that studies on this topic remain fairly limited.
questions.optionD: As long as the implications of inadequate sleep during adolescence remain hard to recognise, it will be challenging for researchers to increase the number of scientific studies on this age group.
questions.optionE: Because it is almost impossible to fully capture how inadequate sleep affects adolescents, there must be more scientific research on this age group.
questions.explanation: 'Due to' ile verilen neden (sınırlı çalışma sayısı) - sonuç (sonuçların tanımlanmasının güçlüğü) ilişkisi B'de 'cannot be described easily as the amount of scientific research... is so small' ile aynı yönde korunuyor; D ve E ise neden ile sonucu birbirine karıştırıp tersine çeviriyor.

questions.promptText: Although there are ongoing revisions to copyright law to safeguard the authors of books and other creative materials, these have not been fully successful.
questions.turkishTranslation: Kitap yazarlarını ve diğer yaratıcı eserlerin sahiplerini korumak amacıyla telif hakkı yasasında devam eden revizyonlar olsa da, bunlar tam olarak başarılı olamamıştır.
questions.optionA: The authors of books and various creative products have failed to protect their materials; however, revisions are still being made regarding the copyright law.
questions.optionB: Revisions to the copyright law are being made currently, yet they all have fallen short of fully protecting the authors of books and various creative products.
questions.optionC: No matter the amount of revisions to the copyright law are being made to protect the authors of books and various creative products, these all have proven to be unsuccessful for them.
questions.optionD: Despite the efforts of the authors of books and various creative products, all the revisions on the copyright law have fallen short of protecting them.
questions.optionE: As it fails to protect the authors of books and various creative products, there should be radical revisions to the copyright law.
questions.explanation: 'Although... ongoing revisions..., these have not been fully successful' karşıtlığı B'de 'Revisions... are being made currently, yet they all have fallen short of fully protecting...' ile aynı devam eden eylem + yetersizlik zıtlığıyla korunuyor; C 'proven to be unsuccessful' diyerek kısmi başarıyı tamamen reddederek anlamı sertleştiriyor.

questions.promptText: While many animals use camouflage to blend into their environment in their quest for survival, others employ a very different technique known as ‘dazzle patterns’ to confuse their predators.
questions.turkishTranslation: Birçok hayvan hayatta kalma arayışında çevrelerine karışmak için kamuflaj kullanırken, diğerleri avcılarını şaşırtmak amacıyla 'göz alıcı desenler' olarak bilinen çok farklı bir teknik kullanır.
questions.optionA: Though numerous animals merge into their surroundings with the use of camouflage in pursuit of survival, others puzzle their predators with an unusual method called ‘dazzle patterns’.
questions.optionB: Although many animals take advantage of a distinct strategy named ‘dazzle patterns’ to trick their predators, some of them owe their lives to combining this technique with using camouflage in their environment.
questions.optionC: Certain animals hide themselves by utilising camouflage in their surroundings to survive, but others might use an unusual technique referred to as ‘dazzle patterns’ in an attempt to puzzle their predators.
questions.optionD: While using camouflage gives a number of animals a chance for survival by making them indistinguishable from their environment, others choose to trick their predators with a distinct approach called ‘dazzle patterns’.
questions.optionE: A few animals puzzle their predators with the use of a method known as ‘dazzle patterns’ unlike the majority whose survival depends on their ability to merge into their environment by using camouflage.
questions.explanation: 'While many... others...' ile kurulan karşıtlık (kamuflaj kullananlar vs 'dazzle patterns' kullananlar) A'da 'Though numerous animals merge into... others puzzle their predators with... dazzle patterns' ile aynı miktar vurgusu (many/numerous, others) korunarak veriliyor; E ise nicelikleri ters çevirip 'a few' / 'majority' diyerek anlamı bozuyor.
